d022.speaker: Rapheal
d022.text:
[ea]No, you can’t sell me to science!
I’ll get you the money, I promise!

d022.speaker: Rapheal
d022.text:
[ea]...Hm? Wh-Where am I?
Oh...it was just a horrible dream...

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text: [ea][a8]gurgle[a9] Bleeeeeegh...

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea]Me busy feeding the fissshies.
Go away.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Master said it was my fault we didn’t make the
finals, so I has been, um, restructured.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Ummm, maybe us meeting is not a coincidence?
Maybe you give me a job?

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[d0]1[f5] has a new recruit.
He should give it a name.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Looks like your company’s, um, fully staffed
already.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Maybe you’ll have to restructure, if, um, you
want me on your team, that is.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oh, um, right. [a8]sigh[a9] This is even worse than
when I got rightsized.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] After the challenge is over, I never feel like
doing nuffin’.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text: [ea][a7][b0] I love it when there’s a challenge on...

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They give out free grub, see.
It’s nice not be ’ungry all the time.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I lost all my money and couldn’t go home,
so everyone’s been looking after me.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea]They throwed me outsss the house, and I floated
aaall the way down here. [a8]gurrrgle[a9]

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea]But me likesss it here.
FFFeels like home. [a8]guuurgle[a9]

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] In every scout challenge, there are all kinds of
dirty dealin’s be’ind the scenes.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] No one knows what, exactly, but there’s
always somethin’ fishy goin’ on.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The rumours start circulatin’ as soon as a new
challenge begins.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But not this time. It was clean as a whistle!
No ’idden motives AT ALL.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I spied this nasty-lookin’ black monster flyin’ to
Infern Isle... Never seen nuffin’ like it.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Sent a shiver down me spine, it did.
An’ now I can’t seem to get it out me ’ead!

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I’m flat broke, but there’s no work to be
had anywhere.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I came to see the challenge, but now I can’t get
home again.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Seems like I have no choice. I’ll have to become
a scout and earn money by fighting.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Now the challenge is over, I thought I’d visit the
mainland.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text: [ea][a7][b0] But the ship ain’t come, so I’m stuck ’ere.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text: [ea][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I’m bleedin’ sick o’ the sewers.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The challenge is over.
It’s time I left for an ’oliday.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Dunno who to take with me, though.
’Eligator or mechan-o’-wyrm?

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text: [ea][a7][b0] You reckon the mechan-o’-wyrm?

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] All right, it’s settled then.
I’ll take mechan-o’-wyrm.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And you can ’ave me ’eligator!
Don’t forget to name it!

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] All right, it’s settled then.
I’ll take mechan-o’-wyrm.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text: [ea][a7][b0] I got this spare ’eligator [96] you can have it!

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Well, yer COULD ’ave it, if you made some
space in your Monster Storage.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text: [ea][a7][b0] You reckon the ’eligator?

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] All right, guv.
I’ll take the ’eligator!

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And you can ’ave me mechan-o’-wyrm!
Don’t forget to name it!

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] All right, guv.
I’ll take the ’eligator!

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I got this spare mechan-o’-wyrm [96] you can
have it!

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Well, yer COULD ’ave it, if you made some
space in your Monster Storage.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text: [ea][a7][b0] I never shoulda asked for your advice.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’ve only got one monster now.
I feel like a beginner again.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea]They throwed me outsss the house, and I floated
aaall the way down here. [a8]gurrrgle[a9]

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea]But me likesss it here.
FFFeels like home. [a8]guuurgle[a9]

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a8]gurgle[a9] It’s terrible.
The sewwwers have ruined me best suit.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea]Maybe I don’t looksss it, but I’m very fastidious
about hygiene.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I saw this dodgy-looking bloke in a black hood.
I wondered[b0] what’s he up to, then?

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I tried to ’ave a word with ’im, but he
completely ignored me. People ’ave no manners!

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text: [ea][a7][b0] I love it when there’s a challenge on...

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They give out free grub, see.
It’s nice not be ’ungry all the time.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It isn’t so bad down here, once you get used to
it.

d022.speaker: Chuck
d022.text: [ea][a7][b0] I suppose I don’t need to leave any time soon.

d022.speaker: Igor Folds
d022.text:
[df]I sink to myself, now who could zat be?
But it’s just you. Vat do you vant?

d022.speaker: Igor Folds
d022.text:
[df][a8]shrug[a9] Ze laboratory zat I used in ze old days is
over zere.

d022.speaker: Igor Folds
d022.text:
[df]But now ze door is locked wiz a key, and I can’t
get in.

d022.speaker: Igor Folds
d022.text: [df]My old research partner used to have ze key...

d022.speaker: Igor Folds
d022.text:
[df]But he is gone now, and not even I, ze great Igor
Folds, can open ze door.

d022.speaker: Igor Folds
d022.text:
[df]So you vould like to know who my ‘research
partner’ vas...?

d022.speaker: Igor Folds
d022.text:
[df][a8]shrug[a9] No, I vill not speak of zat man.
He is gone. Let it be over now.

d022.speaker: Black Jacques
d022.text:
[ea]Ah, it is my leetle chum, [f5].
But maybe, you not so leetle any more, eh?

d022.speaker: Black Jacques
d022.text:
[ea]Everyone at CELL, zey know who is ze man that
stopped ze catastrophe.

d022.speaker: Black Jacques
d022.text:
[ea]You are a ’ero, young [f5].
You saved ze Green Bays.

d022.speaker: Black Jacques
d022.text:
[ea]Never did I sink zat a young boy and ’is leetle
monsters...

d022.speaker: Black Jacques
d022.text: [ea]...could grow strong enough to save ze world!

d022.speaker: Black Jacques
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] We’ll arrange for the heligator to be delivered
to Monster Storage.

d022.speaker: Black Jacques
d022.text:
[ea][a7][b0] We’ll arrange for the mechan-o’-wyrm to be
delivered to Monster Storage.

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[ea]B-But, he said he was only going to get a
breath of fresh air!

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[ea]...And when I asked to go along, he refused to
let me follow him!

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So you just watched him leave!?
You worthless, good-for-nothing...

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [d0]1[f5]...
Your father is no longer here.

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text: [ea][a7][b0] It is as if he has forsaken us all.

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[ea][a7][b0] No... No...
That cannot be true!

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Please forgive me, Warden [96] it was wrong
of me to doubt you!

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[ea]The island’s a mass of sheer cliffs.
He could only have headed in one direction...

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[ea]But the Warden [96] he of all people [96] surely
he wouldn’t...

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The Warden was resting here while his injuries
were tended to.

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[eb][a7][b0] He had recovered enough to walk a few steps,
but not nearly enough to go outside.

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text: [eb][a7][b0] And yet...he just vanished into thin air!

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Of course, I searched every corner of this
place, but he was nowhere to be found.

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The cadets who were away from headquarters
finally returned.

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[eb][a7][b0] With their help, we recaptured the escaped
monsters.

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I can’t believe what happened here while I was
gone.

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text: [ea][a7][b0] What will become of us after all this!?

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text: [ea][a7][b0] If the Warden were here, he’d know what to do.

d051.speaker: Attendant
d051.text:
[ea]IF THIS MESSAGE IS SHOWN, 
IT MEANS A BUG HAS JUST BEEN FOUND.

d051.speaker: Attendant

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text: [df]When I formed CELL, I had a specific plan.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[df]Unfortunately, I cannot make you privy to further
information on that issue.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[df]All I can tell you is that the lives of everyone on
these islands are at stake.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
These books appear to contain Dr Snap’s research
notes.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘The archipelago is home to a singularity which
opens a portal to the dark world...
[f1][fb][fd]
‘...once every 300 years.
When the portal opens...

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘...the darkness beyond begins to affect our world
causing its form to change.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘Accounts suggest that the land itself rises up to
meet the footfalls of...
[f1][fb][fd]
‘...the dark world’s invading multitudes.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘Though we dismiss it as a barren wilderness...
[f1][fb][fd]
‘...the scene of this event is none other than
Infern Isle.’

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
None of the books appear to be particularly
interesting.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
These books appear to contain Dr Snap’s research
notes.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘I always assumed that monsters were responsible
for generating dark matter.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘But I have recently come to believe that it is
dark matter which is responsible for...
[f1][fb][fd]
‘...generating monsters.
It appears that dark matter can...

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘...mould the substance of our world into 
something wholly different.’

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
None of the books appear to be particularly
interesting.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text: These look like Dr Snap’s notes.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘I had always thought of the Incarnus, the
creature born to seal the gate of darkness...
[f1][fb][fd]
‘...as an obstacle to my ambition.
I could not have been more wrong.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘Far from blocking my path,
the Incarnus holds the key!

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘For the Incarnus is responsible for maintaining the
balance of dark matter.’

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
None of the books appear to be particularly
interesting.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text: These look like Dr Snap’s notes.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘The greatest difficulty I face will be compelling
the Incarnus to open the gate to the dark world.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text: ‘However, I believe I have found a solution.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘Those stained in dark matter will draw more of
the substance unto themselves.
[f1][fb][fd]
‘So I shall stain the Incarnus.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘The darkonium crystals I gather through the
challenge should accomplish this perfectly.’

[df]Wait, [f5]!
I must...speak with you!

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text: A white sphere glows with a strange light.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text: [df]When I formed CELL, I had a specific plan.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[df]Unfortunately, I cannot make you privy to further
information on that issue.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[df]All I can tell you is that the lives of everyone
living on these islands are at stake.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Monster Scout Challenge will soon be held
on Domus Isle.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Proceed to the jetty downstairs, and make your
way to the city.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Don’t think that being Warden Trump’s son will
get you any special treatment.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Failure to follow orders will, as always,
result in severe punishment.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You would do well to heed your father this
time.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text: [ea][a7][b0] What are you doing here!?

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But never mind that.
I fear for the Warden...

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] All of the research material we stole from
Dr Snap is in these bookcases.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If you intend to pursue him, you should first
read his notes.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Then you will know exactly what he is
thinking [96] and where he is headed.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Dr Snap suddenly appeared with a mighty black
beast in tow.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text: [ea][a7][b0] They took the Mark from us by force.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Warden tried to stop him, but the beast
felled him with a single blow.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] CELL’s purpose was to expunge the threat of
dark matter from this world.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] With dark matter gone, monsters would cease
to exist as well. There would be peace.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] We hoped to use the Mark and the power of the
Incarnus to achieve that end.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text: [ea][a7][b0] To think that things would end like this...

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] CELL’s purpose was to expunge the threat of
dark matter from this world.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] With dark matter gone, monsters would cease
to exist as well. There would be peace.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] We hoped to use the Mark and the power of the
Incarnus to achieve that end.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But with Warden Trump gone and our plan in
ruins...what will become of us?

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text: [ea][a7][b0] The Warden left without telling anyone.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text: [ea][a7][b0] And his wounds were not even fully healed yet.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It was so sudden.
None of us could have predicted it.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text: [ea][a7][b0] The Warden left a letter...

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s addressed to you, [f5].
Take it.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text: [d0]1[f5] takes the letter.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘[d0]1[f5], if you are reading this,
I am no longer in Green Bays.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘I have left to search for a new method of
eliminating the monster threat.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘I can never forgive them for stealing my beloved
from me.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘I know that others within CELL are motivated by
similar tragedies.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
‘I also know that you are not.
So leave CELL and walk your own path’.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Since you were a young boy, the Warden
always sought to hide his true intentions from you.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But now he has finally come to respect you as
a grown man.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea]IF THIS MESSAGE IS SHOWN, 
IT MEANS A BUG HAS JUST BEEN FOUND.

d052.speaker: Warden Trump
d052.text:
[ea]IF THIS MESSAGE IS SHOWN, 
IT MEANS A BUG HAS JUST BEEN FOUND.

d052.text:

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]It’s a simple little test [96] you just have to bring me
some monsters.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Of course, they have to be the right KIND of
monsters...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]...and sometimes, finding them isn’t so easy.
It takes brains as well as brawn.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]But the good news is, you can keep all the
monsters that you show me.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]And IF you bring the right ones, I’ll even reward
you with a little prize.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]It’ll cost you five gold coins to play.
What do you say?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Now, problem number three... Oh, hang on.
It’s too soon for that.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]We can’t continue until after the opening ceremony
of the challenge has taken place on Domus Isle.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Next prob[96] er, wait... There aren’t any.
You’ve completed all ten!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]I’ll need time to prepare a new test.
Come back later, young man.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the home of Infant Isle’s famous Monster
Scout Proficiency Test.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout. You’ve completed the Monster
Scout Proficiency Test...
[f1][fb][fd]
Which means you’re ready for something a little
more challenging!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]TA-DA! It’s time for the Advanced Monster Scout
Proficiency Test!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The rules are the same [96] you bring me the monsters
I tell you to.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]But now the problems are VERY tricky. You’ll need
to put your thinking cap on, lad [96] and keep it on!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Now then, it’ll cost you the princely sum of
1000 gold coins. Still want to take the test?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Next prob[96] er, wait... There aren’t any.
You’ve completed all ten!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Aye, you’re a fine scout indeed, to pass such a
difficult test.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]You’re not just a champion fighter, lad [96] you’re a
champion thinker too!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the home of the Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Bring me a monster that you’ve scouted!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the home of the Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Bring me a monster that can equip a cypress staff!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the home of the Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Bring me a monster that only appears on this island
at night!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the home of the Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Bring me a monster of the dragon family!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the home of the Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Bring me a Rank E monster!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the home of the Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Bring me a monster that you’ve synthesised!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the home of the Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Bring me a Rank C monster of the material family!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the home of the Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Just bring me a jumping jackal!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the home of the Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Bring me a king slime [96] from this island or
anywhere else!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the home of the Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Bring me a Rank A monster!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is not so simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Bring me a green slime that thinks it’s a courageous
steed!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]...Oh, and despite its name, it likes both ‘night’ AND
day.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is not so simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Bring me a hot-tempered monster that needs a
spittoon!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is not so simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]First, fill in the blank[b0]
‘------ Quest is my favourite RPG!’

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Now, bring me one of those!
Specifically, I want the GREEN one...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is not so simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]I don’t want just any ‘G-rate’ monster, I want you
to bring me a monster that’s better than good.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Now don’t let my question ‘grate’ on your nerves
too much. Just bring me the monster I desire.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is not so simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Fetch me a ‘manly’ monster!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]To work out what kind of monster I want, you’ll
need to pay close attention to the species name.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]If you look hard enough, I’m sure you’ll see what
I mean by ‘manly’. It’s right in front of you!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is not so simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The monster I seek was meant to stand on a
pedestal...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]...but it prefers to spend its whole life stomping
around, with the same stony expression on its face.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is not so simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The monster I seek is a man-eating menace that
likes to think outside the box.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Watch out [96] it’s one canny little carnivore!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is not so simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The ghoulish ghost that I seek may have a grin on
its bony face, but it really is a very unhappy soul.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, you would be unhappy too if you had been
through what this poor soul has endured.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is not so simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The many-armed demon I seek wears a skull
around its neck.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Be careful [96] it’s a MAL-evolent, WRATH-ful old
devil!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is not so simple...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]I’m sure you still have fond memories of your first
monster, so bring me one of that type!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Tsk. It doesn’t look like you’ve found the monster
I’m seeking.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Take your time, sonny.
Think about it again, and try a different monster.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Bravo, young man!
You’ve solved problem number [d0] !

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Remember [96] scouting monsters is the most basic
skill you must master.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df][d0]1[d0]W can certainly use cypress
staves.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Ghosts do indeed appear on this island at night.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Stump chumps do indeed appear on this island at
night.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Winkies do indeed appear on this island at night.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df][d0]1[d0]W do belong to the 
dragon family.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df][d0]1[d0]W are Rank E monsters,
without a doubt.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]A scout isn’t really a scout until he’s learnt how
to synthesise.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Keep practising those skills and your team will be
unbeatable.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The mud mannequin is indeed a Rank C monster of
the material family.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The dingaling is indeed a Rank C monster of the
material family.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The hunter mech is indeed a Rank C monster of the
material family.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The puppeteer is indeed a Rank C monster of the
material family.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Here is your prize [96] a darkonium crystal!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Some monsters exist only through the power of
synthesis.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Never hesitate to experiment.
Who knows what you might create?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Ooh, goody, you’ve brought me a king slime!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]I do love how they wobble so!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]A Rank A [d0]V?
You’ve done well, young scout.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Here is your reward [96] a rather dangerous-looking
pair of metal talons.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [d0]1[f5] receives a pair of metal talons!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well then, young [f5].
You’ve solved all ten problems.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Which means [96] if I’m not very much mistaken [96] that
you’ve passed the Monster Scout Proficiency Test!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]I’ll need time to prepare a new test.
Come back later, young man.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Hmmm... How about...? Ah yes! ...Actually, no.
Too easy. Hmmm... What else is there?
[f1][fb][fd]
Perhaps...hmmm... Aha! That might be good!
...But no one would ever find one... Hmmm...
[f1][fb][fd]
...FINISHED!
Ahem, the new test is ready!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Just talk to me when you feel like taking it!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]I’m afraid that’s not right.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]You have to really, REALLY think about it.
Now go and bring me another monster.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Bravo, young man!
You’ve solved problem number [d0] !

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]What green-coloured slime likes to think it’s a
courageous steed, night OR day?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Why, a slime knight, of course!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The answer is a spitnik!
It likes to spit, you see.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Hmph. What are you looking at me like that for?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]You’ve never heard of a spittoon?
Well, I didn’t say it would be easy!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This one was a bit on the easy side, I thought.
It was a green dragon, of course.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]I mean, there’s no such thing as Bubble Slime Quest!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]You’ve brought a great argon lizard.
It’s a ‘G-rate’ monster indeed!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]You’ve brought a great dracky.
It’s a ‘G-rate’ monster indeed!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]You’ve brought a great sabrecat.
It’s a ‘G-rate’ monster indeed!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]You’ve brought a great dragon.
It’s a ‘G-rate’ monster indeed!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]You’ve brought a great sabrecub.
It’s a ‘G-rate’ monster indeed!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Now that problem was better than good, wasn’t it!?
Heh heh heh!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]I asked for a ‘manly’ monster...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]In short, I was looking for a monster with ‘man’ in
its name!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]So your anchorMAN is perfect!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]So your phantom swordsMAN is perfect!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]So your mud MANnequin is perfect!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]So your merMAN is perfect!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]That’s right [96] I was seeking a living statue!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]What other stony-faced monster was meant to
stand on a pedestal...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]...but now stomps around wherever it pleases?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]What canny, man-eating monster thinks outside the
box?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Why, a cannibox, of course!
You’re sharper than you look, young man.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]What ghostly ghoul can’t stop grinning,
even though it’s deeply unhappy?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Yes, yes. It could be none other than a skull-faced
tortured soul.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]...Although, names are deceiving.
Some of them can be quite good company...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Yes, yes, well done. The malroth is a MAL-evolent
and WRATH-ful old devil.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]You are a mighty scout indeed, to bring me a
Rank S monster!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The truth is, I have no idea what your first ever
monster was.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]But surely you must know.
So I suppose you’re correct!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Here’s your prize [96] a pair of amazingly durable
orichalcum claws. Couldn’t blunt ’em if you tried!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [d0]1[f5] receives a pair of orichalcum claws!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Well, well, [f5].
You’ve solved all ten problems...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]...and, sadly, my Advanced Monster Scout
Proficiency Test is over.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]On a more positive note, you’ve fulfilled one of the
two conditions for entry into Solitaire’s Challenge.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Aye, you did very well indeed.
Those problems were not at all easy!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]It’s been an honour to meet a scout of your calibre!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]This is your prize [96] [d0]H.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[d0]1[f5] receives
[d0]H.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Now, problem number three...
Oh, hang on. It’s too soon for that.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]We can’t continue until after the opening ceremony
of the challenge has taken place on Domus Isle.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Now, the Monster Scout Proficiency Test consists of
ten problems.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The next problem will cost [d0]8 gold coins.
Do you want to hear it?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Now, the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency Test
consists of ten problems.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The next problem will cost [d0]8 gold coins.
Do you want to hear it?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now go and find me the monster I seek!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Now, problem number three...
Oh, hang on. It’s too soon for that.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]We can’t continue until after the opening ceremony
of the challenge has taken place on Domus Isle.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Aye, welcome. Scoutmaster Shuffles, at your
service. Perhaps you’ve heard of me?
[f1][fb][fd]
I’m the man who runs this island’s famous Monster
Scout Proficiency Test.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]It will cost you [d0]8 gold coins.
Are you willing to try?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Aye, I’m Scoutmaster Shuffles, as I think you
already know.
[f1][fb][fd]
I’m the man who runs the Advanced Monster Scout
Proficiency Test.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Do you wish to take the test?
It will cost you [d0]8 gold coins.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Good, let’s begin! Listen carefully to problem
number [d0]  of the Monster Scout Proficiency Test!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Bring me a monster that you’ve scouted!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Bring me a monster that can equip a cypress staff!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Perhaps you know that you can equip your monsters
with weapons?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go and find that monster!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Bring me a monster that only appears on this island
at night!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Different monsters appear when day turns to night.
Bring me one of them.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Bring me a monster of the dragon family!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]There are many different monster families.
Dragons form one such group.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]An icon next to the monster’s name shows the
family it belongs to.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Bring me a Rank E monster!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]The monster’s rank shows how powerful it is.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]It might seem hard to believe, but there are
monsters out there ranked even higher than A!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Bring me a monster that you’ve synthesised!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Any kind of synthesised monster at all.
I don’t care what kind.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go out there and synthesise!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]You have to bring me a Rank C monster that is
ALSO of the material family.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Can you find a monster that meets both conditions?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]I’ll make it simple [96] just bring me a jumping jackal!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]But I should tell you [96] you won’t find this monster
anywhere in Green Bays.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]So how are you going to get one?
Think very, very carefully now...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Bring me a king slime [96] from this island or
anywhere else!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Where can you find one?
That’s a problem for YOU to solve!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]If scouting one is too difficult, synthesising is
always an option...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Bring me a Rank A monster!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]By the way, I don’t care if you scouted it or
synthesised it yourself.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is the very last problem in the Monster Scout
Proficiency Test. You can solve it if you try!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Now, are you ready? Problem [d0]  of the Advanced
Monster Scout Proficiency Test!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Bring me a green slime that thinks it’s a courageous
steed!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]...Oh, and despite its name, it likes both ‘night’ AND
day.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Bring me a hot-tempered monster that needs
a spittoon!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Think what kind of hot-tempered monster would
need a spittoon [96] if you know what a spittoon is!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]This one’s a gift!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]First, fill in the blank[b0]
‘------ Quest is my favourite RPG!’

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Now, bring me one of those!
Specifically, I want the GREEN one...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]I don’t want just any ‘G-rate’ monster, I want you
to bring me a monster that’s better than good.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Now don’t let my question ‘grate’ on your nerves
too much. Just bring me the monster I desire.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Fetch me a ‘manly’ monster!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]To figure out the type of monster I want,
you’ll have to look closely at the species name.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]If you look hard enough, I’m sure you’ll see
what I mean by ‘manly’. It’s right in front of you!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The monster I seek was meant to stand on a
pedestal...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]...but it prefers to spend its whole life stomping
around, with the same stony expression on its face.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The monster I seek is a man-eating menace that
likes to think outside the box.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Watch out [96] it’s one canny little carnivore!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The ghoulish ghost that I seek may have a grin on
its bony face, but it really is a very unhappy soul.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Just think about it... Sad souls whose bony grins
hide the torture within...

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]The many-armed demon I seek wears a skull around
its neck.

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]It’s MAL-evolent, it’s WRATH-ful [96] and, er,
it has wings too!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]I’m sure you still have fond memories of your first
monster, so bring me one of that type!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]This is absolutely, positively the final problem.
So anyway, do you remember?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]Now, go!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text: [df]What!? You don’t have enough gold!?

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Then stop wasting my time and ask your mother for
more pocket money or something!

f010.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
f010.text:
[df]Come back when you’re ready to take the next part
of the test.

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text:
[df]What a relief.
If we had lost this...

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text:
[df]Ah, [f5].
Did you come to check on me?

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text:
[df]Well, don’t you worry, my boy.
I’m quite all right, I assure you.

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text:
[df]All the bounders took were my research notes and
a diary.

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text:
[df]But I haven’t lost a thing.
It’s all up here, in my head.

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text: [df]The important thing is that no one was hurt.

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text:
[df]Well, then. Let’s put this unpleasant incident behind
us, shall we?

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text: [df]The Scout’s Mark is still safe and sound.

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text:
[df]So you, young man, can go back to worrying about
your challenge.

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text:
[df]I’ve taught you some of my finest tricks.
[f1][fb][fd]
It would be a shame not to see them put into
practice in the finals!

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text: It’s locked and won’t open.

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Congratulations on your victory, [f5].

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The award ceremony will take place in the
Commissioner’s office.[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] He’s waiting for you there now.

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Ahem.
This is the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Dr Snap
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Commissioner is a very busy man,
don’t you know? He’s not to be disturbed.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Ah, I’m sorry.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] I’m not authorised to allow anyone inside.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: There is no time for that now.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: Take the lift and leave Monster Scout HQ?

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Welcome to Monster Scout HQ.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You’re here for the challenge, is that right?
Let me just register you...

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Okay, [f5]. I’ve registered you as a
participant, so you’re all set.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Let me tell you about the Monster Scout
Challenge.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Your first objective is to collect ten darkonium
crystals.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Darkonium is a rare kind of rock, usually taking
the form of star-shaped crystals.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] There are darkonium crystals scattered across
the islands.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Once you collect ten of them, you’re allowed
to proceed to the goal.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The first five scouts who reach the goal
advance to the next round of the challenge.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] And that’s all you need to know for now.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You can always come here later to remind
yourself of the rules.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Don’t hesitate to ask if you’re unsure about
anything.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We’re here to answer all your Monster Scout
Challenge questions.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] What would you like to know?

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We’re here to answer all your Monster Scout
Challenge questions.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] What would you like to know?

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We’re here to answer all your Monster Scout
Challenge questions.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] What would you like to know?

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well done, [f5]!
You’ve managed to collect ten darkonium crystals!

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You still have a chance to make the finals.
Hurry upstairs to Baden’s Belfry!

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You haven’t officially reached the goal until
you ring the bell.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s like a countdown to the finals.
You see...

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...when the bell rings for the fifth time,
that means the qualifying round is over.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Now hurry to the belfry, and ring that bell as
loud as you can!

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Let the whole town know you’ve reached the
goal!

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You still have a chance to make the finals.
Hurry upstairs to Baden’s Belfry!

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Ring the bell and let the whole town know
you’ve reached the goal.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We’re here to answer all your Monster Scout
Challenge questions.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] What would you like to know?

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] When you’re ready for the tournament,
just come to this counter.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But we’re not ready to start just yet.
Please come back in a little while.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] We have an awful lot to do at the moment.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] While you’re here, why not have a walk around
the town? It’s a very interesting place.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] If you’re ready for the finals, proceed to the
lounge and let the staff know.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Congratulations on your victory, [f5].

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You’re still free to use the sea scooters and
scoutpost facilities.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We provide round-the-clock support.
The MSO is here to serve YOUR needs.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Please don’t go near that Infern Isle place.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Something terrible is happening.
The whole island is being transformed.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We’re not actually banning anyone from going,
but it really is too dangerous.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You’re [f5], right?
The scout challenge champion?

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The new Commissioner wants to see you.
Please proceed to the commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I think Miss Rumm[96] I mean, Solitaire, is planning
some kind of new project.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] As the challenge champion, you should be
helping the Commissioner out.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The Commissioner has already made the
announcement...[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...about the all-new Solitaire’s Challenge.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Participants have to pass certain trials first.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Specifically, earn Rank X in the battle arena at
Xeroph Isle...

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...and pass the Advanced Monster Scout
Proficiency Test at Infant Isle.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Only scouts who fulfil both criteria are
permitted to fight Miss Rumm[96][f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...I mean, Commissioner Solitaire.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Solitaire’s Challenge has no opening ceremony.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Just start when you’re ready.
Good luck!

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I can tell you all about Solitaire’s
Challenge.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Would you like me to explain?

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Participants have to pass certain trials first.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Specifically, earn Rank X in the battle arena at
Xeroph Isle...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...and pass the Advanced Monster Scout
Proficiency Test at Infant Isle.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Only scouts who fulfil both criteria are
permitted to fight Miss Rumm[96][f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...I mean, Commissioner Solitaire.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] That’s all you need to know about
Solitaire’s Challenge. Good luck!

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] If you’d like to hear the explanation again,
just drop by any time.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hello, [f5].
Are you ready for Solitaire’s Challenge?

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Miss Rumm[96] Commissioner Solitaire is waiting in
her office.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You fought well against the Commissioner,
[f5].

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Don’t be discouraged.
Try again some other time.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You’re the only one who can really give
Solitaire a run for her money.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: It’s locked and won’t open.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: It’s locked and won’t open.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: It’s locked and won’t open.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Welcome back, [f5].
The finals are about to get under way.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] If you’ve finished all your preparations, we can
get started.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You’ll be fighting with the monsters you have
in your current team.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Are you ready to enter the finals?

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Okay, then.
Let the games begin!

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Oh, I’m sorry.
Didn’t I tell you?

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You need at least two monsters in your team to
compete in the finals.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Please come back when you have a team
containing two or more monsters.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] All right. But please come back here as soon
as you’re ready.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] We’re ready to begin the finals.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You’ll be fighting with the monsters you have
in your current team.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Are you ready to enter the finals?

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Are you ready to fight in the scout challenge
finals?

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Good. The finals will begin immediately.
One moment please.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Oh, I’m sorry.
Didn’t I tell you?

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You need at least two monsters in your team to
compete in the finals.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Please come back when you have a team
containing two or more monsters.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well, when you ARE ready, please come and
see me.

f020.speaker: Kakariin
f020.text: Go to the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Oh, this chair is to DIE for! Soft yet supportive,
handsome yet approachable [96][f1][fb][fd]
It’s like sitting on my dream man!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Kicking back in your very own office is one of the
perks of being commissioner.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Ah, if I had won the finals, this chair would’ve
been mine.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Fancy not having a commissioner at a time like this!
Ridiculous! The MSO was falling apart.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Well, I had to put my foot down. Someone needed
to whip this place back into shape.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]I suppose I’m the de facto commissioner now.
What can I say?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Why don’t you renew your pledge at Infant Isle?
[f1][fb][fd]
You can pay your last respects to you-know-who,
too.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]We need you in top shape for the next scout
challenge. The fans demand nothing less.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]And by the time you get back, we’ll be ready to
launch the brand new challenge!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Want to go one-on-one with me?
Take Solitaire’s Challenge.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Actually, I’m not asking. I’m telling.
Remember who’s the Commissioner around here!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]It is almost time [96] time for the battle we have been
fated to fight!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]You think you’re ready, [f5]?
HA! You’ll never be ready for ME!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Hm? Little loser boy thinks he can win this time?
Oooh, scary.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Fine, fine.
I’ll fight you as often as it takes.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Yes, yes?
What do you want?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]You want to know about the key?
Well, if you’re so clever, work it out yourself.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb]It’s your key now.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]I didn’t want it anymore, anyway.
It stinks of sewers.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]And by the way, Solitaire’s Challenge isn’t
over yet.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]We’ve just got started.
More battles lie ahead!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb]You’ve only won the first round, nothing more.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Don’t you dare think I’m finished yet.
I’m not the quitting type.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
