[ea][a7][b0] Then they just have to ring Baden’s Bell,
and they’re in the finals.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea]REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I just talked to the Commissioner for the first
time. He’s actually pretty laid-back.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But when he laughs, he doesn’t laugh with his
eyes, if you know what I mean.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s not surprising. If great men weren’t
different, they wouldn’t be great.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Where did the MSO suit go?
You know, the one with the snooty accent?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He was in front of the Commissioner’s office
going ‘ahem’ this and ‘don’t you know’ that.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Traditionally, the challenge champions are
awarded a trophy and money.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] But this time the Commissioner’s decided that the
Scout’s Mark will be the prize.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] I reckon that’s why so many people entered the
challenge this year.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] We’ve developed all kinds of scouting items
here [96] including that ring on your finger.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Did you know that it was Dr Snap who invented
the scout ring?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] With that one invention, he revolutionised
scouting.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It appears that darkonium consists of
concentrated dark matter.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, dark matter is generated naturally
by monsters.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That’s what the Commissioner says, anyway,
and there’s still much even he doesn’t know.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] This is the lounge where scouts can come and
unwind during the knockout tournament.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] I do hope YOU reach the finals!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I just talked to the Commissioner for the first
time. He’s actually pretty laid-back.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But when he laughs, he doesn’t laugh with his
eyes, if you know what I mean.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s not surprising. If great men weren’t
different, they wouldn’t be great.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Where did the MSO suit go?
You know, the one with the snooty accent?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He was in front of the Commissioner’s office
going ‘ahem’ this and ‘don’t you know’ that.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] The top prize is the Scout’s Mark, though I’ve
never laid eyes on it m’self.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [df][a7][b0] I can’t help wond’rin’ where he keeps it.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Scout’s Mark was originally used by the
monster known as the Incarnus.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] At least, that’s what the legends say.
But who’s to say they’re not true?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s amazing that the Commissioner managed to
find such a treasure.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It appears that darkonium consists of
concentrated dark matter.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, dark matter is generated naturally
by monsters.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That’s what the Commissioner says, anyway,
and there’s still much even he doesn’t know.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m keeping this place spick and span
in preparation for the finals.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s important that the contestants feel
completely at ease in the lounge.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I bet it was her. I mean,
she disappeared right at the same time.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Considering she was an MSO employee,
she was way too nice to the scouts.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Did you see? She would smile at EVERY-
ONE who came to the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Someone broke into the Commissioner’s
office.[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] They were probably after the Scout’s
Mark.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I don’t know why she did it,
but I’m sure she was working alone.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’d hate to think it was one of my
colleagues, but if it smells like a slime...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] The poor Commissioner hardly ever gets
out...[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...and as soon as he does,
look what happens.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, the thief stole the
Commissioner’s research documents.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Nothing is more valuable to Dr Snap than
those notes.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hey, listen. Why don’t you go and see
how the Commissioner is doing?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m far too polite to go myself. I
wouldn’t want to intrude at a time like this.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I think their plan was to get as many
people as possible to visit the Commissioner.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They guessed that someone would be sure
to lure him out of his office sooner or later.[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] Giving them a perfect chance to raid it.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I do hope the Commissioner can
find it in his heart to forgive me.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Had I only done my job,
this tragedy would never have occurred.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I became ill and took to bed with a
slight fever.[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] Oh, what a fool I am!
A fool, I say!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Ahem.
This is the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But, I’m afraid I couldn’t possibly let a stranger
disturb him at the moment.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] How was the Commissioner?
Was he upset about the robbery?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Oh, poor Dr Snap.
All his research notes were stolen.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Yes, of course. Those research notes were his
life’s work, weren’t they?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Oh, he’s so brave!
He refuses to show how upset he is.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Everybody says that female staff member was
involved, right?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] Shame. I kind of fancied her.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] It’s a good thing them bandits didn’t make off
with the Scout’s Mark.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] See, the Commissioner anticipated summin’ like
this, and he hid it well away.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Some people aren’t very keen on this new rule
about collecting darkonium.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They say it was just a way for Dr Snap to get
free samples for his research.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It is true the Commissioner uses an awful lot of
darkonium...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But so what? He makes the rules, right?
We’ll just have to live with them.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It appears that darkonium consists of
concentrated dark matter.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, dark matter is generated naturally
by monsters.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That’s what the Commissioner says, anyway,
and there’s still much even he doesn’t know.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] This is the lounge where scouts can come and
unwind during the knockout tournament.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] I do hope YOU reach the finals!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Oh, pshaw! They say we can’t keep the
darkonium we collect.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] I was going to use it to make jewellery.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Ahem.
This is the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But, I’m afraid I couldn’t possibly let a stranger
disturb him at the moment.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] It’s a good thing them bandits didn’t make off
with the Scout’s Mark.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] See, the Commissioner anticipated summin’ like
this, and he hid it well away.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Listen.
This is just between you and me...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But the truth is, only the Incarnus can use the
Scout’s Mark.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Even if you win it, none of your monsters can
equip it. Not much use, huh?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Doesn’t the Commissioner have his own lab?
You know, a proper facility to work in?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I can’t see him doing monster research in that
office, with all that nice furniture.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It appears that darkonium consists of
concentrated dark matter.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, dark matter is generated naturally
by monsters.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That’s what the Commissioner says, anyway,
and there’s still much even he doesn’t know.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Some of the scouts collect monsters and fight
battles even at night.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But I think night-time is for sleeping.
[a8]yawn[a9] Speaking of which...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Not a single scout has reached the goal yet.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] And I’ve spent all this time cleaning the lounge
until it was spick and span!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
THIS MESSAGE HAS BEEN ROBBED BY WHOEVER
STOLE DR. SNAP’S DOCUMENTS. 
[f1][fb][fd]
PLEASE REPORT AS A BUG.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Ahem.
This is the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But, I’m afraid I couldn’t possibly let a stranger
disturb him at the moment.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] It’s a good thing them bandits didn’t make off
with the Scout’s Mark.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] See, the Commissioner anticipated summin’ like
this, and he hid it well away.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] As soon as the first scouts reached the goal,
everyone stopped talking about the robbery.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s no wonder, considering there’s been no
progress in the investigation.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Did you know that some scouts have already
reached the goal?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] They’re relaxing upstairs in the finalists’ lounge.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I know I shouldn’t be hanging around here at this
point in the challenge...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...but with only three darkonium crystals, I don’t
have a prayer of finishing in the top five.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] When your team try to scout a monster, they’re
actually scaring the dark matter out of it.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The less dark matter it has, the more docile it
becomes.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It appears that darkonium consists of
concentrated dark matter.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, dark matter is generated naturally
by monsters.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That’s what the Commissioner says, anyway,
and there’s still much even he doesn’t know.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The scouts in the lounge who’ve reached the
goal are treated like celebrities.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Oooh, it makes me green with envy.
What I wouldn’t give to be in their place!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I know I shouldn’t be hanging around here at this
point in the challenge...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...but with only three darkonium crystals, I don’t
have a prayer of finishing in the top five.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Ahem.
This is the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But, I’m afraid I couldn’t possibly let a stranger
disturb him at the moment.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] All the scouts have to turn in the darkonium
that they collect. It’s one of the rules.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Darkonium is concentrated dark matter.
The Commissioner can use it in his research.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Studying dark matter is a good way to learn
about monsters.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [df][a7][b0] That commissioner is a sly one.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] He uses the challenge as an excuse to get
the scouts to collect research materials for him.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It appears that darkonium consists of
concentrated dark matter.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, dark matter is generated naturally
by monsters.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That’s what the Commissioner says, anyway,
and there’s still much even he doesn’t know.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Ahem.
This is the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But, I’m afraid I couldn’t possibly let a stranger
disturb him at the moment.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, you’re [f5], right?
I saw you when they announced the finalists.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I couldn’t make it past the qualifiers, but a
young lad like yourself is in the finals...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Just goes to show that age doesn’t matter in
this contest. Good luck!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] All the darkonium collected during the challenge
has to be handed over to the MSO.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m sure no one will object.
Darkonium is of no use to anyone.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] The Commissioner had been hard at work in his
office for weeks...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...but the moment he went outside, the thieves
struck.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] It seems rather unlikely it was a coincidence,
if you ask me...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] I saw the finalists in the lounge upstairs.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They’ve finished their final training, and now
they’re taking a breather before the big fight.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The finals are due to start, but you wouldn’t
know it at the battle arena.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Some scouts have completely forgotten about
the challenge and spend all their time there.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] As long as the paying customers keep coming,
the battle arena will stay open.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey there, I’m Slimon.
I’m in the finals, goo...er, I mean ‘too’.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]I don’t know about you, but I can’t wait to get on
with it.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text: [ea]Are you still in training?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]I’m all ready to goo. I’m just killing slime...er, I
mean ‘time’, until the battle starts.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text: [ea]Are you still in training?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]Goo idea...er, I mean, ‘good idea’.
Always be prepared, right?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]You want to put in a good showing, it being the
finals and all.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]You don’t need any more training, eh?
Stronger than you look, are you?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]Well, be gentle with me in the finals then!
Hahaha!

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m Solitaire’s BIGGEST fan, you know.
She inspired me to become a scout.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] That’s why I’m going to beat her and win the
championship!

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m going to be the new scout challenge idol!
Soon, everyone will know the name ‘Missy’!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb]Solitaire’s SO good.
I mean, she finished first in the qualifiers!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb]She’s skilful and clever and good looking...
She’s BRILLIANT!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The drama is about to begin [96] and no one knows
how it will end!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Who will win? Who will fail? The whole of
Green Bays will be glued to the action!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...That reminds me. I saw a man dressed all in
black down by the jetty.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Is he here for the finals too?
There was something very unsavoury about him.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’re the tournament wild card, aren’t you!?
Can’t wait to see what you can do!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The fifth scout rang the bell just as I arrived
here at HQ.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I was so close I could taste it. [a8]sigh[a9]
This is gonna haunt me for years...

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Imagine a young laddie like you makin’ it to the
finals...

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Hmph. The quality of the competition isn’t what
it used to be.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] I caught a gigantes, but he’s awfully stupid.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I sent him to monster storage, but I bet he gets
lost on the way...

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLURRRP.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Ahem.
This is the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But, I’m afraid I couldn’t possibly let a stranger
disturb him at the moment.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, you’re [f5], right?
I saw you when they announced the finalists.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I couldn’t make it past the qualifiers, but a
young lad like yourself is in the finals...

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Just goes to show that age doesn’t matter in
this contest. Good luck!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] All the darkonium collected during the challenge
has to be handed over to the MSO.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m sure no one will object.
Darkonium is of no use to anyone.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] The Commissioner is keeping all the darkonium
the scouts collected.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Can’t imagine why.
What’s he goin’ to do with a big pile of rocks?

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] This quiet period just before the finals is like
the calm before the storm.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] But the sparks will be flying soon, trust me!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The finals are due to start, but you wouldn’t
know it at the battle arena.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Some scouts have completely forgotten about
the challenge and spend all their time there.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] As long as the paying customers keep coming,
the battle arena will stay open.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey there, I’m Slimon.
I’m in the finals, goo...er, I mean ‘too’.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]I’m all ready to goo. I’m just killing slime...er, I
mean ‘time’, until the battle starts.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text: [ea]Are you still in training?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]I’m all ready to goo. I’m just killing slime...er, I
mean ‘time’, until the battle starts.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text: [ea]Are you still in training?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]Goo idea...er, I mean, ‘good idea’.
Always be prepared, right?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]You want to put in a good showing, it being the
finals and all.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]You don’t need any more training, eh?
Stronger than you look, are you?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]Well, be gentle with me in the finals then!
Hahaha!

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] That scout isn’t like the other finalists...

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Seems like she has a real cruel streak in her.
I’d watch out for her if I were you.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’re the tournament wild card, aren’t you!?
Can’t wait to see what you can do!

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I should never have gone to the battle arena in
the first place...

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I was supposed to be one of the five scouts
ringing that bell!

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I can’t believe I blew it!
What a joke...

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] In the old days, there were fewer challengers,
but they really knew how to fight.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Ah, what I wouldn’t give to see battles like
that again!

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]IF THIS MESSAGE IS SHOWN, 
IT MEANS A BUG HAS JUST BEEN FOUND.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Ahem.
This is the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But, I’m afraid I couldn’t possibly let a stranger
disturb him at the moment.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, you’re [f5], right?
I saw you when they announced the finalists.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I couldn’t make it past the qualifiers, but a
young lad like yourself is in the finals...

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Just goes to show that age doesn’t matter in
this contest. Good luck!

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] All the darkonium collected during the challenge
has to be handed over to the MSO.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m sure no one will object.
Darkonium is of no use to anyone.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] The Commissioner had been hard at work in his
office for weeks...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...but the moment he went outside, the thieves
struck.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] It seems rather unlikely it was a coincidence,
if you ask me...

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] I saw the finalists in the lounge upstairs.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They’ve finished their final training, and now
they’re taking a breather before the big fight.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] All the darkonium collected during the challenge
has to be handed over to the MSO.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m sure no one will object.
Darkonium is of no use to anyone.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey there, I’m Slimon.
I’m in the finals, goo...er, I mean ‘too’.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]I don’t know about you, but I can’t wait to get on
with it.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text: [ea]Are you still in training?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]I don’t know about you, but I can’t wait to get on
with it.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text: [ea]Are you still in training?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]Goo idea...er, I mean, ‘good idea’.
Always be prepared, right?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]You want to put in a good showing, it being the
finals and all.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]You don’t need any more training, eh?
Stronger than you look, are you?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]Well, be gentle with me in the finals then!
Hahaha!

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m Solitaire’s BIGGEST fan, you know.
She inspired me to become a scout.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] That’s why I’m going to beat her and win the
championship!

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m going to be the new scout challenge idol!
Soon, everyone will know the name ‘Missy’!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb]Solitaire’s SO good.
I mean, she finished first in the qualifiers!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb]She’s skilful and clever and good looking...
She’s BRILLIANT!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The drama is about to begin [96] and it’s the
worst kind of soap opera!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] A battle of low blows, knives in the back, and
poison in the tea...

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...Yes, it’s business as usual in the finalists’
lounge! Tee hee hee!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’re the tournament wild card, aren’t you!?
Can’t wait to see what you can do!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I should never have gone to the battle arena in
the first place...

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I was supposed to be one of the five scouts
ringing that bell!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I can’t believe I blew it!
What a joke...

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Imagine a young laddie like you makin’ it to the
finals...

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Hmph. The quality of the competition isn’t what
it used to be.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] I caught a gigantes, but he’s awfully stupid.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I sent him to monster storage, but I bet he gets
lost on the way...

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLURRRP.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] A finalist you may be, but I’m afraid I cannot
allow you into the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, [f5].
Bad luck in the finals.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Still, get ’em next time, right?
I’ll be cheering you on!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Ooh, I love it when it takes more than one round
to decide the finals.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] You can bet the Commissioner is happy about
it too. Mark my words!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Now is a good time to visit the other islands and
put in some extra training.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m glad the championship wasn’t decided right
away.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I mean, it’s the Monster Scout Challenge.
It shouldn’t be easy to win.

f020.speaker: Announcer
f020.text:
[ea]If you need more time to train your monsters,
go right ahead.

f020.speaker: Announcer
f020.text:
[ea]I’ve got a killer stand-up routine.
The crowd won’t notice you’ve gone!

f020.speaker: Announcer
f020.text: [ea]So don’t you worry about your fans!

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea]If you’re looking for the scout called Ginny,
she left.

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea]I think she’s training again. Can you believe her?
She REALLY does want to win, huh?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]It doesn’t look like this championship is going to be
decided ickily...er, I mean, ‘quickly’.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text: [ea]Everyone in the finals this year is really good.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb]Isn’t Solitaire AMAZING?
No one can beat her!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [eb]I’m really surprised she hasn’t won already.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [eb]I don’t think I have any chance of beating her...

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] That Rummy girl looks like the front runner.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s something about the way she fights...
She’s in a different league.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You know, I’m actually sort of glad I didn’t
make it to the finals.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s no way I could take those monsters on.
No way.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I would have just embarrassed myself in front
of all the challenge fans.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Imagine a young laddie like you makin’ it to the
finals...

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Hmph. The quality of the competition isn’t what
it used to be.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] I caught a gigantes, but he’s awfully stupid.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I sent him to monster storage, but I bet he gets
lost on the way...

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLURRRP.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] A finalist you may be, but I’m afraid I cannot
allow you into the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The fans are all waiting in the stands, but I say
let ’em wait.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The tension, the anticipation...
They’re all part of the magic of the challenge.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Sometimes, I wonder how many more challenge
finals I’ll get to see.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [df][a7][b0] It’s something I think about a lot these days...

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] To be honest, I wish this challenge was over.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Then everyone here at the MSO could finally
take a holiday.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m glad the championship wasn’t decided right
away.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I mean, it’s the Monster Scout Challenge.
It shouldn’t be easy to win.

f020.speaker: Announcer
f020.text:
[ea]If you need more time to train your monsters,
go right ahead.

f020.speaker: Announcer
f020.text:
[ea]I’ve got a killer stand-up routine.
The crowd won’t notice you’ve gone!

f020.speaker: Announcer
f020.text: [ea]So don’t you worry about your fans!

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea]If you’re looking for the scout called Ginny,
she left.

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea]I think she’s training again. Can you believe her?
She REALLY does want to win, huh?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text: [ea]Everyone here is ready for the next round.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]We’re just waiting on you and Ginny Rummy,
so slurry up...er, I mean ‘hurry up’, okay?

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb][a8]yawn[a9] I’m BORED.
Can we start, please?

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb]Spending all day in this lounge is bad for my
complexion, you know!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] That Rummy girl looks like the front runner.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s something about the way she fights...
She’s in a different league.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You know, I’m actually sort of glad I didn’t
make it to the finals.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s no way I could take those monsters on.
No way.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I would have just embarrassed myself in front
of all the challenge fans.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] In the old days, there were fewer challengers,
but they really knew how to fight.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Ah, what I wouldn’t give to see battles like
that again!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea]IF THIS MESSAGE IS SHOWN, 
IT MEANS A BUG HAS JUST BEEN FOUND.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Wow, [f5]!
You want to talk to me?

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] This is SO amazing!
I’m your biggest fan!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Ah, if it isn’t the champion!
I saw your battle, young man.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Off to collect your prize, are you?
What a fine prize it is!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Ah, hello, [f5].
Leaving us already?

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Don’t forget to go to the Commissioner’s office
first to collect your prize.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Commissioner told me not to let you leave
until you did.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The MSO has a big issue to discuss at the next
general meeting.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That is, how do we spread the popularity of
the Monster Scout Challenge beyond these islands?

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Commissioner told me to expect you.
Please, do go in.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Commissioner is waiting.
Please don’t delay any longer.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]Wow. I never thought I’d lose to someone so
inexperienced...

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]What I mean is, you’re really good!
You’ve got serious talent...

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]I should never have underes-slime-ated goo...er,
I mean ‘underestimated you’!

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [eb]Don’t get all big-headed just because you won.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb]You’d NEVER have won if you’d actually had to
fight Solitaire.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text: [eb]I can’t believe she was disqualified.

f020.speaker: Missy
f020.text:
[eb]Oh, poor Solitaire!
It’s SO unfair!

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea]Wow, you’re a lot tougher than you look. Just goes
to show that appearances CAN be deceiving...

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea]...Okay, confession time.
The truth is, I really AM a weartiger.

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea]I’ve been looking for a strong scout to team up
with...and...well, er, can I join you?

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea]Yeah? Thanks so much!
You won’t reGRRRet this!

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea]Huh!? Your monster storage is full!
You have to make some space!

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea]GRRR...Er, I mean, I was just joking, you know!
You didn’t actually BELIEVE me, did you?

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] This is the first win by disqualification in the
history of the challenge.

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]shrug[a9] But you have to be a winner to have
winner’s luck, right?

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You deserved the prize.
Don’t let anyone tell you otherwise.

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] To take the title is amazing in itself, but
against those monsters... Wow.

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text: [df][a7][b0] I have to admit, you young ’uns aren’t half bad.

f020.speaker: Tryger
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] In terms of excitement, these finals ranked with
the best of ’em!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Ahem, are you going to tell me what’s going on?
HELLOOO! Can you HEAR me?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb]Hmph! Are you sulking AGAIN?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]You only won the stupid championship because I let
you, you know.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Oh, it’s you.
What do you want?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Are you looking for the Commissioner?
Well, guess what?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]You’re looking at her!
That’s right, say hello to Commissioner Solitaire!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Hehe...just kidding.
Old Snap hasn’t come back yet.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb]The Commissioner hasn’t come back yet, obviously.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]But forget about HIM.
Tell me what’s happening.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Fine, fine.
Don’t tell me then. See if I care.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Wow, [f5]!
You want to talk to me?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] This is SO amazing!
I’m your biggest fan!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Have you collected your prize yet?
Will you show it to me?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] I’m not long for this world, see, and it would
make an old man very happy.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] Commissioner Snap left with a monster.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It looked a lot like the one you had before.
Did you give it to him?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Actually, it was a different colour, now that
I think about it.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] Are you looking for the Commissioner too?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] The fact is, we’ve all been looking for him.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] We really need him here at HQ, just in case
something happens.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The MSO has a big issue to discuss at the next
general meeting.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That is, how do we spread the popularity of
the Monster Scout Challenge beyond these islands?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] As soon as the Commissioner departed, Solitaire
insisted that she be allowed into his office.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m afraid I find it rather difficult to refuse a
lady of such charms.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] Oh dear, I’m not much of a receptionist, am I?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We didn’t get to see much of a grand finale,
did we? It was over so fast...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The top scouts are so efficient that the battles
only seem to last an instant.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I was wondering[b0] what will they do with all the
darkonium the scouts collected?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s a lot to store...unless they crushed it all
together or something?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But don’t you think that would also concentrate
the power of the dark matter?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That would be something scary...
I hope the Commissioner knows what he’s doing.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I saw the Commissioner with a monster I haven’t
seen before, so I asked him about it.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He was awfully pleased with himself.
Said it was a really, really rare breed.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He told me he was looking for some treasure or
something, but I had no idea what he meant.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You know that flying black monster everyone is
talking about in town?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Well, the more I hear about it, the more I think
it’s the same beastie the Commissioner had.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Maybe it escaped during one of the
Commissioner’s bouts of absent-mindedness.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [df][a7][b0] I have to admit, you young ’uns aren’t half bad.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] In terms of excitement, these finals ranked with
the best of ’em!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [df][a7][b0] Hmph! Snap STILL hasn’t come back, you know!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] I wanted to have a word with him about the
next challenge, I did.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]Wow. I never thought I’d lose to someone so
inexperienced...

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]What I mean is, you’re really good!
You’ve got serious talent...

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]I should never have underes-slime-ated goo...er,
I mean ‘underestimated you’!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Ahem, are you going to tell me what’s going on?
HELLOOO! Can you HEAR me?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb]Hmph! Are you sulking AGAIN?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]You only won the stupid championship because I let
you, you know.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Oh, it’s you.
What do you want?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Are you looking for the Commissioner?
Well, guess what?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]You’re looking at her!
That’s right, say hello to Commissioner Solitaire!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Hehe...just kidding.
Old Snap hasn’t come back yet.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb]The Commissioner hasn’t come back yet, obviously.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]But forget about HIM.
Tell me what’s happening.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Fine, fine.
Don’t tell me then. See if I care.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s a shame we didn’t get to see a battle
between you and Solitaire.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] A fight between you two would have been
something special!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] Commissioner Snap left with a monster.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It looked a lot like the one you had before.
Did you give it to him?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Actually, it was a different colour, now that
I think about it.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] Are you looking for the Commissioner too?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] The fact is, we’ve all been looking for him.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] We really need him here at HQ, just in case
something happens.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] After the challenge, all the staff were
supposed to have a holiday.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But with the Commissioner gone, we all have to
stay on duty until further notice.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] As soon as the Commissioner departed, Solitaire
insisted that she be allowed into his office.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m afraid I find it rather difficult to refuse a
lady of such charms.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] Oh dear, I’m not much of a receptionist, am I?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We didn’t get to see much of a grand finale,
did we? It was over so fast...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The top scouts are so efficient that the battles
only seem to last an instant.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I was wondering[b0] what will they do with all the
darkonium the scouts collected?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s a lot to store...unless they crushed it all
together or something?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But don’t you think that would also concentrate
the power of the dark matter?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That would be something scary...
I hope the Commissioner knows what he’s doing.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I saw the Commissioner with a monster I haven’t
seen before, so I asked him about it.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He was awfully pleased with himself.
Said it was a really, really rare breed.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He told me he was looking for some treasure or
something, but I had no idea what he meant.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You know that flying black monster everyone is
talking about in town?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Well, the more I hear about it, the more I think
it’s the same beastie the Commissioner had.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Maybe it escaped during one of the
Commissioner’s bouts of absent-mindedness.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [df][a7][b0] I have to admit, you young ’uns aren’t half bad.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] In terms of excitement, these finals ranked with
the best of ’em!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Ooh, that Snap rotter!
It looks like he’s not coming back tonight.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] How dare he keep an old man waiting past his
bedtime...and for nothin’!

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]Wow. I never thought I’d lose to someone so
inexperienced...

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]What I mean is, you’re really good!
You’ve got serious talent...

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]I should never have underes-slime-ated goo...er,
I mean ‘underestimated you’!

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea]IF THIS MESSAGE IS SHOWN, 
IT MEANS A BUG HAS JUST BEEN FOUND.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I heard the Commissioner went to investigate the
disaster on Infern Isle.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I hope he doesn’t take any chances.
If something were to happen...

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Yes, I’m worried about him too.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But our priority right now is to evacuate the
residents of Infern Isle!

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Wow, [f5]!
You want to talk to me?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] This is SO amazing!
I’m your biggest fan!

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Oh, you know Snap. He’ll come back whenever
he feels like it, without a scratch.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I keep wondering, why did the Commissioner want
the scouts’ darkonium?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] And where did he put it all?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’ve come to suspect that he has a laboratory
somewhere in town... But where?

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It certainly isn’t here in HQ.
I would have found it by now.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Solitaire lady has made herself rather
comfortable in the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I suppose I should ask her to leave, but she is
somewhat...stubborn.

f020.speaker: Slimon
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m afraid I’m not very good around such
forceful women.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Oh, this chair is to DIE for! Soft yet supportive,
handsome yet approachable [96][f1][fb][fd]
It’s like sitting on my dream man!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Kicking back in your very own office is one of the
perks of being commissioner.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Ah, if I had won the finals, this chair would’ve
been mine.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Fancy not having a commissioner at a time like this!
Ridiculous! The MSO was falling apart.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]Well, I had to put my foot down. Someone needed
to whip this place back into shape.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb]I suppose I’m the de facto commissioner now.
What can I say?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] In the end, nothing interesting happened in
the lounge. Nothing at all!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] No conspiracies, no murderous glances, no poison
in the tea...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...and nobody got stabbed in the back.
Not even with a dessert fork. BOR-ing!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I heard the Commissioner went to investigate the
disaster on Infern Isle.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I hope he doesn’t take any chances.
If something were to happen...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Yes, I’m worried about him too.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But our priority right now is to evacuate the
residents of Infern Isle!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] Please don’t go near that Infern Isle place.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Something terrible is happening.
The whole island is being transformed.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We’re not actually banning anyone from going,
but it really is too dangerous.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] Do you think Snap might have been caught up in
that disaster on Infern Isle?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] No, no, what am I thinking?
My imagination is getting the better of me.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Everyone is all in a flap, but I’m a scientist.
I don’t get into flaps.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Though I do of COURSE care about the
Commissioner’s welfare.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’ve come to suspect that he has a laboratory
somewhere in town... But where?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It certainly isn’t here in HQ.
I would have found it by now.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Solitaire lady has made herself rather
comfortable in the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Solitaire

[ea][a7][b0] I suppose I should ask her to leave, but she is
somewhat...stubborn.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m afraid I’m not very good around such
forceful women.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] If you tell him you’re on an errand for Solitaire,
he’ll let you in.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I don’t get to see the Commissioner’s office very
often. It’s a nice change.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea]IF THIS MESSAGE IS SHOWN, 
IT MEANS A BUG HAS JUST BEEN FOUND.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Commissioner is expecting you.
Please go straight in.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, champ.
Glad to see you’re still in one piece!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I was worried about you.
Someone told me you’d gone to Infern Isle.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] The Commissioner left without a word of
explanation.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[df][a7][b0] The fact that no one knows why just shows
how little we really know about him.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I finally worked out why Commissioner Snap
wanted all that darkonium.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He needed it to stop the disaster on Infern Isle
from spreading.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] As far as I’m concerned, Dr Snap will always
be our true leader!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I won’t accept this new commissioner.
Money can’t buy everything, you know.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, champ.
Have you met the new commissioner yet?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That appointment came as a bit of a shock,
I can tell you. No one expected it.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I mean, she couldn’t be any more different from
her predecessor if she tried!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]shrug[a9] Politics, eh?
Best not to think about it...

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m hoping there’ll be some dirty dealings in the
finalists’ lounge during the NEXT challenge.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] I’m going to keep on working here until then.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m from Infern Isle.
I fled here when the disaster happened.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But I’m sure it’s all over now.
Maybe it’s time I went home?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You’re [f5], right?
The scout challenge champion?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The new commissioner wants to see you.
Please proceed to the office.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Commissioner is expecting you.
Please go straight in.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [ea][a7][b0] Commissioner Snap was a great man.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He had the scouts collect darkonium just so he
could save us from the catastrophe.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I mean, we all knew he had our best interests at
heart, but who knew he could see into the future!?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text: [eb][a7][b0] I’m going to keep on working here until then.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Is it true what they say? Did the former
commissioner save us from the catastrophe?

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I actually saw him shortly before the disaster
occurred.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] He had this nasty-looking black monster at his
side. Just thinking about it makes me shiver!

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea]IF THIS MESSAGE IS SHOWN, 
IT MEANS A BUG HAS JUST BEEN FOUND.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I had the utmost respect for the former
commissioner.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] As for the present commissioner...well, one must

f020.speaker: Solitaire

[eb]Are you still here? Go on, SHOO!
Go and pay your respects on Infant Isle.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[eb][a7][b0] And by the time you get back, I’ll have a brand
new challenge ready to go!

f020.speaker: Solitaire

[ea]IF THIS MESSAGE IS SHOWN,

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It turns out that the new commissioner has all
sorts of exciting plans for the future of the MSO.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It was something of a revelation.
Clearly, I had underestimated her.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And so I have decided to devote myself wholly
to the service of our new commissioner.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You need no permission, sir. You are always
welcome at the Commissioner’s office.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] No one ever thought of including the battle
arena and proficiency tests in the challenge.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But the new Commissioner did.
Seems there’s more to her than meets the eye.

f020.speaker: Solitaire
f020.text:

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [ea][a8]slobber[a9] GRRRRRR. ME HUNGRY.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I bet you’ve got lots of girlfriends, being in the
finals and all.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I could never be that popular.
Not in a thousand years.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I wish someone would open a matchmaking
service for scouts...

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Mr Wuffles won’t accept any monster less
than Rank A [96] though we’d much prefer Rank S.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [eb][a7][b0] But the matchmaking centre is hopeless.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We’ve been here FOREVER and they haven’t
found a single suitable partner.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We refuse to compromise.
Mr Wuffles is VERY particular.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [ea][a8]drool[a9] GRRRAWN. ME SLEEPY.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, champ. I bet you have all the girlfriends
a guy could want, eh?

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Aaah, I’d give anything to be in your shoes.
Anything!

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I wish someone would open a matchmaking
service for scouts...

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You seem to have some interesting monsters with
you.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I wonder if one of them would be a good match
for Mr Wuffles?

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But if we did bring them together, I would have
to say bye-bye to Mr Wuffles.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [eb][a7][b0] ...NO! I couldn’t bear to part with him!

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I should never have brought him here in
the first place...

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [eb][a7][b0] I couldn’t possibly live without my Mr Wuffles.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [ea]URRRGH. ME HAVE ACCIDENT.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [ea][a7][b0] Yeah, well...actually, we’re going on a date.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] We’re both here all the time, see, and I started
to notice how pretty she was.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So I plucked up my courage and asked her out.
And she said yes!

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [ea][a7][b0] She’s a scout too, so we have lots in common.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Fancy meeting a man here in Monster
Matchmaking!

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] And it’s all thanks to Mr Wuffles.
He’s my own personal cupid.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [ea][a8]dribble[a9] ME WANT GO HOME.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We’re planning to open a Monster Matchmaking
service on this floor.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [eb][a7][b0] But we’re a little bit behind schedule.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m so sorry about this.
But do come back when we’re open!

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Welcome to Monster Matchmaking, where monsters
come together.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We offer an introduction service for monsters
that belong to different scouts.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Remember that you will lose the monster you
offer for matchmaking.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But in return, the brand new monster resulting
from the match will be yours.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] If you’re having problems synthesising powerful
monsters, we can help.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Welcome to Lethal Weapons, the best armoury on
the island.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Welcome to Skilful Scribblings, the shop of
choice for skill scroll lovers.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Skill scrolls are magical manuscripts that allow
you to teach your monsters new skills instantly.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [ea][a7][b0] I accept monsters in exchange for my scrolls.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But not just any monster, you understand.
It takes certain kinds...

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If you want a good scroll, you’ve got to give
me something worth my while.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So, what d’you say?
Feel like trading something?

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Welcome to Skilful Scribblings, the shop of
choice for skill scroll lovers.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If you see a skill scroll you fancy, let’s make
a deal, okay?

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Welcome to Skilful Scribblings, the shop of
choice for skill scroll lovers.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Sorry, son. I’m waiting on new stock.
Come back later.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Welcome to Backpackers, your one-stop item
shop.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [eb][a7][b0] Welcome to Monster Matchmaking!

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We’re here to help scouts find the perfect
synthesis partner for their monstrous companions.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We’re the cupids that make monster romance
a reality! [a0]

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We understand that every monster has his or
her own likes and dislikes.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s our job to find the ideal monster match, so
let us take the confusion out of monster fusion! [a0]

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [eb][a7][b0] Welcome to Monster Matchmaking!

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Go on, don’t be shy.
Select a partner from the list. [a0]

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [eb][a7][b0] Welcome to Monster Matchmaking!

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Thank you for coming, but we don’t have any
suitable matches at the moment.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m sure we’ll have some wonderful candidates
for you to choose from when you next visit! [a0]

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [ea]WELCOME TO THE GOLD BANK ATM.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Thank you.
Please come again!

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Cheers, mate.
Come again soon.

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Thank you very much.
Do come again soon!

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text: [eb][a7][b0] See you later! [a0]

f030.speaker: Mr Wuffles
f030.text:
[ea]WE ARE OPEN 24 HOURS A DAY.
PLEASE COME AGAIN.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]I am Dr Snap’s great arch-rival, Igor Folds!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]I am vorking on a great invention zat vill make
ze scout ring look like a baby’s toy.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Ven ze public sees my creation, ze vorld vill
never be ze same again!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]My name is Igor Folds...but YOU can call me Igor!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I wouldn’t take the old geezer who lives
downstairs too seriously, if I were you.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He’s convinced himself that he’s Dr Snap’s great
rival, but he’s the only one who thinks so.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] He hasn’t invented a single thing in his life.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] What do you think you’re doing!?
This is a private house, I’ll have you know!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hmph.
You challenge scouts think you own the place!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] My daughter wants to become a scout in the
monster challenge.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But my husband is dead set against it.
He says it’s too dangerous.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hey, mister!
You’re competing in the challenge, right?

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] When I grow up, I’m going to be a scout too.
See, I already have a monster!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] Glup, glop, guloop!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]I am Dr Snap’s great arch-rival, Igor Folds!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]I am vorking on a great invention zat vill make
ze scout ring look like a baby’s toy.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Ven ze public sees my creation, ze vorld vill
never be ze same again!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]My name is Igor Folds...but YOU can call me Igor!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I spend the day competing in the challenge, but
in the evenings I like to relax at home.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That’s just the way I live my life, and I’m not
about to change!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLUUURP...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The girl across the way asked me to look after
her slime for her.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, her parents don’t want her keeping
monsters.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea]IF THIS MESSAGE IS SHOWN, 
IT MEANS A BUG HAS JUST BEEN FOUND.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Mummy, Mummy!
It’s a monster!

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea]Hi, I’m Tryger! I’m really into dressing up like
monsters. Pretty realistic, huh?

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea]Maybe a bit TOO realistic for the little girl’s
liking... She still hasn’t calmed down.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea]I’m looking to rent a room.
Have you seen the landlord?

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That Igor Folds really gets on my nerves.
What’s he blabbering on about this time?

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]I am Dr Snap’s great arch-rival, Igor Folds!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]I am vorking on a great invention zat vill make
ze scout ring look like a baby’s toy.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Ven ze public sees my creation, ze vorld vill
never be ze same again!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]My name is Igor Folds...but YOU can call me Igor!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Scouts are always on the road, never able to
put down roots. There’s no future in it.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I won’t allow my daughter to live the life of
a wandering vagabond!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] My daughter wants to become a scout in the
monster challenge.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But my husband is dead set against it.
He says it’s too dangerous.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] My slime ran away.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The training may have been a bit tough, but it
was for his own good...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hey, guess what!
I went to see Uncle Snap, the Commissioner!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But when I asked him for a battle, he said he
was too busy...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]...You are not ze number von, Snap... Ze number
von is me...Igor...Folds...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]Zzz...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hahaha! Tryger and I hit it off straight away.
It was like we’d known each other all our lives.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So we’ve decided to share a room to save on
rent.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea]The landlord doesn’t seem to like monsters very
much.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text: [ea]Maybe I should get out of this costume for a while.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text: [ea]But it’s such an important part of who I am.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The girl across the way asked me to look after
her slime for her.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] But now she says she wants a gigantes too.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m not sure if I’d want one of them stomping
around my room at night.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLUUURP...

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]I am ze great Igor Folds, arch-rival of Dr Snap!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]My great invention is ready at last! It vill make
ze vorld forget about ze stupid scout ring!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Do you vant to know vat it is?
Ja, ja, of course you do!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Very vell. I vill share zis magnificent invention
vith you, my friend.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [d0]1[f5] receives an antidotal herb!!!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]You eat zis grass and it cures ze poison, see?

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]Ah, you are speechless vith amazement, ja?

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]I am ze great Igor Folds, arch-rival of Dr Snap!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Remember zis name, for soon it vill reverberate
around ze vorld!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]My name is Igor Folds...but YOU can call me Igor!

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea]Hi, I’m Tryger! I’m really into dressing up like
monsters. Pretty realistic, huh?

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea]The girl who saw me earlier kept crying and
crying, and I didn’t know what to do.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text: [ea]Where did the landlord get to?

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] When I first saw the tiger I was really scared,
but then he talked to me and he was really nice.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] My slime ran away again.
But I wasn’t THAT strict with him...

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Maybe he thinks playing hide-and-seek is part
of his training?

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Don’t believe a word that geezer downstairs
tells you. He’s just a crazy old man.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He’s convinced himself that he’s Dr Snap’s great
rival, but he’s the only one who thinks so.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He claims the most common items as his own
inventions.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I wanted my daughter to learn how scary
monsters really are...

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But instead, she’s more interested than ever
before. [a8]sigh[a9]

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] My husband’s attempt to scare our daughter
had the opposite effect.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It looks like she has her heart set on being a
scout, no matter what we say.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]My name is Igor Folds...but YOU can call me Igor!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] Tryger and I are getting on famously.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] As fellow scouts, we have lots in common.
He’s the perfect room-mate.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea]I wait until the landlord is fast asleep before
sneaking back in.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text: [ea]You see, he really doesn’t like monsters...

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea]Of course, I’m not REALLY a monster.
I’m just dressed like one.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The girl across the way is trying to catch a
gigantes.

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] I really hope she doesn’t find one...

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ’Cause if she does, guess who’ll have to look
after it. I had a hard enough time with her slime!

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLUUURP...

f040.speaker: Tryger
f040.text:
REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I liked him.
I wonder where he went?

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea]There was a monster in the building the other day.
I couldn’t believe my eyes!

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text: [ea]’Course, I kicked it out the instant I saw it.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text: [ea]Huh? What kind was it?

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text: [ea]Er, I think it was one of those weartiger things.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea]There was a WEARTIGER in the building the other
day, would you believe! I certainly couldn’t!

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text: [ea]’Course, I kicked it out the instant I saw it.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] My slime ran away AGAIN!
And we were right in the middle of training...

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s as if he doesn’t want to BE in the scout
challenge! But I know he could do well if he TRIED!

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Don’t believe a word that geezer downstairs
tells you. He’s just a crazy old man.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He’s convinced himself that he’s Dr Snap’s great
rival, but he’s the only one who thinks so.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He claims the most common items as his own
inventions.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] My daughter keeps pestering me to take her to
the challenge finals.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I can’t tell you how much I hate that stupid
contest.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s putting all sorts of crazy ideas into her
head.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] My husband once competed in the challenge
himself, you know.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] That was back before our daughter was born.

f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] Tryger was kicked out by the landlord.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] It’s a shame. He was a grrreat guy...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I did become rather fond of that little slime I
was looking after.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He was cute, in a blubbery sort of way...
But I doubt anyone could find a gigantes ‘cute’!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLUUURP...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea]Go on, shoo! Out, out, out! I don’t want you
making a mess in my nice clean lodging-house!

f040.speaker: Gigantes
f040.text:
[ea]Aw, you not nice.
You big bully.

f040.speaker: Gigantes
f040.text:
[ea]Master said go to monster storage.
So I go.

f040.speaker: Gigantes
f040.text: [ea]But then I meet angry man. HMPH!

[df]Zis is a kind of really special vater zat is

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] What’s Folds up to this time? That banging and
clattering hasn’t stopped for AGES!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And when it’s not banging, it’s sizzling!
...Do you think he’s working on a new invention?

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] For every 100 scouts, only one makes it to the
big time. Those are harsh odds.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Why does my daughter want to be part of such
a world?

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] It’s no wonder she wants to become a scout.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] She’s been watching the scout challenges ever
since she learnt to walk.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text: [ea]Hm? [a8]sniff sniff[a9]

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea]I smell something rotten...
Where is it coming from?

f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] Chuck and I hit it off right away.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So we’ve decided to share a room to save on
rent.

f040.speaker: Chuck
f040.text: [ea]I may not lookkks it, but I’m a ssscout.

f040.speaker: Chuck
f040.text:
[ea]Becaussse of the wwway I look, sommmetimes
people missstake me for a rotting corrrpse.

f040.speaker: Chuck
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] First, the girl across the way asked me to look
after her slime...

f040.speaker: Chuck
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Now she’s got me babysitting a gigantes! What
does she think I am, a monster storage facility?

f040.speaker: Chuck
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLUUURP...

f040.speaker: Gigantes
f040.text:
[ea]Here no bed.
Me sleep on floor?

f040.speaker: Gigantes
f040.text:
REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

f040.speaker: Gigantes
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Mummy and daddy have gone out, and I’m
BORED.

f040.speaker: Gigantes
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] I wish the tiger man would come and visit again.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]I am Dr Snap’s great arch-rival, Igor Folds!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Vat is all zis racket?
Is it ze challenge finals again?

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Bah! Zat Snap is a fool! Vill he never grow tired
of zese games for ze children!?

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]But zis is my chance! While he is busy, I can build
my amazing invention, and beat him at last!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]I am Dr Snap’s great arch-rival, Igor Folds!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Remember zis name, for soon it vill reverberate
around ze vorld!

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea]More and more people are wandering in here with
monsters in tow.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea]Walking corpses, gigantes... Don’t they know
monsters AREN’T ALLOWED in this lodging-house!?

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I wouldn’t take the old geezer who lives
downstairs too seriously, if I were you.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He just keeps tellin’ fibs so he can get more
attention.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] The finals were fairly exciting, I must admit...

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...but that still doesn’t mean I’m going to allow
my daughter to become a scout.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] My husband cried when he watched the finals.
He couldn’t help himself.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Of course, he tried to deny it. He can be so
silly at times. I KNOW he really misses scouting.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]I am Dr Snap’s great arch-rival, Igor Folds!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Vat is all zis racket?
Is it ze challenge finals again?

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Bah! Zat Snap is a fool! Vill he never grow tired

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
