f040.text:
[df]Remember zis name, for soon it vill reverberate
around ze vorld!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] My room-mate Chuck was kicked out by the
landlord.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] I mean, yeah, he smelled a bit...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...but that’s hardly a good reason to kick
someone out onto the streets.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLUUURP...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The landlord spotted the gigantes and kicked
him out.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] I feel bad for the little girl across the way.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea]How many times do I have to tell people?
No monsters allowed!

f040.speaker: Gigantes
f040.text: [ea]Me bring storyteller friend.

f040.speaker: Gigantes
f040.text:
[ea]Maybe he appeal to landlord’s heart.
Maybe make landlord be nice to me.

f040.speaker: Gigantes
f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] Me bring storyteller friend.

f040.speaker: Gigantes
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Maybe he appeal to landlord’s heart.
Maybe make landlord be nice to me.

f040.speaker: Gigantes
f040.text:
[ea][a8]sniffle[a9] The story too sad...
[a8]sob[a9] Me can’t stop [a8]SOB[a9] crying! BOOHOO HOOOOO!

f040.speaker: Puppeteer
f040.text:
[ea]‘We will be together in the next world, my love’,
whispered Golemette with a soft sigh.

f040.speaker: Puppeteer
f040.text:
[ea]And then Drackeo and Golemette leapt
hand-in-hand into the stormy ocean far below.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea]What? So they just die in the end?
What kind of story is that?

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
The landlord failed to respond to the puppeteer’s
sad tale.

f040.speaker: Puppeteer
f040.text:
[ea]‘Enough! All monsters, out!’ screamed the hysterical
landlord, frothing at the mouth.

f040.speaker: Puppeteer
f040.text:
[ea]...And so the poor gigantes was left to die, cold
and hungry, alone on the streets.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text: [ea]Er, are you trying to tell me something?

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
The landlord failed to respond to the puppeteer’s
sad tale.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Daddy said I’m not allowed to go out into the
hallway.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] He said there were monsters around and it was
too dangerous for me.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Daddy said that if the monsters start stomping
around, the building might collapse.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]I am ze great Igor Folds, arch-rival of Dr Snap!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Every day I am vorking on a new invention.
Soon I vill leave Snap in ze dust, ja?

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Vat invention, you ask?
Ah, you vill see ven ze time is right.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]No doubt ze department store vill be selling it,
so all you vill need to do is join ze queue.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [df]I am Dr Snap’s great arch-rival, Igor Folds!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]I am about to invent a sing zat vill blow ze socks
off ze feet of Snap.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Some day soon, zis invention vill be on sale at ze
department store.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] That gigantes bloke doesn’t give up easily...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But there’s no way he’s goin’ to change the
landlord’s mind. No way at all.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I do feel sorry for him, but it was a bit of a
relief when he left, to be honest.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] The finals were fairly exciting, I must admit...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...but that still doesn’t mean I’m going to allow
my daughter to become a scout.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] My husband used to be a scout when he was
younger.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] He knows how hard it is. He doesn’t want our
daughter to go through the same thing.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Night-time is ze most productive time for a genius
like Igor Folds!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]And I do lots of sinking on ze toilet.
In ze old days, we have no flusher...

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]...and no plumbing! It’s much better zese days.
I love ze heated seats. Zey make me more creative!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You know that travelling storyteller, the
puppeteer? He’s my new room-mate.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He’s been EVERYWHERE [96] you wouldn’t believe
how many great stories he has.

f040.speaker: Puppeteer
f040.text:
[ea]My dear friend the gigantes asked me to help him
with the landlord...

f040.speaker: Puppeteer
f040.text:
[ea]But it’s not easy to show a monsterphobe the
error of his ways.

f040.speaker: Puppeteer
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, the gigantes is comin’ back tomorrow
to plead his case.

f040.speaker: Puppeteer
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I honestly don’t know why he bothers.
He’ll just be shooed away again.

f040.speaker: Puppeteer
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I wonder where’s he’s spending the nights in
the meantime?

f040.speaker: Puppeteer
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLUUURP...

f040.speaker: Puppeteer
f040.text:
REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

f040.speaker: Puppeteer
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Mummy and daddy have gone out, and I’m
BORED.

f040.speaker: Puppeteer
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I wish something INTERESTING would
happen around here.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]If you’re here to see my latest invention, you might
as vell go home. I quit!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Zat senile old fool ran avay.
Who knows vere he is now?

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Every time I manage to find a room-mate, the
landlord boots him out.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I mean, Tryger was a challenge finalist!
Why couldn’t he have stayed?

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea]More and more people are wandering in here with
monsters in tow.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea]Walking corpses, gigantes... It’s ridiculous! This is
supposed to be a monster-free lodging-house!

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Recently, I’ve seen old Igor sneakin’ out in the
middle of the night.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I wonder if the shock of losing his ‘great rival’
has driven him over the edge.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I heard that the previous commissioner gave his
life to avert the disaster.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They say he used the darkonium the scouts
collected to save us somehow...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] I never thought he was capable of such heroism.
And maybe I was wrong about the challenge too...

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I knew my husband would change his mind about
the challenge...

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLUUURP...

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text: [ea][a7][b0] I wish Igor would turn back into his old self.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It makes me miserable, seeing him moping around
like that.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Mummy and daddy have gone out, and I’m
BORED.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I wish something INTERESTING would
happen around here.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]If you’re here to see my latest invention, you might
as vell go home. I quit!

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[df]Zat senile old fool ran avay.
Who knows vere he is now?

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Every time I manage to find a room-mate, the
landlord boots him out.

f040.speaker: Igor Folds
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I mean, Tryger was a challenge finalist!
Why couldn’t he have stayed?

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea]More and more people are wandering in here with
monsters in tow.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea]Walking corpses, gigantes... It’s ridiculous! This is
supposed to be a monster-free lodging-house!

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You know, old Igor hasn’t been in his room for a
while now.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I suppose it’s good he’s getting some fresh air
for a change.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I heard that the previous commissioner gave his
life to avert the disaster.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They say he used the darkonium the scouts
collected to save us somehow...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] I never thought he was capable of such heroism.
And maybe I was wrong about the challenge too...

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I knew my husband would change his mind about
the challenge...

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLUUURP...

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You know, old Igor hasn’t been in his room for a
while now.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I suppose it’s good he’s getting some fresh air
for a change.

f040.speaker: Landlord
f040.text:
REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text: [ea]I used to be a lovely ochre colour.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea]But I owe money to some very unpleasant
gangsters, and I’ve turned blue with the stress.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea]People just assume I’m a run-of-the-mill
healslime, but they’re quite wrong.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Don’t listen to ’im.
’E’s just a big fibber.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text: [ea][a7][b0] There ain’t no such thing as a mega ’ealslime.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You lookin’ for Rapheal? Cos ’e ain’t ’ere.
Said ’e ’ad to take part in the challenge.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ’E don’t look it, but ’e’s actually a scout like
you.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea]Didn’t I tell you?
I’m competing in the challenge myself.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea]Winning the championship is the only way I can pay
off my debts.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It don’t make no sense!
’Ow can a monster be a scout at the same time?

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Not to mention ’e’s in the challenge!
Wot was the MSO thinkin’?

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Wot d’yer reckon? Think Rapheal ’as a chance
o’ makin’ it to the finals?

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ’E’s the local boy, see.
I ’ope ’e does well.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea]My plan failed. I had hoped to pay off my debts
by winning the championship.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text: [ea]Looks like my only chance now is to flee overseas.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It don’t make no sense!
’Ow can a monster be a scout at the same time?

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Not to mention ’e were in the
challenge! Wot was the MSO thinkin’?

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Poor ol’ Rapheal looked so down.
I told ’im to try again next challenge...

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But with all the interest ’e owes, ’is debts jus’
keep gettin’ bigger an’ bigger.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea]My plan failed. I had hoped to pay off my debts
by winning the championship.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text: [ea]Looks like my only chance now is to flee overseas.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea]I’m not a regular healslime, I tell you!
I’m a mega healslime!

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Why did the loan sharks lend ’im the dough
in the first place? That’s wot I wanna know.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Maybe it’s cos yer don’t get many talkin’
’ealslimes?

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Yeah. They prob’ly thought they’d jus’ sell
’im to a collector if ’e couldn’t pay up.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea]Zzz...oh, no, I lost again!
If I don’t win this next hand...zzz...

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea]WAH! [a8]gasp pant[a9] Gracious me.
What a horrible dream!

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ’Ow did ol’ Rapheal get ’imself into debt in the
first place?

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I ain’t never ’eard o’ monsters ’avin’ money
troubles before.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text: [ea]I’m going to enter Solitaire’s Challenge and win it!

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea]Then I can pay off my debts and turn my life
around!

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ’E ain’t much, but when it comes to scoutin’,
Rapheal’s the local ’ero.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I ’ope ’e wins a few battles an’ pays ’is debts
off.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text: [ea][a7][b0] MEEEEEGAHEALSLIIIME!

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Phew. No one would take ’im off me ’ands.
I owes yer one, mate.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text: [d0]1[f5] obtains a yabby.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Right. Tonight I’m gonna dream about grilled
lobster!

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text: [d0]1[f5] obtains an octavian sentry.

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Right. Tonight I’m gonna dream about fried
octopus!

f060.speaker: Rapheal
f060.text: [eb][a7][b0] Look after me mum, okay?

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df]Snap is dead, but his inventions are still used ze
world over.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df]If I invent something even better, zen I, Igor Folds,
vill be ze vinner!

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df]My only regret is zat he vill never know. I vould
have loved to see ze look on his face ven he lost!

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df]Snap and I vorked side by side in zis laboratory
for many long years.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df]Zen von day he kicked me out onto ze streets
without any varning!

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df]Since zen, I am sinking of nothing but exacting
revenge on ze man who betrayed Igor Folds!

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text: [df][a7][b0] uuuUUURGH...

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df][a7][b0] Thou who darest waken me...
...I have waited long for thee.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df][a7][b0] I was born of the fiery flames in the ancient
depths of the underworld known as Nadiria.
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] My destiny is to evolve beyond Lord of the
Underworld and Emperor of Monsterkind!

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df][a7][b0] I bow to none excepting he that can defeat me
through force of arms.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df][a7][b0] Now, human.
Dost thou seek a battle with me?

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df][a7][b0] uuuUUURGH... Thou who darest waken me...
...I have waited long for thee.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds

f070.speaker: Igor Folds

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df][a7][b0] Nay, I refuse. Thou hast no room for one such
as I in thy monster storage.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df][a7][b0] Prepare thy monster storage first.
Then we shall duel.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df][a7][b0] Then begone with thee. I shall sleep until a real
champion dares face me.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘I discovered the legendary Mark completely by
accident.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘Who would have imagined I’d find such a treasure
amongst Igor Folds’ accumulated rubbish!?

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘I might not even have recognised it but for the
strange light it gave off.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘I took the Mark from Folds, and banished the senile
fool from my laboratory.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘It meant losing my research partner of many years,
but I did what I had to do.’

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text: These look like Dr Snap’s notes.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘According to legend, the Incarnus will appear when
the Mark begins to shine.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘And lo, the Mark now glows in my hand, just as
the legends described.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘But though I wait and wait, the Incarnus does not
come to me.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘Perhaps it is unaware of the existence of the
Mark?

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘If that is the case, I must somehow tell the world
about the treasure I have discovered.’

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text: These appear to be Dr Snap’s research notes.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘The products of monster synthesis are sometimes
quite unlike the monsters which were combined.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘We assume this phenomenon to be caused by the
awakening of dormant traits in the base monsters.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘If we randomly pair up a mum, boh, jum and boe,
we can synthesise two visibly similar monsters.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘But if we then combine these, we produce a new
monster impossible to create by any other means.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
‘I have named this phenomenon Quadrilineal
Synthesis.’

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text: [df][a7][b0] Thou art powerful, human.

f070.speaker: Igor Folds
f070.text:
[df][a7][b0] I shall honour my vow, and accompany thee on
thy quest.

he will admit you into the garden.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text: [ea]If the vigour of your performance satisfies me...

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]...you shall have free and unfettered access to
my garden of delights!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]So will you rise to the challenge, young man!?
Ah-hua-hua-hua!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]Each time you complete an area of the garden,
a new one shall open to you.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:

take...

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]...for you to gain access to ALL the delights of
my garden!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]Oh, how exciting! You now have full access to
my huggies area!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]Should you succeed in opening the next gate,
you will be able to see everything. EVERYTHING!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]I want to see you work up a good sweat, young
man!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]I am Madaaame Ronda Rummy, and this is my

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text: [ea]At last, you have opened the final gate.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text: [ea]The WHOLE island now lies open before you.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]At least that’s what you’d like to believe, isn’t
it? Ah-hua-hua-hua!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]Well, you just keep thinking that for now,
darling.

f111.text:
[ea]I am Madaaame Ronda Rummy, and this is my

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text: [ea]Ah-hua-hua-hua!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I found the entrance to a shrine on the north
side of the island.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I went in to have a look around, but I got
completely lost.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I bet you anything there’s something worth
having hiding in there.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It wasn’t easy, but I managed to explore the
biggest part of the shrine to the north.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And just when I was starting to doubt there
was anything worth finding, I saw a blue chest...

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But it was empty! Can you believe that?
All that pain and suffering, for nothin’!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, did you know that Old Maid Rummy
sponsors the scout challenge?

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Not only that, but she also supports Dr Snap’s
research efforts.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Just think about how much the Old Maid must be
spending... How does anyone get to be that rich?

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Madame Rummy is extremely generous with her
wealth, you know.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] She even opened her gardens to the public.
Now anyone can visit.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] There was this really skilful girl scout who
tried Madame Rummy’s garden challenge...

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] She knew exactly where to find the slimes, as
if she’d lived in the garden all her life.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] She completed every area without breaking a
sweat. I wish I’d got her name...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] Judging by that performance, I’d say she was
odds-on to win the challenge.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] At this stage of the challenge, you have to
start really pushing your monsters.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Actually, maybe I should get to work on that
too, instead of lazing about here.

[eb][a7][b0] You have been granted access to the metal

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s a special privilege Madame Rummy extends

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I hope you appreciate Her Ladyship’s great

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]Welcome, my young Monster Scout Challenge

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]In recognition of your accomplishments, I grant

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s awfully good of you to visit Her Ladyship
after being named champion.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Such humility and respect will serve you well

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]Welcome, my sturdy young champion!
Ah-hua-hua-hua!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]Although I must say, I was rather disappointed
with the finals.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]But anyway, you mustn’t rest on your laurels.
[f1][fb][fd]
Remember that my garden will ALWAYS be open
should you wish to practise!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text: [ea]I do so enjoy watching young men training hard!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]I hardly need mention that I strongly disapprove
of that young lady’s behaviour during the finals.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]Her show of temper and was most unbecoming,
and more than a little embarrassing.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You know Solitaire, the girl who lost in the
finals? I saw her being scolded by the Old Maid.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I have no idea why she was so angry.
None of us dared to try and find out.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I heard something funny the other day! Since the
finals, if someone gets disqualified in a battle...

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...they call it ‘pulling a Solitaire’!
Hee hee hee hee hee!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s awfully good of you to visit Her Ladyship
after being named champion.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Such humility and respect will serve you well
in the future.

[eb][a7][b0] It’s awfully good of you to visit Her Ladyship

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[eb][a7][b0] If you treat your enemies with the same respect
and stay focused...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...you’ll win Solitaire’s Challenge too.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]Welcome, my sturdy young champion!
Ah-hua-hua-hua!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]I have nothing whatsoever to do with Solitaire’s
Challenge.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]And yet, scouts still insist on visiting my garden
and I.

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]One can only assume they are unable to resist
our charms!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea]Ah, my beauty can be something of a burden at
times. Ah-hua-hua-hua!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text: [ea]Ah-hua-hua-hua! [a8]wink[a9]

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Is that what I think it is?
Do you have one of the priceless metal tickets!?

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] As I’m sure you know, that gives you immediate
access to the metal menagerie!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So then, sir, would you like to use your ticket
and enter the metal menagerie?

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Very well. The menagerie of metallic merriment
is open! May your experience be fruitful!

f111.speaker: Madame Rummy
f111.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I see. In that case, you will have to participate
in Madame Rummy’s Garden Challenge to enter.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea]My name is Tryger.
I may not look it, but I’m one of the finalists.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea]You know why? This is just a costume!
I bet I had you fooled!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea]Instead of just waiting around, I’m going to try and
squeeze in some last-minute training...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea]But which island should I go to?
I just can’t decide.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There have been six previous scout challenges.
Only once was the champion decided immediately.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That was the very first one, when Commissioner
Snap won.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] In other years, the challengers were so closely
matched, it took time for a winner to emerge.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Now then lad, have you visited the skill scroll
shop in that newfangled department store of ours?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Skill scrolls let you teach monsters skill sets
without havin’ to do any synthesisin’, see.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] They can be pretty bleedin’ useful if you
use them right.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea]My name is Tryger.
I may not look it, but I’m one of the finalists.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea]You know why? This is just a costume!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] All the scouts who were camped out in the den
have upped sticks and gone.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s like the day after a festival [96] the place
feels like a ghost town.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Some skill sets require certain conditions before
you can coax ’em out, so to speak. For example...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] ...some can only be obtained by combinin’ the
existin’ skills of monsters usin’ synthesis.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] There are other ways to acquire skills.
You just have to experiment, I reckon.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I saw some ominous black clouds on the horizon,
way over yonder.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Over to the east, they were.
That’s where Infern Isle lies.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Some skill sets require certain conditions before
you can coax ’em out, so to speak. For example...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] ...some can only be obtained by combinin’ the
existin’ skills of monsters usin’ synthesis.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] There are other ways to acquire skills.
You just have to experiment, I reckon.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I wonder how much damage that catastrophe on
Infern Isle has done.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] I just hope no one’s been hurt...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Some skill sets require certain conditions before
you can coax ’em out, so to speak. For example...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] ...some can only be obtained by combinin’ the
existin’ skills of monsters usin’ synthesis.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] There are other ways to acquire skills.
You just have to experiment, I reckon.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The scouts are coming back from the islands to
take part in Solitaire’s Challenge.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] Green Bays is never boring with them around!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Some skill sets require certain conditions before
you can coax ’em out, so to speak. For example...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] ...some can only be obtained by combinin’ the
existin’ skills of monsters usin’ synthesis.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] There are other ways to acquire skills.
You just have to experiment, I reckon.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s great the new challenge keeps going even if
somebody defeats the Commissioner!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] When there’s no challenge on, the scoutposts
can become rather lonely.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Some skill sets require certain conditions before
you can coax ’em out, so to speak. For example...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] ...some can only be obtained by combinin’ the
existin’ skills of monsters usin’ synthesis.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] There are other ways to acquire skills.
You just have to experiment, I reckon.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] IF YOU ARE READING THIS MESSAGE,
A BUG HAS OCCURRED.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The whole of Palaish Isle is owned by Madame
Rummy.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] She even paid for this scoutpost to be built.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Now that you’re here, you should go and pay
your respects.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] Have you already met Madame Rummy?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oh, dear!
Well, you have my sympathies...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] All scouts should meet her at least once,
including you.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s a good opportunity to see a new type of
monster.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Listen, kid. I have a Theory about monster skills.
D’yer wanna hear it?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] As you keep synthesisin’ beasties, they get
numbers added to their skills.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [df][a7][b0] Like Ice II or Ice III, fer example.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Well, I reckon that monsters with higher numbers
after their skills learn better abilities.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Now, you wanna hear my Theories about
inheritin’ skills?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Well, it seems to me that yer can pass on up to
three skills sets to a newly synthesised monster.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Yer can choose three of the original monsters’
skills for the little ’un to inherit.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Choosin’ them skills [96] well, that’s what
separates the scout masters from the cubbies!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Hmph. Suit yerself.
Yer might have learnt somethin’ though.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Well, what about my Theories on inheritin’
skills? D’yer wanna hear them?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Well, it seems to me that yer can pass on up to
three skills sets to a newly synthesised monster.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Yer can choose three of the original monsters’
skills for the little ’un to inherit.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Choosin’ them skills [96] well, that’s what
separates the scout masters from the cubbies!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Ah, I’m a-wasting my time.
No one wants to listen to an old man like myself.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] We are currently searching for the person who
broke into the Commissioner’s office.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] No clues so far.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] However, we don’t want our scouts worrying
about it. They should focus on the challenge.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Do you know the scout called Ginny, the one at
the top of the standings?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, that scout is participating with the
backing of Old Maid Rummy.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I wonder what kind of scout you’d need to be
to earn the Old Maid’s support?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Listen, kid. I have a Theory about monster skills.
D’yer wanna hear it?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] As you keep synthesisin’ beasties, they get
numbers added to their skills.

k001.speaker: Tryger

Yer might have learnt somethin’ though.

[df][a7] Well, what about my Theories on inheritin’
skills? D’yer wanna hear them?

[df][a7][b0] Well, it seems to me that yer can pass on up to
three skills sets to a newly synthesised monster.

[df][a7][b0] Yer can choose three of the original monsters’
skills for the little ’un to inherit.

k001.speaker: Tryger

[df][a7][b0] Choosin’ them skills [96] well, that’s what
separates the scout masters from the cubbies!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Ah, I’m a-wasting my time.
No one wants to listen to an old man like myself.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] A robbery at the HQ! During the challenge!
Well, I never...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Still, it seems the finals are to go ahead as
planned.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] All thanks to Madame Rummy’s most generous
financial support, of course.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hm?
You think Madame Rummy actually had a mother?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I dunno...
I always imagined she hatched out of an egg.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Either way, she’s definitely one of the beast
family.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I tell you, the Old Maid is a beast family
monster that hatched out of a giant egg!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Listen, kid. I have a Theory about monster skills.
D’yer wanna hear it?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] As you keep synthesisin’ beasties, they get
numbers added to their skills.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [df][a7][b0] Like Ice II or Ice III, fer example.

k001.speaker: Tryger

[df][a7][b0] Well, I reckon that monsters with higher numbers

k001.speaker: Tryger

[df][a7][b0] Now, you wanna hear my Theories about
inheritin’ skills?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Well, it seems to me that yer can pass on up to
three skills sets to a newly synthesised monster.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Yer can choose three of the original monsters’
skills for the little ’un to inherit.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Decidin’ which skills to pass on [96] that’s what
separates the scout masters from the cubbies.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] If yer want to know more, talk to my brother.
He’s usually in the scoutpost in town.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Hmph. Mebbe my brother at the scoutpost in
town knows more about this stuff than I do...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] ...but what ’arm would it do to ’ear some of my
Theories, eh?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7] Well, what about my Theories on inheritin’
skills? D’yer wanna hear them?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Well, it seems to me that yer can pass on up to
three skills sets to a newly synthesised monster.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Yer can choose three of the original monsters’
skills for the little ’un to inherit.

k001.speaker: Tryger

separates the scout masters from the cubbies.

k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] If yer want to know more, talk to my brother.
He’s usually in the scoutpost in town.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Ah, I’m a-wasting my time.
No one wants to listen to an old man like myself.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] As one of our main sponsors, Madame Rummy
always watches the challenge finals.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] It is a great honour to fight before her.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You mustn’t disappoint her with a poor showing.
You should train on this island for a while.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I heard a rumour that Old Maid Rummy has
a daughter.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] Boy. Talk about being dealt a losing hand...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Any scout that makes it to the finals must ’ave
a sharp eye for pickin’ skills...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] ...and they gotta know which monsters to
choose for the best balance...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] ...and they gotta keep all that in mind when
they’re synthesisin’!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Why, if it isn’t the challenge champion?
Thank you for visiting us.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I know that Madame Rummy is most anxious to
meet our latest challenge winner.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] She is very fond of strong scouts.
Perhaps she’ll take a shine to you?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Maybe she’ll even introduce you to her
daughter. Now that would be something!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s a lot to be said for marrying for money
over looks...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] ...I’m sorry.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] Some things shouldn’t even be joked about...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] ...no matter how much money it might be worth.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]shudder[a9] Can you imagine calling the Old Maid
‘Mother’?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] There ain’t nothin’ more I can tell yer about
skills.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] It’s up to you to find yer own path now,
usin’ all yer experience and wits.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Why, if it isn’t the challenge champion?
Thank you for visiting us.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m sure you’ve already heard, but we’re
advising all scouts to avoid Infern Isle.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] Something has gone terribly wrong there...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hmmm, if she has a daughter, then it stands to
reason she must have had...a man?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]gulp[a9] He must’ve been into some pretty weird
stuff...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] There ain’t nothin’ more I can tell yer about
skills.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] It’s up to you to find yer own path now,
usin’ all yer experience and wits.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Her Ladyship was responsible for Miss Rumm[96]
I mean, Solitaire, being promoted to commissioner.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] In other words, we have her to thank for the
new challenge.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If you’re a participant, you owe it to Madame
Rummy to pay your respects.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So I hear that Madame Rummy’s daughter is
a scout.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You haven’t come across any hideous-looking
scouts on your travels, have you?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] What with her mum being a sponsor, you have to
assume she’s competing in the challenge.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] Looks to me that yer know just about all there
is to know about skills.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[df][a7][b0] You young ’uns learn so fast, it takes my
breath away.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] IF YOU ARE READING THIS MESSAGE,
A BUG HAS OCCURRED.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [eb][a7][b0] Hm? A shrine?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well, I don’t know any shrines, but
this island does have some enormous ruins.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Two great towers loom over them.
It’s easy to get lost inside!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] There’s an entrance to the west.
You can use that to get in and explore.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The ruins on this island are dominated by two
towers.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] One is called the Temple of the Sun and the
other, the Temple of the Moon.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] There’s an entrance to the west.
You can use that to get in and explore.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If you run into any other scouts, don’t be shy.
Just try talking to them.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] No one is going to suddenly start a battle
without asking first.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And if you’re not up for it, you can always
turn them down.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] South of this island, there’s another little
island.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] They say you need the sun and moon to
get there!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Who’re ‘they’?
Why, the talking mirrors of course!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] These days, Dr Snap is our leading authority on
monster biology.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Years ago, there was another famous
researcher, too. His name was Trump.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But he seems to have just dropped off the map.
I wonder what he does now?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] Shh! Don’t turn around. Act casual.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I had the same mission as you.
But I messed it up.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] Looks like you managed to pick up the pieces.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So I just wanted to say thanks, buddy.
I owe you. Now, get outta here!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] South of this island, there’s another little
island.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] They say you need the sun and moon to
get there!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Who’re ‘they’?
Why, the talking mirrors of course!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Recently, people have reported seeing some man
in a black hood.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] A very suspicious character, apparently.
Certainly not part of the MSO.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [eb][a7][b0] I hope he’s not trying to sabotage the challenge.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] To win the challenge, the five finalists will
have to fight it out.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So, if I see any scout wanderin’ around outside,
I’m gonna take him on. Or her.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I don’t know if I can make the finals, but I’d
better practise, just in case.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The monster challenge race is almost finished,
isn’t it?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] When the race bit is over, everyone goes to
Domus Isle for the big battle.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s gone very quiet around here now all the
scouts have left.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I get the feeling that the finals will be starting
pretty soon.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The old man with the golem in the scouts’ den
isn’t interested in the challenge.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What is wrong with all these lazy people!?
Let’s start the next challenge!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The scouts and staff are just sitting around
like bubble slimes!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The scout challenge is over, but I’m going to
stay on this island for a bit.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m not going home until I’ve unlocked the mystery
of the ruins.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hey, [f5]!
You’re going to win the next contest, right?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You don’t want to become another one-hit
wonder!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] One of the MSO suits told me a secret.
Do you want to hear it?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] A disaster has struck Infern Isle.
The actual shape of the island is changing!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] The challenge is over, but I’m not done yet.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] I’m going to fight any scout I see outside.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I didn’t reach the finals, so I’m itching for a
good battle or two!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hey, [f5]!
You’re going to win the next contest, right?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You don’t want to become another one-hit
wonder!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] They say something terrible happened over on
Infern Isle.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [eb][a7][b0] I’m so glad this island wasn’t affected.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] We have to go through Infern Isle to get back
to Domus Isle.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But I heard the monsters there have become
really powerful.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I don’t like my chances of getting home in one
piece. What should I do?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [eb][a7][b0] Did you hear the new commissioner is a girl?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] If I worked really, really hard, maybe I could
be a commissioner too!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] IF YOU ARE READING THIS MESSAGE,
A BUG HAS OCCURRED.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] So what’s your name?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [d0]1[f5] gives his name.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So you’re not a Rummy, huh?
I was going to ask for your autograph...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I collect the autographs of all the famous
scouts that come here.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But I don’t need yours.
I’ve never heard of you.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] I’m collecting the autographs of famous scouts.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You know, people like Tryger and Slimon,
and Missy too.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But I still don’t have Rummy’s autograph.
That’s the one I really want.
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] Solitaire keeps telling me I should have hers
instead, but what’s she ever done?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m having a hard time getting Rummy’s
autograph.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]shrug[a9] But I suppose I could settle for yours
in the meantime.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, aren’t you [f5]?
The new kid everybody’s talking about?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Can I have your autograph? Please?
Come on, I’m begging you!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [d0]1[f5] signs his autograph.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Awesome.
You’re going to be really good, I just know it!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I thought I’d better add you to my collection
while I still can.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So that’s how it is, is it?
Too big and famous for the rest of us, huh?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If you win the tournament, your autograph will
become a family heirloom!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And if you lose, I can always throw it in the
rubbish.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Please, [f5]!
Give me your autograph!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Unlike the other islands, we don’t have caverns
or ruins to explore here.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But there’s a great big door at the top of the
island.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There is a series of chambers inside, kind of
like a shrine.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Okay... FIRST we collect ten darkonium
crystals, and then...er...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Oh, right, I remember!
We go to the HQ and ring the bell in the belfry.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Cool! I just have to explore this island, and the
championship is mine.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] At the end of each shrine, there’s a sealed
door with a pattern carved on it, right?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] Well, do you know what’s behind those doors?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oh, no you don’t!
NO ONE can open them.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] No one except the chosen one.
You couldn’t possibly know.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Well, listen closely. The thing lurking on the
other side of those doors is a...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...MYSTERY!
Hahaha! I can’t believe you thought I knew!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Seems like that monster old Dr Snap was going
on about actually exists.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Whenever a scout reaches the goal, everybody
in town celebrates.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] My very close friend has a lovely caf[5c] there.
The place is always packed.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s called the Mess Hall.
You really should drop by some time.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] A challenge aficionado like myself can tell
right away if a new scout has what it takes.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The first time I saw you, I had you pegged as
a special talent.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I saw a scooter leaving that volcanic island
across the straights.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] People are definitely living there.
But why on earth would they want to?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] What’s that?
Have I seen Commissioner Snap?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] Hmm... Not that I recall.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But why would a busy man like the
Commissioner come to a dead-end island like this?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s a man in black lurking in the den.
I don’t like the look of him.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He seemed to be injured.
I wonder what he’s been up to...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That gentleman who’s hanging around in the den
is quite the dandy.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Dressed all in black, he is.
I do like that look.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I saw a black monster flying away from here
at a crazy speed.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] One minute it was here, and the next it was
gone. I don’t know where it’s headed...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] But if that thing got loose in town...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] That guy dressed in black is still in the den.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text: [ea][a7][b0] Don’t tell me you know him!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Wait... Does that mean you’re part of that
organisation, too?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...Forget I asked.
I don’t want to know.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Yeah, of course not.
You don’t look like one of them.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The challenge is supposed to be over, but all
sorts of people are coming and going.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s rather strange.
It’s not like anybody lives around here.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Did you hear?
Some sort of catastrophe struck Infern Isle.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Well, whatever it was, the MSO will sort it
out, right?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That nice gentleman dressed in black isn’t in
the den any more.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And I never did get to introduce myself...
Oh, why am I so SHY!?

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I bet Infant Isle and Xeroph Isle are pretty
lively right now.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] We don’t host any scouting events here on
Fert Isle, so hardly anyone comes by.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m never going to complete my famous scout
autograph collection at this rate!

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It seems like some people actually live on that
volcanic island.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Anyone who wants to live somewhere as bad
as that MUST be up to no good.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That gentleman in black who graced the den
left quite suddenly.

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And I did so want to introduce myself.
[a8]sigh[a9] Another missed opportunity...

k001.speaker: Tryger
k001.text:
[ea][a7][b0] IF YOU ARE READING THIS MESSAGE,
A BUG HAS OCCURRED.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Thanks.
Slime you later!

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Thanks.
Slime you later!

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text: [eb]Okay, good luck!

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text: [eb]Okay, good luck!

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text: [eb]Let’s do this again some time.

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text: [eb]Let’s do this again some time.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text: [ea]See ya, mate.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text: [ea]See ya, mate.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea][a8]gurgle[a9] Bye!

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea][a8]gurgle[a9] Bye!

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]Look out for me at the next cosplay conference,
okay?

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text: [ea]I’ll be the guy in the weartiger costume...

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]Look out for me at the next cosplay conference,
okay?

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text: [ea]I’ll be the guy in the weartiger costume...

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]Nice doing business with you.
But remember [96] this doesn’t make us friends, okay?

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]Nice doing business with you.
But remember [96] this doesn’t make us friends, okay?

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text: [ea]Cheerio!

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text: [ea]Cheerio!

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]Cheers, mate.
Let’s do this again some time.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]Cheers, mate.
Let’s do this again some time.

k002.speaker: Rusty
k002.text:
[df]Well, I think that’s everything. Give me a shout if
you have anything else you’d like to swap.

k002.speaker: Rusty
k002.text:
[df]Well, I think that’s everything. Give me a shout if
you have anything else you’d like to swap.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Oh, is that it?
’Kay, see ya.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Oh, is that it?
’Kay, see ya.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Oh, is that it?
’Kay, see ya.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Oh, is that it?
’Kay, see ya.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The fact you came back to this island proves
you’re sharper than you look.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] As soon as they could, all the scouts who
didn’t know better ran off to the other islands.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But to find darkonium, you have to search every
nook and cranny, not sprint for the horizon.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] This is the scouts’ den.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s a place for scouts like us to relax and
share information.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’re having trouble scouting new monsters,
aren’t you?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] Know what your problem is?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The monsters in your team just aren’t strong
enough.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Wild monsters won’t join you if they don’t think
you have what it takes.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I mean, no monster wants to fight for a weak
master!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That’s why scouting with weak monsters has a
low success rate.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So if you’re having problems, try levelling up
your monsters.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The more powerful your team members are, the
easier scouting new ones will be.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The opening ceremony?
It’s nothing but old Snap mumbling a few words.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Speaking of which, did you hear what the prize
is going to be this year?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, it’s a ‘priceless’ antique called the
Scout’s Mark.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The fact you came back to this island proves
you’re sharper than you look.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] As soon as they could, all the scouts who
didn’t know better ran off to the other islands.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But to find darkonium, you have to search every
nook and cranny, not sprint for the horizon.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Commissioner discovered the Scout’s Mark
right here on this island.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But if that’s true, the Incarnus must have lived
here too, right?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Though no one’s seen hide nor hair of it for
donkey’s years. Maybe it’s dead?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It might sound a bit far-fetched, but a secret
organisation tried to recruit me a while back.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Apparently, they wanted scouts to bring them
monsters for their research.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But I turned them down.
For me, it’s all about winning the challenge!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] From what I hear, the Commissioner is obsessed
with the Incarnus.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So why is he offering the Scout’s Mark as a
prize?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I mean, if he’s so into Incarnus-related stuff,
surely he’d want to keep the Mark?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It might sound a bit far-fetched, but a secret
organisation tried to recruit me a while back.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Apparently, they wanted scouts to bring them
monsters for their research.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But I turned them down.
For me, it’s all about winning the challenge!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m taking the Scout Proficiency Test to try and
win a darkonium crystal.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But it’s just so difficult!
It’s going to take me AGES to get it.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’d better move fast if you want to reach
the finals.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m not taking part in the challenge, so I’m in no
hurry.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’d better move fast if you want to reach
the finals.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] My summer holidays are over...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I just saw the Commissioner.
He was crossing the rope bridge.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I was surprised to see a man of his experience
on THIS island. Usually only beginners come here.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I don’t have a penny to my name.
I wish the MSO would pay us a salary or something.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m sure the scouting life may SEEM glamorous to
outsiders...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...but it’s actually a lot of hard work for very
little reward.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, the Commissioner still hasn’t
returned.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The suits are a bit worried that something has
happened to him.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But I think he just wandered off somewhere.
He is a bit batty after all.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I don’t have a penny to my name.
I wish the MSO would pay us a salary or something.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m sure the scouting life may SEEM glamorous to
outsiders...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...but it’s actually a lot of hard work for very
little reward.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Do you know why there’s a temple on the top of
the mountain here?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Yeah, of course you do.
You’re the champion [96] I bet you know everything!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Really? You don’t?
Well then, I suppose I’ll have to tell you...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] A long, long time ago, the legendary Incarnus
descended to this island.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Centuries later, challenge scouts started coming
here to take the pledge...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...hoping to receive the Incarnus’ blessing in the
process.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hey, do you remember when that strange
monster appeared on the mountain?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It seems so long ago now, but I think it was just
before the last challenge began.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] IF YOU ARE READING THIS MESSAGE,
A BUG HAS OCCURRED.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I found a pool of quicksand near the battle
arena.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s like a hole in the desert [96]
it almost sucked me right in.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I reckon once you fall in there,
you’re not coming out!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What’s wrong with this island?
I can’t reach the north side!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m SURE there must be a hidden passageway
somewhere. ...I just haven’t found it yet.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Hey, I remember that stupid haircut. You’re the kid I
saw at the temple, right? On Infant Isle?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][d0]1[f5], wasn’t it!?
Well, if you’re here...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]...I’m guessing that means you’re competing in the
challenge, right?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb]But anyway, enough about you...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Listen, I met that strange monster again [96]
the one you let escape.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]I didn’t waste any time [96] I attacked and tried to
scout it, but NOTHING worked.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Tsk. I just don’t understand it.
It looks like a complete pushover...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Huh? Where did it go after that?
...Oh, I see!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb]You want to take it for yourself, don’t you?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]In your DREAMS, kid!
There’s no WAY I’m telling YOU where it went!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]...It’s such a wimpy monster.
WHY can’t I scout it!?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Huh? Where did it go after that?
...Oh, I see!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb]You want to take it for yourself, don’t you?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Ha! Nothing you could POSSIBLY do would persuade
me to tell you it jumped into the quicksand!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Oh dear! I was engrossed in reading the
noticeboard...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...when suddenly I noticed there was a stray
monster in here!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well, I’m just going to ignore it.
Pretend I never saw it.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] Was your monster actually talking!?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] I couldn’t hear what it was saying exactly...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But that little thing certainly does talk posh,
doesn’t it?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] That monster you picked up here wasn’t just a
run-of-the-mill stray.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Maybe I should have tried scouting it for my
team...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I heard that the battle arena is offering
darkonium as a prize.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Dunno about you, but I need all the crystals I
can get if I’m going to make it to the finals.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] I’d be a fool not to give it a go.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What was the Commissioner talking about again?
Something about an ‘Incarnus’?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] He said it possessed ‘immeasurable power’.
‘A monster among monsters’, he called it...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] Do you think such a creature really exists?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] I’d love to see it, if it does.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] They say the Incarnus is incredibly powerful.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Huh! If I had one of them, I’d actually have a
chance of winning the challenge!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I won a darkonium crystal at the battle arena.
But do you know what?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They only award ONE per contestant!
I was planning to collect all ten there!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Pirates have begun attacking challenge
contestants out on the ocean.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] They only sail at night, apparently.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The latest information is usually posted on the
noticeboards. Be careful!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Watch out for pirates while you’re travelling on
your sea scooter!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If you don’t fancy walking the plank, you’d
better keep checking the noticeboards for updates!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’ve already dropped out, but how about you?
Think you can make it to the finals?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] Hm. I suppose it’s good to be confident.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well, good luck then!
Win it for me, okay?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Oh, I’m sorry.
Perhaps I shouldn’t have asked...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Of all the contestants, only five scouts can
qualify for the finals. I don’t like those odds!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The scouts who fail to qualify don’t even get
to keep their darkonium. The MSO takes it!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Imagine missing out on the finals and then having
the fruits of your labours taken off you! Not fun.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You’re joking!?
[d0]1[f5] reached the finals?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hmph! It’s only because he’s got that strange
monster. I mean, he’s not that good, right?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, wasn’t it you that brought that monster no
one had ever seen here?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It was way back when the challenge first
started... Seems so long ago now.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I can’t believe that of all the scouts that
passed through here, YOU became champion.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] Eh? [d0]1[f5] won the championship?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Ooh, I suppose that makes him better than us
now, doesn’t it?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Is it true that the catastrophe on Infern Isle has
blocked out the sun?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s hard to imagine something like that happening
in Green Bays...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] Eh? [d0]1[f5] won the championship?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Ooh, I suppose that makes him better than us
now, doesn’t it?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Did you know that the Rank S prize at the
battle arena is a loyalty card?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It gives you a 20-percent discount on
ALL item purchases.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’re joking!
You cleared Rank S at the battle arena!?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] S-So, you must have a loyalty card!
...Er, could I see it? Just for a second?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Actually, never mind...
It’d just make me even more jealous...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The Commissioner made an announcement about
the prize for winning Solitaire’s Challenge...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] She said it would be ‘something really
awesome’!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] As much as I trust our glorious new leader, it
might’ve been nice to know what the ‘something’ is!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] IF YOU ARE READING THIS MESSAGE,
A BUG HAS OCCURRED.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, has someone already explained the
challenge rules to you?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If not, go and register! The receptionist will tell
you everything you need to know.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m no good at finding stuff!
What am I going to do?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] They say darkonium is a kind of rock, right? But
Green Bays is full of rocks! Where do we start?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I suppose we just have to comb each
island, one by one...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But some islands have EXTREMELY powerful
monsters.
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] Make sure your team can handle them before
boarding that sea scooter!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Sometimes, the scouts listed on the leader board
come by here.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You can usually find them hanging around the
table by the wall there.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Why don’t you try striking up a conversation?
...They’re probably too shy to approach you!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’ve seen some really famous scouts in the
scouts’ den...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...but I’ve never met Rummy.
You know, the one at top of the leader board?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] When you have a spare moment, it can be fun to
browse through your library.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Of course, the more monsters you scout and
synthesise, the more fun you’ll have!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Once the first contestant reaches the goal,
they take down the leader board.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It rather takes the thrill out of reading the
notices...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] During the finals, the battling is non-stop [96]
there are no breaks between bouts.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The secret of success is being able to heal
your team during the fight.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The finals don’t end until a scout wins four
battles in a row.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So even if a scout loses a few bouts, it doesn’t
mean he’s out of the running.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But if he loses faith in his abilities?
Well, then it’s game over, my friend.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] During the finals, the battling is non-stop [96]
there are no breaks between bouts.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The secret of success is being able to heal
your team during the fight.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Wow!
So this is what it’s like inside a scoutpost!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m going to enter the next challenge, so I came
to have a look around.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLURRRP.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Wow!
So this is what it’s like inside a scoutpost!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m going to enter the next challenge, so I came
to have a look around.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLURRRP.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] What’s a gigantes doing in here?
The scouts’ den isn’t for monsters.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] I mean, think of the furniture!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] Why no monster allowed in lodging house!?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Stupid landlord not nice.
Where me live?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The MSO summoned me here all the way from
the mainland to compete in this new challenge...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I suppose I’ll take part...but really, that
Commissioner can be a bit pushy at times.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You know, we scouts are just like everyone
else when there’s no challenge going on.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] So if it’s the scout challenge, Solitaire’s
Challenge, or whatever challenge [96] I’m in!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] I just HATE not being in the spotlight, don’t you?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Okay, so you were the first to defeat
Solitaire [96] but I’ll definitely be the second!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ’Course, I have to pass the advanced test
first...and, ahem, do all that battle arena stuff...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Don’t worry, though [96] with my awesome skills,
I’ll have it all done in no time!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You know, we scouts are just like everyone
else when there’s no challenge going on.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] So if it’s the scout challenge, Solitaire’s
Challenge, or whatever challenge [96] I’m in!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] I just HATE not being in the spotlight, don’t you?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] This place is more than just an island [96]
it’s one giant pleasure-garden.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m convinced there MUST be a darkonium crystal
hidden somewhere here!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I keep worrying that someone’s going to snatch it
from under my nose...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] Ah...it’s a wonder I can still relax with all of
that on my mind...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There HAS to be a darkonium crystal somewhere
in these gardens.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] Wh-What!? You’ve already found it!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ARRRGH! I just KNEW someone was going to
snatch it from under my nose!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You beat me to it, but I was right about there
being a darkonium crystal hidden on this island.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Next time, I’m going to follow my instincts and
grab the darkonium for myself.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] There’s a jetty on the west side of the island.
I wonder where you can reach from there.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’d like to find out, but a lot of this island is
off-limits...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Unless the Old Maid gives you permission, that
is.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Can you believe it? You can only get to boring
old Domus Isle from that jetty on the west side.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] To think I wasted ALL that time and effort
completing Madame Rummy’s Garden Challenge!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I tell you, I wouldn’t mind if I never saw
another slime in my life!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Commissioner discovered dark matter when
he was researching monsters.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Darkonium is essential to the study of dark
matter.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] I think that’s why he wants so much of it.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You know how the Old Maid’s last
name is Rummy? I wonder...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Is she related to the scout Rummy?
You know, the one on the leader board?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If I could just reach the finals, I’d have a
really good chance of winning it all.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The trouble is, I’m not very good at treasure
hunts.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You know how the Old Maid’s last
name is Rummy? I wonder...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Is she related to the scout Rummy?
You know, the one on the leader board?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, the Old Maid will open her most
prized garden to the challenge finalists!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s supposed to be a place where any scout’s
desires can be fulfilled!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You are SO lucky!
What I wouldn’t give to be in your shoes!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I just saw one of the finalists practising in the
Old Maid’s gardens... She thrashed them!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] She’s really, REALLY good. As a girl scout,
I’m definitely going to support her!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Who cares about the challenge?
Madame Rummy’s gardens are much better!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m having way more fun than I would have if
I’d made it to the finals!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You know the scout who was making the Old
Maid’s gardens look like child’s play?
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] Well...it turns out her surname is Rummy.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] Suddenly, I’m a lot less impressed...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Must be nice, being champion.
You’re allowed to play in the metal menagerie.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I didn’t even reach the finals, so there’s no
way I’m getting in.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You know that finalist ‘Solitaire’?
Well, apparently, her real name is Ginny Rummy.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] No prizes for guessing who she’s related to.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s a reason why access to the metal
menagerie is limited.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Metal monsters are quite rare.
They’re considered endangered, believe it or not.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Old Maid supports a lot of worthy causes,
but she’s especially keen on environmental issues.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’ve seen the new commissioner going into the
palace quite a few times.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Seems that even the Commissioner is at the beck
and call of the important sponsors.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
REPORT...THIS... [a7]COUGH[a7]
AS A BUG...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
