[ea][a7][b0] Did you read the noticeboard?
That Rummy is still in first place.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hmph. No prizes for guessing which contestant is
best at treasure hunts.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But the finals are a different story.
That’s when the REAL scouts prove themselves.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The Commissioner came up with the new rule
about collecting darkonium.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] Looks like he needs a lot of it for his research.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Look here, Boo Boo.
This here’s called a ‘ladybug’.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Go on, you try and say it.
L-a-d-y-b-u-g.

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text: [ea]Gggrglebbbg...?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea]Sorry, I simply cannot bring myself to call a
‘ladybird’ that other name. It’s just too uncouth.

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m feeling a bit bored, Boo Boo.
How about a game of checkers?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You know what I’m talking about...
‘Checkers’! It’s a lovely game, don’t you think?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text: [ea]Gggrrrgers...?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea]If you will kindly refer to is as ‘draughts’, I might
be convinced to join you in a game or two...

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea]Otherwise, I might have to just crown you on the
noggin this very instant, you boorish oaf!

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m feeling a bit peckish for some ‘eggplant’
right now. How about you, Boo Boo?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Are you listening? Hullo!?
I asked if you wanted to share some ‘eggplant’!

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text: [ea]Gggrrrglant...?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea]If I’m not mistaken, the word you are looking for is
‘aubergine’...
[f1][fb][fd]
DO try and curb your brutish tendencies, old boy.
It’s becoming rather vexing!

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So I’m thinking of taking up gardening, Boo Boo.
Should I start off with some zucchini perhaps?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] C’mon now, Boo Boo!
Whaddaya say to my ‘zucchini’ idea!?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text: [ea]Gggrglini...?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea]That vulgar nomenclature really isn’t growing on
me...but you may propagate ‘courgettes’ if you wish!

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Boo Boo, how about we go to the shop
and pick up some ‘cotton candy’?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s something about silky, smoothy,
COTTONY candy that makes my tummy rumbly!

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text: [ea]Gggrrrglbandy...?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea]Hmph! If it’s ‘candyfloss’ you’re referring to,
then I quite agree. It’s divine! But please...
[f1][fb][fd]
‘Cotton candy’? How grotesque! Next you’ll be
calling it ‘fairy floss’ or something!

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] IF YOU ARE READING THIS MESSAGE,
A BUG HAS OCCURRED.

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Let me tell you, the monsters on this island are
murder!

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If your team isn’t up to it, you should train on
one of the other islands.

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Especially if you have newly synthesised
monsters in your squad.

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Did you know you can start combining monsters
via synthesis once they’ve reached level ten?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ’Course, it’s better to be patient and boost their
basic attributes even more than that.

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Levelling up your beasties is the key to
synthesising really powerful monsters, see.

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s good to combine monsters with outstanding
attributes, especially HP and Attack.

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And it goes without saying, the higher the rank
of the original monsters you pair up...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...the stronger the synthesised beastie will be.

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] If you have ten darkonium crystals,
you should head for the goal.

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I mean, it’s all very well spending time
perfecting your team...

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...but if you don’t make the finals,
what’s the point?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I sometimes see this really suspicious-looking
bloke in a black hood.

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Do you think he’s competing in the challenge?
’Cause he doesn’t look like a scout to me!

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] Out of all the finalists, I like Tryger the best.

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I mean, isn’t it just ADORABLE how he always
dresses like a weartiger?

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The weird guy in the black hood?
Yeah, I’ve seen him a few times.

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] Maybe he’s one of THEM...

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You know, that underground organisation that
collects monsters...

k002.speaker: Boo Boo
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’m training my monsters in preparation for the
next challenge.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]Ah, my leetle chum! ’Ave you ’eard about what
’appened at ’eadquarters!? Everything is in chaos!

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]All ze monsters we ’ad collected escaped from
zeir cages, and now zey run wild!

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]It was getting a leetle too ’airy for me, so I
says to myself[b0] ‘Jacques, it is time for an ’oliday!’

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea][a8]wink[a9] A good thing your old friend Jacques knew
about ze secret jetty, eh?

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]Pardon?
You do not know of ze secret jetty?

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text: [ea]Hmmm. I suppose zere is no ’arm in telling you now.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]Leave zis scoutpost, go left, and follow ze
shoreline around ze island.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text: [ea]Zere you will find it [96] ze secret jetty!

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]Go if you want. But if it were me, I’d stay far
away from zat place...

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]Pardon?
You do not know of ze secret jetty?

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text: [ea]Hmmm. I suppose zere is no ’arm in telling you now.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]Leave zis scoutpost, go left, and follow ze
shoreline around ze island.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text: [ea]Zere you will find it [96] ze secret jetty!

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]Go if you want. But if it were me, I’d stay far
away from zat place...

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I just can’t focus on my training.
Something’s...not right out there.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The air is deadly still....like the quiet before
a storm.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]Ah, my leetle chum.
I see zat you are safe.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text: [ea]I ’eard you went to ze ’eadquarters by yourself.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]What did you say!?
Warden Trump ’as been injured...!?

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]Oh, ’ow I wish zere was something I could do for
’im...

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]But ’ow can I show my face zere now?
I ran away like a scaredy dog.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]And now you ’ave been entrusted wiz a great
mission, eh?

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea][a8]sigh[a9] I know YOU will not let ze Warden down like
I did.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]Soon, I shall slip away and leave zis place
forever.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text: [ea]I think maybe, we will never meet again, eh?

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea]C’est la vie, my leetle chum... I ’ope you succeed
in your mission. Bonne chance, and au revoir!

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I just can’t focus on my training.
Something’s...not right out there.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The air is deadly still....like the quiet before
a storm.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The monsters here have been howling non-stop.
It’s driving me mad!

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They’ve been at it ever since that black monster
was first spotted...

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Are you [f5]?
The kid who won the scout challenge?

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Some scouts wow everyone on their debut and
then just sort of...fizzle out.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Make sure you don’t end up being another
one-hit wonder!

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That guy with the black hood [96] was he from
the volcano island?

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Seems like the perfect place for dodgy blokes
like him.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] IF YOU ARE READING THIS MESSAGE,
A BUG HAS OCCURRED.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oh, hello.
I don’t think we’ve met.

k002.speaker: Black Jacques
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Slimon’s my name.
Nice to muck...er, I mean ‘make’, your acquaintance.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]If you’re competing in the challenge, you should
glop...er, I mean ‘drop’, in every now and then.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]The scouts’ dens are great places to meet other
challenge contestants.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]If you see people loitering near the wall, like I
am, try talking to them.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Scouts looking to meet other scouts gather near this
table. It’s the same in all the scouts’ dens.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Once you get to know someone, you’ll be able to
swap monsters with them.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Unfortunately, I don’t have any monsters to trade
now, but maybe later?

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Next time you visit a scoutpost, plop...er, I mean
‘pop’, into the scouts’ den and see if I’m around!

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] has made friends with the gloopy
gladiator, Slimon!

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, nice to meet you.
Mire...er, I mean ‘my’, name is Slimon.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]As soon as I saw you come in, I thought,
‘Now there’s a scout I’d like to get to know!’

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]We may be competing against each other in the
challenge...
[f1][fb][fd]
...but that’s no reason we can’t be friends.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]If we all went around treating each other as
mortal enemies, this contest would be a nightmare!
[f1][fb][fd]
I mean, Green Bays is PACKED with contestants.
It would be WAR! Ha ha!

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Anyway, listen [96] let’s swap monsters when we
next meet, eh?

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]See goo around!
...Er, I mean ‘See you around!’

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] has made friends with the gloopy
gladiator, Slimon!

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, nice to meet you.
Mire...er, I mean ‘my’, name is Slimon.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]And I know your name, of course [96] what with us
both being in the finals.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]But I’m glad we’ve had this chance to actually get
to know each other.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Anyway, listen [96] let’s swap monsters when we
next meet, eh?

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]See goo around!
...Er, I mean ‘See you around!’

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] has made friends with the gloopy
gladiator, Slimon!

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Hey, [f5].
How’s it wobbling?

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]I’m really working hard on my slimes’ training,
trying to make them the best they can be.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]People tend to underestimate slimes, but they can
become pretty powerful if they have a mind to.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Anyway, goo you...er, I mean ‘do you’, want to
exchange monsters?

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Hey, [f5].
How’s the team?

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]My slimes are training hard.
I’m turning them into lean, mean sliming machines...

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]...Well, not so lean, perhaps...but I AM close to
realising my dream...

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]...ANY-way. Do you want to muck...er, I mean
‘make’, a trade?

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text: [ea]Today, I want to tell you about my dream.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]I want to build a battle arena...
[f1][fb][fd]
...just for SLIMES!

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Slimes could train there as much as they liked and
finally win a bit of respect for themselves.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]And you know, there’s NOTHING better than diving
into big wobbly pile of slimes and smothering[96]

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Uh...oh, er, did I say that out loud?
O-KAY! A monster swap, right? Let’s do it!

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Hey there, [f5]. I take it you’re competing
in Solitaire’s Challenge too.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]You haven’t heard anything about any prize money,
have you?

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Only, I really need some capital.
You know, to build my Slimopolis.

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea][a8]sigh[a9] My dream, my Slimopolis! My very own jiggly,
wobbly, wibbly slime arena! Just think of it! [a8]drool[a9]

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]...You’d rather not? Oh, okay.
So, er, you’re just here to swap monsters then?

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Oh? You’ve changed your mind?
Stop ‘mucking’ about!

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[ea]Oh, come on! Ick’ll be fun!
...Er, I mean, ‘It’ll be fun!’

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text: [ea]I’ve got something slimy with your name on it!

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] Eek! H-Hello!?

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Mmm... Judging by that hair, I’d say you’re a cat
person. I’m right, aren’t I?

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well, that settles it then!
You and I are going to be friends!

k002.speaker: Slimon
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] My name is Kitty...

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]...and I think cats are purrrfect!
So if you find any feline monsters, let me know!

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]And if you’re REALLY nice, I might even give you
something in exchange. So see you around, okay?

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] has made friends with the feline
fanatic, Kitty!

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] WHIPPPEEEEEE!

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] This is SO exciting! The challenge champion
is actually talking to ME-OW!!!

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]I’m a big fan of yours, you know.
I ADORE people who look like cats.

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]...and I think cats are purrrfect!
So if you find any feline monsters, let me know!

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]And if you’re REALLY nice, I might even give you
something in exchange. So see you around, okay?

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] has made friends with the feline
fanatic, Kitty!

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]Hi there, [f5].
Tell me, have you heard of a scout called Missy?

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]Well, she’s my younger sister, and do you know
what she did?
[f1][fb][fd]
She went and registered for the challenge without
telling anyone!

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]Anyway, if you happen to see her around, say ‘hi’
from me, okay?

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]Oh, and while you’re here, how about swapping a
monster or two?

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text: [eb]Hi, [f5].

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]You haven’t seen my little sister, have you?
She’s competing in the challenge.

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]Actually, she’s an amazing girl.
Her IQ is over 240! Can you believe it?

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]She’s really crafty in battle [96] she likes to use
tricks to keep her opponents off balance.

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]She inherited ALL the brains in our family...
I got stuck with the good looks and personality.

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]But what more do you need, right?
Now, do you want to swap monsters?

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text: [eb][a8]sigh[a9] I just don’t know what to do, [f5].

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]I’ve poured all my love into rearing my monsters.
How can I send the poor things into battle?

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]What if one of my little kitties were to get hurt?
I’d never be able to forgive myself!

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]...Oh, I’m so sorry.
I shouldn’t be burdening you with my troubles...

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text: [eb]Enough of my yowling [96] let’s swap monsters!

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text: [eb]Did you hear about the new commissioner?

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]No one knows where Dr Snap went, so the MSO had
to replace him...

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]Personally, I think they should have chosen you
over Solitaire. You won the championship, after all.

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]Of course, my little sister couldn’t have been
happier. She ADORES Solitaire.

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]What do I care though [96] there’re no cats in politics.
Let’s change the subject. Want to swap monsters?

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]Oh, don’t play so hard to get [96] I KNOW you want
what I’m offering!

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb]Oh...I see. [a8]sniff[a9] 
Maybe next time then...

k002.speaker: Kitty
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Nice to meet you.
My name is Lizzy.

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]I was curious about this ‘challenge’ event of which
the hoi polloi[96]

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]...er, that is to say, the working class people, are
so fond. So I decided to enter it myself.

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]Well, it was nice to meet you, but now you will
have to excuse me.

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] is honoured to make the acquaintance
of the stuffy scout named Lizzy!

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Ah, you must be the champion [96] [f5],
wasn’t it? You may call me Lizzy.

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]I must say, I was most impressed that one of the
hoi polloi[96] er, that is to say...

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]...a member of the working class, was capable of
showing the diligence required to earn victory.

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]I am sure we shall meet again.
Now, if you will excuse me...

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] is honoured to make the acquaintance
of the stuffy scout named Lizzy!

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]Ah, is that you, [f5]? I made a most
extraordinary discovery the other day.

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]You see, I found a copper sword, and I was looking
forward to sundering some slimes with it.

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]But imagine my surprise when I was informed that
only monsters could wield it!

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]One learns something new every day. Anyway...
I assume you’d like to exchange some monsters?

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]Have you already met Madame Rummy of Palaish
Isle?

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]I don’t like to speak ill of people, but she really is
a most BEASTLY woman, don’t you think?

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]Just because she owns her very own island,
everyone assumes she must be a wonderful person!

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]It makes my blood boil! Still, whatever advantages
she may have over me in real estate and fame...
[f1][fb][fd]
...I MORE than make up for in beauty and grace!

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb][a8]sigh[a9] Of course, just about ANYONE could say
that...

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]Anyway, enough chit-chat.
Would you like to exchange some monsters?

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]If you were to fight in the finals, what manner of
monsters would you have in your team?

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]I know what I’D pick [96] king squids, without a
doubt...

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]I love their smooth, sinewy tentacles...how they
bind their victims with an irresistible embrace...
[f1][fb][fd]
...before slithering forward to deliver the final...

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]...Oh, haha.
Listen to me, getting carried away again...

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]SO, shouldn’t we be swapping monsters or
something?

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]Ah, it’s my working class hero! This Solitaire’s
Challenge is rather intriguing, don’t you think?

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]Apparently, some of the island events have been
incorporated into the challenge...

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]Obviously this means more profits for the organisers
of those events...

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]There’ve been whispers about deals with the
arena and monetary ‘gifts’ to the Commissioner.

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]That Solitaire certainly has her fingers in a lot of
pies.

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]Still, what can WE do? Best not to think about it.
Let’s exchange monsters instead.

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text: [eb]Oh, you can’t possibly mean that!

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]This is no time for false modesty [96] I’m SURE you’d
be honoured to trade with me!

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text: [eb]Well I never!

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[eb]Are you implying that I’m not good enough to
swap monsters with you!?

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] You lookin’ for a fight, son?

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] O, sorry about that, mate.
My mistake.

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] I ain’t seen yer face ’round ’ere before, see.

k002.speaker: Lizzy
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] My name’s Ooligan. I reckon you an’ me’re gonna
get on like an ’ouse on fire.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]So give us a shout next time yer see me, awright,
son?

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] is now friends with the occasionally
objectionable Ooligan!

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oooh! ’Ard luck losin’ to that Rummy bird!
Still, at least yer lost to the challenge champ, eh?

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] O, sorry about that, mate.
My mistake.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] That Rummy bird got disqualified,
didn’t she.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It was YOU wot won it!
Pleased to meet yer, anyway. The name’s Ooligan.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]So give us a shout next time yer see me, awright,
son?

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] is now friends with the occasionally
objectionable Ooligan!

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]There you are, [f5]!
I’ve been waitin’ ’ere for bleedin’ AGES!

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]Thing is, I ’ad this idea that maybe you an’ me
could swap some monsters or somefin’.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text: [ea]Wot d’yer reckon?

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text: [ea]Ah, if it ain’t me good mate, [f5]!

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]Listen, son. I ’eard somefin’ on the grapevine wot I
reckon might come in ’andy...

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]A little bird [96] actually, it was a bloke [96] told me
yer can win darkonium at the arena on Xeroph Isle.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]Sounds good, don’t it? I’d rather fight for the stuff
than go on a bloomin’ treasure ’unt.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]Now, I ’elped you, so you ’elp me, eh?
Let’s swap some monsters!

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]’Ello, [f5]!
Tell me, wot’s yer favourite monster?

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text: [ea]I’m pers’nally like dragony-style monsters, see.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]Oooh, I loves it when they breath fire over
ev’ryfin’... Proper get’s me goin’, it does!

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]’Course, back where I come from, they called me
‘Ooligan the Dragon Tamer’!

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]So, ’avin’ divulged me secret past, I’m sure yer
know me well enough to swap monsters, eh?

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]’Ello, [f5].
I ain’t an ’appy scout today, an’ that’s the truth!

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]This new Sally-tears Challenge is RUBBISH!
It don’t ’ave ’alf the atmosphere o’ the old one.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]Me dream was to battle you in the championship
final.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]But there ain’t no way that’ll ever ’appen in this
all-new bleedin’ challenge.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]O well. I s’pose we’ll just ’ave to swap monsters
instead.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]O, ’ave an ’eart, son!
Just one little swap?

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea]So that’s ’ow it is, is it!?
An’ I thought we was mates!

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]gurrrgle[a9] Don’t worry.
Me don’t bitesss.

k002.speaker: Ooligan
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Actually, me a ssscout.
You can call me Chuck. [a8]burp[a9]

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea][a8]sigh[a9] No one talk to me.
Maybe becaussse me smell funny?

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea]...Anyway, you and me friendsss now.
So if we meet again, you say ‘hello’.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea][a8]guuurgle-urgle[a9]

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] and the scabby scout called Chuck
have become fast friends!

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You isss [f5],
the challenge champion?

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] This is big honour. My name isss Chuck.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea][a8]BURP[a9] Me look like rotting corpssse, but me
actually scout.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea]Next time, you and me swap monsssters, okay?

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] and the scabby scout called Chuck
have become fast friends!

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea][a8]gurgle[a9] Hello [f5].

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea]People alwaysss point at me and say,
‘Ew! Look at the walking corpse!’

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea]But they can’t see the REAL me.
[a8]sigh[a9] People isss so shallow.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea]Anyway. You want trade monsters?

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea]Me makesss friends with a scout called Tryger.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea]He ask, ‘You like cosplay too?’

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea]But why would me dress up as rotting corpssse?

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea]It so frustrating. People can’t sssee past green
flaky flesh and bad breath.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea]People ssso rude.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea]Me upset.
Perhaps monster swap make me happy?

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea][a8]burrrp[a9] Hello, [f5].

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea]Me almost collect ten darkonium cryssstals.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea]Me almossst reach goal. [a8]BURP[a9]

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea]If me reach goal, me have lotsss of girlfriends.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea]Me be challenge champion and be famousss.
Me be Green Bays Casanova.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea][a8]guuurgle gaaargle[a9] Today me happy.
You and me swap monsters, okay?

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea]Listen, [f5].
My dream ssstill alive.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea][a8]gurgle[a9] Me make harem of groupies.
Me have plan.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea]First, me win Solitaire’sss Challenge.
Me be popular.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea]Famousss man once said, ‘I have a dream.’

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text: [ea]Me too have dream. [a8]burp[a9]

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea]Me can see it!
Me can see it!

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea]Me have groupies stuck to me like flies on rotting
banana.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea]Okay, [f5].
Now you and me swap monsters!

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea][a8]gurrrgggle[a9] Why you say no?
Me want swap monsters!

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea]Eh!? Why not?
Pleassse? It be fun.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oh, it’s okay! Don’t run away!
I’m not actually a monster, you know.

k002.speaker: Chuck
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m just wearing a weartiger costume, you see.
My name is Tryger, and I’m a monster scout.

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]I know, I know. My costume is SO convincing, you
thought I was the real thing...

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]...but I assure you, I won’t bite, hahaha! So let’s
swap monsters next time we meet, all right?

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] has made friends with the seriously
stripy scout called Tryger!

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]Oh, hello [f5].
You know, I had quite an adventure the other day.

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text: [ea]I found myself in a fight with a certain scout...

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]But his team had some of the most idiotic monsters
I’ve ever had the misfortune to meet.

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]Would you believe they actually attacked ME
instead of my monsters!?

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]I DO try to explain that it’s only a costume, but
people just don’t understand the cosplay lifestyle.

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]Anyway, speaking of monsters [96] would you like to
trade?

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text: [ea]Oh, hello, [f5].

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text: [ea]I’m afraid you’ve caught me at a rather bad time.

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]Recently, I’ve really been in two minds about which
costume to wear.

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]Should I stick with the weartiger, or go with my new
hacksaurus costume?

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]Well, I thought I’d try being a hacksaurus for a bit,
and popped outside to explore the island...

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]...but I couldn’t go more than ten paces without
being attacked by overenthusiastic scouts!

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]So I scurried back here as fast as I could and
changed right back into my weartiger costume.

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]But enough about my adventures [96] shall we swap
monsters?

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]Oh dear, oh dear. [f5], you’ll never
guess what’s happened to me now.

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]I have a female lips on my team, and it’s fallen
head-over-heels in love with me.

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text: [ea]The poor, besotted thing keeps trying to KISS me!

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]It just doesn’t understand that humans and
monsters were never meant to be together!
[f1][fb][fd]
...At least, not in THAT way.

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]Ahem, speaking of monsters...you wouldn’t fancy
swapping any, would you?

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]What do you mean? You’d rather hear more about
my cosplay adventures?

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]Look, I can tell you more stories later.
What about trading monsters?

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[ea]Oh well, if you’ve made up your mind, I won’t try
to talk you into it...

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You know, Mummy said REAL gentlemen don’t
suddenly talk to strange women in scouts’ dens...

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hehe. But you don’t look like a gentleman, so I
suppose it’s okay.

k002.speaker: Tryger
k002.text: [eb][a7][b0] My name is Missy.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]I’m going to be the next Monster Scout Challenge
idol. I already have a fan club.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]Hey, if we meet again, let’s exchange monsters,
okay?

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] is now friends with the scouting
idol-in-training known as Missy!

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I don’t really need to introduce myself, do I?
Tut! FINE! I’m Missy, the next challenge idol.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]Because of you, I wasn’t able to fight Miss
Solitaire in the finals.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]You’re stupid! I HATE you!
I’m going to get you back, just you wait!

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text: [eb]Because YOU’RE not the next challenge idol [96] I am!

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] is now friends with the scouting
idol-in-training known as Missy!

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text: [eb]I’m planning on becoming the next challenge idol.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]Which means I have to fight the current idol,
and beat her.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text: [eb]That’s why I entered the challenge.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]So anyway, shall we swap monsters?
I mean that’s what you’re here for, right?

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text: [eb]I first met Miss Solitaire on Palaish Isle.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]She looked SO cool, the way she squished those
slimes one after another.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]After that, I promised myself that one day, I would
become a super scout like her!

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]So anyway, shall we swap monsters?
I mean that’s what you’re here for, right?

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]You know, I think of Solitaire sort of like a big
sister, but my REAL big sister is a scout too.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]Of course, she’s nowhere NEAR as cool and
amazing as Solitaire...

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]I mean, all she cares about are her stupid cat
monsters!

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]Hmph. She really is useless when it comes to
scouting.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]So anyway, shall we swap monsters?
I mean that’s what you’re here for, right?

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]Isn’t that just like Solitaire? One minute she’s a
scout, the next she’s Commissioner of the MSO!

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]I really set my sights high when I picked her as my
rival!

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]Still, I’m not giving up.
One day, I’m going to be even bigger than Solitaire!

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]So anyway, shall we swap monsters?
I mean that’s what you’re here for, right?

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]Ha! I don’t believe you. I think you’re really
DESPERATE to swap monsters with me.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]So come ON.
Let’s just trade, okay?

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[eb]Hmph. Fine.
See if I care.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text: [eb]I never wanted your stupid monsters anyway!

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hmph. I suppose you think I’m just another
monster...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] No doubt you assumed that I’d somehow crept in
here when no one was looking, right?

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Well, if you must know, I’m an officially
registered contestant in the challenge.

k002.speaker: Missy
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] My name is Rapheal.
Pleased to meet you.

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text: [ea]Next time we meet, perhaps we can swap monsters.

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] is now friends with Rapheal, the
only scout slimier than Slimon!

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You were going to scout me, weren’t you?
Of course, you have a champion’s eye for monsters.

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text: [ea][a7][b0] But I’m afraid I’m not the scoutable type.

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] My name is Rapheal, and I’m a scout
just like yourself.

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text: [ea]Next time we meet, perhaps we can swap monsters?

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] is now friends with Rapheal, the
only scout slimier than Slimon!

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]Oh, hello my friend. I hope you’re doing well,
because I’m certainly not.

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]You see, I found this half-eaten sandwich,
and I was so VERY hungry...

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]Oh dear... [a8]RUMBLE[a9] M-My stomach feels like it’s
going to explode!

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]B-But I think I could just about manage a monster
exchange, if that’s what you want? [a8]RRRUMBLE[a9]

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]I’ve never told you my tale of woe, have I?
[f1][fb][fd]
You see, gambling ruined my life. I’m so mired in
debt that I fear I shall never again break even.

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]You mustn’t make the same mistake I did! Resist
the lure of the dice! Devote yourself to scouting!

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]...Though I suppose scouting is something of a
gamble too, when you think about it...

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]But enough about my woes! The demon debt can’t
prevent me from exchanging monsters! Shall we?

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]I really shouldn’t linger in Green Bays...
I should flee while I still have the chance.

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text: [ea]But I can’t just give up on my scouting dreams.

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text: [ea]No, only one course of action remains...

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]I’m going to have to win the challenge before the
debt collectors catch up with me!

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]And for that, I need a good team.
Shall we swap monsters?

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text: [ea]Thank heavens for this new commissioner!

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]Because of her, there’s still a chance I can win a
tournament and pay off my debts!

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]Oh, I’m so excited! Tonight, I’m going to celebrate
with a steaming bowl of spaghetti!
[f1][fb][fd]
Actually, the last time I did that, I ended up eating
one of my tentacles...

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text: [ea]Anyway, shall we swap monsters?

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea]Shhh! I know what you’re going to say...
But let’s just trade monsters anyway!

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text: [ea]Well you’re no fun at all.

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oh, hi there.
Are you competing in the challenge too?

k002.speaker: Rapheal
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] My name is Bob A. Job, but you can call me Bob.
I’m from the mainland.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]This is my first time in Green Bays, and frankly,
I’m a bit overwhelmed.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]I really need someone to show me the ropes.
Maybe you could help me out?

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] has made friends with the man from
the mainland, Bob A. Job!

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oh, hi there.
Are you competing in the challenge too?

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea][a7][b0] My name is Bob A. Job, but you can call me
Bob. I’m from the mainland.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]This is my first time in Green Bays, and frankly,
I’m a bit overwhelmed.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]I really need someone to show me the ropes.
Maybe you could help me out?

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] has made friends with the man from
the mainland, Bob A. Job!

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]When I exchange monsters, I always try to make
sure that they’re both of equal value.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]That’s fairest for everyone, as I’m sure you’ll
agree.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]I don’t know about here in Green Bays, but that’s
how we do things on the mainland.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]So, what do you say?
Shall we exchange monsters?

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]Normally, I like to collect monsters of the machine
family...

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]...but there doesn’t seem to be many of them here
in Green Bays.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]If you DO happen to find any, please come and see
me. Maybe we could make a deal.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]Speaking of which, would you like to swap
monsters?

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text: [ea]Before we get to trading, let me tell you a story.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]Once, a long time ago, I worked as a monster scout
for a certain kingdom.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]I became rather famous for it, in fact.
Famous and wealthy.
[f1][fb][fd]
And with wealth came women. LOTS of women.
I had everything I’d ever wanted.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]But what I didn’t have was freedom.
Scouting wasn’t fun any more, it was just a job.
[f1][fb][fd]
I longed to be answerable to no one, to live the
life of a wandering scout... So I gave it all up.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]It’s years since I left that life behind...
But I don’t regret what I did.
[f1][fb][fd]
I mean, who needs a mountain of money and hoards
of beautiful, willing, young[96] ARRRRRRGH!!!
[f1][fb][fd]
...Let’s change the subject, eh!?
How about we swap some wom[96] MONSTERS?

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]I heard about the catastrophe on Infern Isle.
Green Bays really is quite dangerous.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]But that’s exactly why it teems with such
abundant monster life.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]You see, every place has its good points and bad
points. Just like monsters.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]Which is why swapping monsters can be
advantageous to both parties. So, shall we?

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]Swapping monsters can help both our teams,
so why not?

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text: [ea]Yes, well, it’s your choice, I suppose.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[ea]But remember[b0] though you lose something in every
exchange, you gain something as well.

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[df][a7][b0] Ah, ye must be the young champion they call
[f5]?

k002.speaker: Bob A. Job
k002.text:
[df][a7][b0] My name be Rusty. They say I’m the oldest
active scout in these here islands.

k002.speaker: Rusty
k002.text:
[df]And ye be one of the youngest. Nought wrong with
that though. Ye seem like an honest young fellow.

k002.speaker: Rusty
k002.text:
[df]Well, I think that’s everything. Give me a shout if
you have anything you’d like to swap.

k002.speaker: Rusty
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] has made friends with the veteran
scout called Rusty!

k002.speaker: Rusty
k002.text:
[df]I’ve been a scout for nigh on fifty years, but I’ve
never been able to reach the top.

k002.speaker: Rusty
k002.text:
[df]I reckon ye be different though.
’Seems to me yer a natural born scout.

k002.speaker: Rusty
k002.text:
[df]You’ve already achieved a great deal at a very
young age...
[f1][fb][fd]
...but don’t let it go to yer head. Keep working at
it, and ye could be something really special.

k002.speaker: Rusty
k002.text: [df]...Now then, how about a little monster swap?

k002.speaker: Rusty
k002.text:
[df]I want to see how great ye can become.
Won’t you trade with me?

k002.speaker: Rusty
k002.text:
[df]So ye aren’t ready to trade?
I had you pegged as a more adventurous type.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb]Oh, it’s you.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb]Argh! Can’t you take a HINT!?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]I’m TRYING to forget that debacle of a finals,
you know.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]If we’d have been allowed to have a proper fight,
there’s no WAY you’d have won.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Still, my new challenge will give me the opportunity
to set the record straight.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Providing, of course, you actually manage to fulfil
the entry requirements!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]So what are you waiting for? You’ve got some
qualifying to do [96] go on, chop chop!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] renews his, er, acquaintance with
the charming scout named Solitaire.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb]Oh. You again?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]I suppose you think I’m here skipping work or
something.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Well, you’re wrong. Getting out to the islands is
one of my most important duties.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]As the Commissioner, I have to fight the scouts who
qualify for Solitaire’s Challenge.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]So it’s absolutely essential that I stick to my
training and keep myself sharp.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Anyway, now that you’re here, why don’t we trade
monsters?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Oh, I know what you’re up to [96] you’re playing hard
to get.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]You say ‘no’, but we both know you REALLY want
to say ‘yes’!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Tsk. And I had all these useless monsters I wanted
to get rid of...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]...Er, did I say that out loud? What I MEANT to say
was...
[f1][fb][fd]
...you are missing a GOLDEN opportunity, buster!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb]Oh, it’s you.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb]Argh! Can’t you take a HINT!?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]I’m TRYING to forget that debacle of a finals,
you know.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]If we’d have been allowed to have a proper fight,
there’s no WAY you’d have won.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Still, my new challenge will give me the opportunity
to set the record straight.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Providing, of course, you actually manage to fulfil
the entry requirements!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]So what are you waiting for? You’ve got some
qualifying to do [96] go on, chop chop!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[d0]1[f5] renews his, er, acquaintance with
the charming scout named Solitaire.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb]Listen, I’m going to tell you something for free.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]As you probably already suspect, I don’t like being
called Ginny Rummy.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text: [eb]Solitaire is my name, and that’s all there is to it.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb][a8]sigh[a9] That last challenge really was a nightmare.
It was all Mummy’s fault.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]She entered me in the challenge under my real
name [96] WITHOUT my permission!

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]That name just does NOT suit me. Solitaire is way
more my style, y’know?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Anyway, I’m telling you this as a favour.
It doesn’t go beyond the two of us...

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Now, let’s get down to business...
What do you say we trade monsters?

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]Oh, I know what you’re up to [96] you’re playing hard
to get.

k002.speaker: Solitaire
k002.text:
[eb]You say ‘no’, but we both know you REALLY want
to say ‘yes’!

k002.speaker: Solitaire

[eb]...Er, did I say that out loud? What I MEANT to say

[f1][fb][fd]
...you are missing a GOLDEN opportunity, buster!

s001.speaker: Wingle
s001.text:
[ea]Given a choice between fight and flight, you’d
choose to fight, right?

s001.speaker: Wingle
s001.text: [ea]Excellent choice.

s001.speaker: Wingle
s001.text: [ea]Chicken.

s001.speaker: Percy Weed
s001.text:
[ea]Er, excuse me.
Would you care for a battle?

s001.speaker: Percy Weed
s001.text: [ea]Oh, goody!

s001.speaker: Percy Weed
s001.text: [ea]Aw...

s001.speaker: Sebeastian
s001.text:
[ea]Hey, loser.
Wanna try and take me on?

s001.speaker: Sebeastian
s001.text:
[ea]Right.
You asked for it!

s001.speaker: Sebeastian
s001.text:
[ea]Aw, come on.
Don’t be a wuss.

s001.speaker: Sebeastian
s001.text:
[ea]Give me fight, pleeease!
Pleasepleasepleaseplease!

s001.speaker: Victoria
s001.text:
[eb]What, you want a battle?
Is that why you’re talking to me?

s001.speaker: Victoria
s001.text:
[eb]Suits me just fine.
Now show me what you got!

s001.speaker: Victoria
s001.text:
[eb]So, what then? Are you trying to pick me up?
I’m out of your league.

s001.speaker: Wyrma
s001.text:
[eb]Excuse me!
Could I tempt you to a little battle?

s001.speaker: Wyrma
s001.text:
[eb]Oh, thank you! But do be gentle with me, okay?
I haven’t done this too often.

s001.speaker: Wyrma
s001.text: [eb]Oh? Aren’t you feeling up to it?

s001.speaker: Orephelia
s001.text:
[eb]I-I’m no good at battles, you know.
I never win.

s001.speaker: Orephelia
s001.text: [eb]Do you really want to fight someone like me?

s001.speaker: Orephelia
s001.text: [eb]Well, please don’t hurt me.

s001.speaker: Orephelia
s001.text:
[eb]That’s right.
Fighting me wouldn’t be any fun.

s001.speaker: Nick
s001.text: [ea][a8]giggles[a9] Oh, looks like it’s my lucky day.

s001.speaker: Nick
s001.text: [ea]You and me, we fight, right?

s001.speaker: Nick
s001.text: [ea]Dinner time!

s001.speaker: Nick
s001.text: [ea]Pfft. I needed to make some cash, fast.

s001.speaker: Christough
s001.text:
[ea]In this world, power is everything.
We shall fight, young scout!

s001.speaker: Christough
s001.text: [ea]There can be only one!

s001.speaker: Christough
s001.text: [ea]Bah! What fun are you?

s001.speaker: Seedy Player
s001.text:
[ea]Hey, kid.
Do me a favour and fight me, okay?

s001.speaker: Seedy Player
s001.text:
[ea]Heheheh, now THAT’S what I’m talkin’ about...
The kid’s got guts!

s001.speaker: Seedy Player
s001.text:
[ea]Aw, come on.
Don’t make me beg!

s001.speaker: Fauna
s001.text:
[eb]Hey, sir?
Do you want to have a battle?

s001.speaker: Fauna
s001.text:
[eb]Yippee!
A battle, a battle!

s001.speaker: Fauna
s001.text:
[eb]Aw, but why? Come ON, PLEASE can we fight?
Just a little one!

s001.speaker: Milicia
s001.text:
[eb]Huh?
Excuse me, but are you flirting with me?

s001.speaker: Milicia
s001.text:
[eb]Oh, I see.
Well, I suppose a battle would be acceptable.

s001.speaker: Milicia
s001.text:
[eb][a8]chuckle[a9] A battle it is then.
But don’t think I’m going to go easy on you!

s001.speaker: Milicia
s001.text:
[eb]I beg your pardon!
Are you turning me down!?

s001.speaker: Maggie
s001.text:
[eb]Hmph. Nice hair.
You don’t look so tough.

s001.speaker: Maggie
s001.text:
[eb]I’ll give you a practice fight.
How about it, spiky head?

s001.speaker: Maggie
s001.text: [eb]Okay. Let me show you how it’s done!

s001.speaker: Maggie
s001.text: [eb]You won’t get any better if you don’t practise!

s001.speaker: Francis Drake
s001.text:
[ea]Ah, perfect timing!
I’m in the mood for a fight. Shall we?

s001.speaker: Francis Drake
s001.text:
[ea]Capital. Do your best, now!
I’d rather not embarrass you!

s001.speaker: Francis Drake
s001.text: [ea]Alas, a missed opportunity if ever there was one.

s001.speaker: Kelvin Klein
s001.text: [ea]Yo, kid. Wanna fight?

s001.speaker: Kelvin Klein
s001.text: [ea]Bring it on!

s001.speaker: Kelvin Klein
s001.text: [ea]Pathetic.

s001.speaker: Norm
s001.text:
[ea]Our paths have crossed. There’s no going back.
We’ve no choice now but to FIGHT!

s001.speaker: Norm
s001.text:
[ea]Enough talking.
Let battle commence!

s001.speaker: Norm
s001.text:
[ea]You’re refusing me?
And you call yourself a scout!

s001.speaker: Daisy
s001.text:
[eb]You want a piece of me?
Come and get it, if you dare.

s001.speaker: Daisy
s001.text:
[eb]Excellent.
This might prove to be...stimulating.

s001.speaker: Daisy
s001.text:
[eb]Fine.
If you don’t think you can handle me...

s001.speaker: Sweetie
s001.text:
[eb]Hey, you’re a cutie.
I’ll be your sparring partner, if you like.

s001.speaker: Sweetie
s001.text:
[eb][a8]snigger[a9] Okay, but that was your last chance to
turn me down!

s001.speaker: Sweetie
s001.text: [eb]Still too young, huh?

s001.speaker: Destiny
s001.text: [eb]I think fate has brought us together today.

s001.speaker: Destiny
s001.text: [eb]We must do battle.

s001.speaker: Destiny
s001.text: [eb]Yes. Let us follow the path and discover our fate.

s001.speaker: Destiny
s001.text: [eb]You cannot escape destiny.

s001.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s001.text:
[df]Well aren’t you a lively-looking young fellow!
Wilhelm Splitz at your service.

s001.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s001.text:
[df]What’s that? You want to fight an old codger like
me!?

s001.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s001.text:
[df][a8]chuckle[a9] I still have a few tricks up my sleeve,
young ’un!

s001.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s001.text:
[df]Is that so?
Hm, I didn’t take you to be a coward...

s001.speaker: Gardini
s001.text:
[df]I may not look it, but I’m a scout jus’ like
yerself. Fancy a fight?

s001.speaker: Gardini
s001.text:
[df]Right then! Get ready to find out why yer
oughta respect yer elders!

s001.speaker: Gardini
s001.text:
[df][a8]laugh[a9]
Children these days have got no backbone!

s001.speaker: Grandead
s001.text:
[df]When two scouts cross paths, nothing can
prevent them from...from...err...

s001.speaker: Grandead
s001.text:
[df]Now, what is it...?
Ah, I remember [96] from FIGHTING!

s001.speaker: Grandead
s001.text:
[df]I’m jolly strong, you know.
You’ll not get the better of me!

s001.speaker: Grandead
s001.text:
[df]What, you won’t fight, you say?
Bah, kids these days...

s001.speaker: Grandead
s001.text: Fight this scout?

s011.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s011.text:
[df]Well aren’t you a lively-looking young fellow!
Wilhelm Splitz at your service.

s011.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s011.text:
[df]What’s that? You want to fight an old codger like
me!?

s011.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s011.text:
[df][a8]chuckle[a9] I still have a few tricks up my sleeve,
young ’un!

s011.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s011.text:
[df]Is that so?
Hm, I didn’t take you to be a coward...

s011.speaker: Gardini
s011.text:
[df]I may not look it, but I’m a scout jus’ like
yerself. Fancy a fight?

s011.speaker: Gardini
s011.text:
[df]Right then! Get ready to find out why yer
oughta respect yer elders!

s011.speaker: Gardini
s011.text:
[df][a8]laugh[a9]
Children these days have got no backbone!

s011.speaker: Grandead
s011.text:
[df]When two scouts cross paths, nothing can
prevent them from...from...err...

s011.speaker: Grandead
s011.text:
[df]Now, what is it...?
Ah, I remember [96] from FIGHTING!

s011.speaker: Grandead
s011.text:
[df]I’m jolly strong, you know.
You’ll not get the better of me!

s011.speaker: Grandead
s011.text:
[df]What, you won’t fight, you say?
Bah, kids these days...

s011.speaker: Grandead
s011.text: Fight this scout?
