[ea][a7][b0] Monsters are so fierce and hard to tame
because they have dark matter inside them.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] At least, that’s what I heard an MSO suit
saying. Maybe it’s a kind of poison?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Until the finals begin, you’re allowed to visit
any of the seven islands.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But remember, you have to bring back ten
darkonium crystals.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You can find darkonium in blue treasure chests,
apparently.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] One theory says that these blue chests are the
remains of dead mimics.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] It happened quite a while ago now...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...but I was just thinking about the dog-like
monster that broke into HQ.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I wonder what it wanted.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Madame Rummy loves to watch young scouts
workin’ up a sweat on Palaish Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I can’t imagine why.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s no skin off my nose though.
We all have our hobbies.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Have you had a look around the department
store on the main street?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They sell some pretty interestin’ things.
Like skill scrolls, for example.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What’s that? You don’t know what the goal is?
Er, it’s Baden’s Bell, on the upper floor of HQ.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I used to have quite a reputation in scouting
circles. They called me the Dancing Dumpling...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] A lot of my success was down to the fact that
I wasn’t afraid to experiment. You should try it.
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] Have a go at combining a monster of the dragon
family with a slime. You might be surprised!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] From this jetty, you can go to Xeroph Isle and
Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] It’s up to you where you want to go...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] ...but if it were me, I’d go to Xeroph Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Infern Isle is very dangerous, especially for an
amateur like yourself.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] From this jetty, you can go to Xeroph Isle and
Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] More and more scouts are heading for Infern
Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They must be getting stronger if they think they
can handle Danger Level C!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] This here’s the way into the sewers...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s no place for kids.
I’d stay up here where it’s safe, if I were you.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m not in the challenge, but it’s fun just to
soak up the carnival atmosphere.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Darkonium crystals are SO pretty, don’t you
think?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s such a shame we have to hand them over to
the MSO.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] It happened quite a while ago now...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...but I was just thinking about the dog-like
monster that broke into HQ.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I wonder what it wanted.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Maybe I’ll go and grab a bite to eat at the Mess
Hall...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Lots of scouts like to relax in there.
It’s a good place to pick up challenge gossip.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]NEWSFLASH! Scouts stampede to Palaish Isle,
the most popular island in Green Bays!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]But can they solve the puzzle of the shrine?
Find out next time!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Department store reopens for business!
All scouts welcome!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You know how they don’t have a scoutpost on
Infern Isle?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well, I heard it’s because of some sort of
natural disaster that happened there years ago.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[df][a7][b0] Most of the people on this island look wealthy
and contented.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[df][a7][b0] But there are always a few unfortunate souls
who fall through the cracks.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [df][a7][b0] On Domus Isle, they lurk down in the sewers.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The finals are broadcast live all over the
island.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Each of the challengers attracts their own set
of supporters, so it gets pretty wild around here.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] This is the seventh Monster Scout Challenge
ever to be held.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] In the beginning, there weren’t many competitors
at all [96] it was all very low-key.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But once sponsorship money started pouring in,
it quickly became a major event.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I was talking to this bloke who came here from
the mainland...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] He said he’s never seen as many monsters as
here in Green Bays.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What’s that? You don’t know what the goal is?
Er, it’s Baden’s Bell, on the upper floor of HQ.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Have you heard of a challenge contestant
called Rummy?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well apparently, that scout has the
backing of the MSO sponsor.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] That’s all we know [96] we have no other
records about him...or her.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The suits won’t let anyone in to see the
Commissioner.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Oh, that is SUCH old news!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] What I hear is that he has a new receptionist.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] And she’s letting anything with a pulse in to
see him.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The scouts are congregating in town, looking for
an audience with the Commissioner.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’d think they’d have more important things to
do [96] like winning the challenge!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] This here’s the way into the sewers...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s no place for kids.
I’d stay up here where it’s safe, if I were you.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Why not pay the Commissioner a visit, if you
haven’t already?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] In case you didn’t know, he won the first ever
challenge.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You certainly wouldn’t want to miss a chance
to pick his brains on the secrets of his success.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Until the finals begin, you’re allowed to visit
any of the seven islands.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But remember, you have to bring back ten
darkonium crystals.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Breaking news! Scouts flock to Domus Isle to
meet Commissioner Snap!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]First opportunity in years to shake hands with
the Great One himself!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s a rich lady from Palaish Isle who
sponsors the challenge.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Seein’ as how she owns the whole bloomin’
island, she can afford to be generous.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Domus Isle is thriving thanks to the Monster
Scout Organisation.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] This place used to be a dump.
No one came here except lowlifes and losers.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Glup, glop, guloop!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hey, guess what!
I went to see Uncle Snap, the Commissioner!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But when I asked him for a battle, he said he
was too busy...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] How does the department store get away with
charging those prices?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What are regular folks supposed to do?
Just drool on the display cases?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Green Bays is made up of seven islands...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...but Domus Isle is the only one with a proper
town.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Most of the other islands just have scoutposts
[96] oh, and the occasional palace.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[df][a7][b0] Most of the people on this island look wealthy
and contented.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[df][a7][b0] But there are always a few unfortunate souls
who fall through the cracks.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[df][a7][b0] They prefer to hide down in the sewers, out of
the glare of the sun...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I invited the Commissioner to the matchmaker’s,
but he turned me down.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...MONSTER Matchmakers, that is.
So you can wipe that smirk off your face.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Have you met the Commissioner’s new
receptionist? She’s VERY friendly.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The snooty guy she replaced wouldn’t let ANY-
ONE see Snap, so she’s definitely an improvement.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Are you going to visit the Commissioner too?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Oh. Well try not to disturb him unnecessarily.
He’s a very busy man.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s not right that scouts like you take up all
his time.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well, I think you should. Opportunities like these
don’t present themselves very often.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You can find darkonium in blue treasure chests,
apparently.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] One theory says that these blue chests are the
remains of dead mimics.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What’s that? You don’t know what the goal is?
Er, it’s Baden’s Bell, on the upper floor of HQ.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The suits won’t let anyone in to see the
Commissioner.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Oh, that is SUCH old news!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] What I hear is that he has a new receptionist.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] And she’s letting anything with a pulse in to
see him.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The scouts are congregating in town, looking for
an audience with the Commissioner.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’d think they’d have more important things to
do [96] like winning the challenge!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] This here’s the way into the sewers...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s no place for kids.
I’d stay up here where it’s safe, if I were you.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Why not pay the Commissioner a visit, if you
haven’t already?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] In case you didn’t know, he won the first ever
challenge.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You certainly wouldn’t want to miss a chance
to pick his brains on the secrets of his success.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I have a feeling that this challenge is going to
be very special...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I think it’s because of Rummy.
There’s something about that scout...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Breaking news! Scouts flock to Domus Isle to
meet Commissioner Snap!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]First opportunity in years to shake hands with
the Great One himself!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s a rich lady from Palaish Isle who
sponsors the challenge.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Seein’ as how she owns the whole bloomin’
island, she can afford to be generous.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I invited the Commissioner to the matchmaker’s,
but he turned me down.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...MONSTER Matchmakers, that is.
So you can wipe that smirk off your face.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You know how they don’t have a scoutpost on
Infern Isle?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well, I heard it’s because of some sort of
natural disaster that happened there years ago.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[df][a7][b0] Most of the people on this island look wealthy
and contented.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[df][a7][b0] But there are always a few unfortunate souls
who fall through the cracks.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [df][a7][b0] On Domus Isle, they lurk down in the sewers.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Are you going to visit the Commissioner too?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Oh. Well try not to disturb him unnecessarily.
He’s a very busy man.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s not right that scouts like you take up all
his time.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well, I think you should. Opportunities like these
don’t present themselves very often.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Have you met the Commissioner’s new
receptionist? She’s VERY friendly.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The snooty guy she replaced wouldn’t let ANY-
ONE see Snap, so she’s definitely an improvement.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Darkonium crystals are SO pretty, don’t you
think?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s such a shame we have to hand them over to
the MSO.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What’s that? You don’t know what the goal is?
Er, it’s Baden’s Bell, on the upper floor of HQ.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] If you have ten darkonium crystals, go to the
bell tower at HQ.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You must ring Baden’s Bell before you can
advance to the finals.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Have you been down to the sewers yet?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Then you probably know there’s a weapon shop
down there, right?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They sell stuff you won’t find in any of the
scoutposts, or the department store for that matter.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So what are you waiting for?
You HAVE to visit the weapon shop down there.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You can get to the sewers through the tunnel
below the west gate of the city.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I heard you can get to the north side of Celeste
Isle from Infant Isle...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...but there’s this gate blockin’ access to
the jetty.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Sounds to me like a proper bleedin’ nuisance.
I don’t know who, but SOMEONE should open it!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The scouts are sayin’ the route between Infant
Isle and Celeste Isle is finally open.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I don’t know who finally opened that gate,
but it was about bleedin’ time someone did!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, kid. You should have a look around in the
sewers some time.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’ll really see a different side to this town.
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] There’s an entrance down by the west gate,
if you’re interested.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Security has really tightened.
Now no one can get in to see the Commissioner.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] Missed my chance again.
I really wanted to talk to old Snap.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Do you know what? I think that mysterious
Rummy character is going to qualify first.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] I bet he’s a great, big brute of a scout!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I used to have quite a reputation in scouting
circles. They called me the Dancing Dumpling...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] A lot of my success was down to the fact that
I wasn’t afraid to experiment. You should try it.
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] Why not mix a monster of the undead family
with a green dragon? You might be surprised!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You have to be as rich as royalty to shop at
the department store.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I’m tired of being poor.
Maybe I should become a scout?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I heard the Commissioner actually left his office
the other day.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Oh, that is SUCH old news!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] While he was out, someone broke in and robbed
him. Well, I say someone...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...but I bet it was the receptionist.
She’s vanished, you know!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Crisis in the MSO! Commissioner swears[b0]
‘The challenge will go on!’

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Scouts make dash for the islands in desperate
bid to find final pieces of darkonium!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Glup, glop, guloop!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] My slime ran away again.
But I wasn’t THAT strict with him...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Maybe he thinks playing hide-and-seek is part
of his training?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] A scout dropped out of the challenge and
opened a weapon shop down in the sewers.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] They say he sells some interesting things, but,
ewww, who wants to go down there...?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We’ve had reports of challenge contestants
being attacked by pirates.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Make sure you read the advisories in the
scouts’ dens.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Green Bays is made up of seven islands...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...but Domus Isle is the only one with a proper
town.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Most of the other islands just have scoutposts
[96] oh, and the occasional palace.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The suits’ve been hasslin’ the sewer folk.
They’re lookin’ for Snap’s stuff, I reckon.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Or maybe they think the criminals are hidin’
down there?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Every time a crime happens topside, it’s always
the same [96] blame the sewer folk!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] From this jetty, you can go to Xeroph Isle and
Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Xeroph Isle has a battle arena,
and Infern Isle has...practically nothing.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] From this jetty, you can go to Xeroph Isle and
Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Xeroph Isle has a battle arena,
and Infern Isle has...practically nothing.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Have you been down to the sewers yet?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Then you probably know there’s a weapon shop
down there, right?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They sell stuff you won’t find in any of the
scoutposts, or the department store for that matter.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So what are you waiting for?
You HAVE to visit the weapon shop down there.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] The entrance to the sewers is just over there.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The suits’ve been hasslin’ the sewer folk.
They’re lookin’ for Snap’s stuff, I reckon.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Or maybe they think the criminals are hidin’
down there?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Every time a crime happens topside, it’s always
the same [96] blame the sewer folk!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I sense that this challenge is going have a few
surprises...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] It must be that scout Rummy...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s a challenger called Slimon who is
OBSESSED with slimes.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And if the experts are to be believed, he’s odds
on to make it to the finals.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Crisis in the MSO! Commissioner swears[b0]
‘The challenge will go on!’

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Scouts make dash for the islands in desperate
bid to find final pieces of darkonium!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I heard you can get to the north side of Celeste
Isle from Infant Isle...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...but there’s this gate blockin’ access to
the jetty.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Sounds to me like a proper bleedin’ nuisance.
I don’t know who, but SOMEONE should open it!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The scouts are sayin’ the route between Infant
Isle and Celeste Isle is finally open.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I don’t know who finally opened that gate,
but it was about bleedin’ time someone did!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Bleeeurgh... [a8]rumble[a9]
Those f-frogs’ legs were a bad idea...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I should’ve known a [a8]rumble[a9] c-cafeteria in the
s-sewers would have hygiene issues... [a8]RRRUMBLE[a9]

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But it was so cheap! I couldn’t resist ordering [56]
la c-carte... [a8]RUMBLE[a9] Oooh...I think I’m[96] BLEURGH!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I was attacked by pirates while I was riding my
scooter...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]fume[a9] What I wouldn’t give to see that Captain
Crow walk his own plank!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The finals are broadcast live all over the
island.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Each of the challengers attracts their own set
of supporters, so it gets pretty wild around here.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Pirates have been ambushing sea scooter traffic.
Be careful out there.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You can check the noticeboards in the scouts’
den for info on the danger areas.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] [a8]shrug[a9] But no matter how careful you are,
sometimes it’s just not your day.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] A scout dropped out of the challenge and
opened a weapon shop down in the sewers.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] They say he sells some interesting things, but,
ewww, who wants to go down there...?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] If you have ten darkonium crystals, go to the
bell tower at HQ.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You must ring Baden’s Bell before you can
advance to the finals.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] From this jetty, you can go to Xeroph Isle and
Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Xeroph Isle has a battle arena,
and Infern Isle has...practically nothing.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The suits’ve been hasslin’ the sewer folk.
They’re lookin’ for Snap’s stuff, I reckon.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Or maybe they think the criminals are hidin’
down there?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Every time a crime happens topside, it’s always
the same [96] blame the sewer folk!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I think this challenge is nearing its endgame.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Any day now, the first scouts are going to be
ringing that bell...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Oh, that is SUCH old news!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Some contestants have ALREADY reached the
goal! Only a few spots remain...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...and if we don’t finish in the top five,
neither of us will be in the finals!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Newsflash! Contestants reach the goal with ten
darkonium crystals!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Only a few finals spots remain!
Tension levels hit new high!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The five scouts who reach the goal first face
an even tougher challenge...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] They have to fight each other until someone
wins four bouts in row!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The names of the finalists aren’t announced
until all five have reached the goal.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It helps keep the fans on the edge of their seats
right to the end.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I reckon the finalists are gonna be decided any
moment now.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’d better get a move on if you want to be
one of them...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It was VERY pricey, but I bought a steel
broadsword at the department store.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It was a bit of an impulse buy actually...
I’ve no idea what I’m going to do with it!
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] Perhaps I should become a scout?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] The qualifiers will be finishing very soon.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Everyone is making a last mad dash for the
finish [96] good luck to you!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Someone told me the bell rang a few times
while I was on the other islands.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Do you know what that means!? It means some
scouts have already reached the goal!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I definitely want to be here when they announce
the finalists.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Once I see who they are, I’ll be able to pick the
winner no problem.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If you’ve got the ten crystals, make a beeline
for Baden’s Bell!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You can’t be worryin’ about trainin’ your
monsters now!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’ll be plenty of time for that once you’ve
made it to the finals.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] All the scouts have to hand in the darkonium
they collect.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Even the ones who don’t reach the goal.
That’s going to be a lot of darkonium!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well, it’s not worth anything anyway,
so I suppose it doesn’t matter.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Ooh, I can’t wait!
The finals are always SO exciting!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] I bet the fur will be flying this year!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I used to have quite a reputation in scouting
circles. They called me the Dancing Dumpling...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] A lot of my success was down to the fact that
I wasn’t afraid to experiment. You should try it.
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] Have a go at combining a seasaur with a Hades
condor. You might be surprised!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] If you have ten darkonium crystals, go to the
bell tower at HQ.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You must ring Baden’s Bell before you can
advance to the finals.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] From this jetty, you can go to Xeroph Isle and
Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Xeroph Isle has a battle arena,
and Infern Isle has...practically nothing.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I like your face, kid.
You seem like the responsible type.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I reckon the sewer folk wouldn’t mind havin’
you around. In you go then, and have fun!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Newsflash! Contestants reach the goal with ten
darkonium crystals!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Only a few finals spots remain!
Tension levels hit new high!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I wonder if that Slimon guy will make it to the
finals? It’d be great to see his slimes in action.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I see his name a lot on the leader board, so he
must be in with a chance.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Wow, can you believe that Rum[96]

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...Er, never mind. You’re not in the MSO.
I shouldn’t be talking to you.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] A scout dropped out of the challenge and
opened a weapon shop down in the sewers.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] They say he sells some interesting things, but,
ewww, who wants to go down there...?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If you’ve got the ten crystals, make a beeline
for Baden’s Bell!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You can’t be worryin’ about trainin’ your
monsters now!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’ll be plenty of time for that once you’ve
made it to the finals.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Bleeeurgh... [a8]rumble[a9]
Those f-frogs’ legs were a bad idea...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I should’ve known a [a8]rumble[a9] c-cafeteria in the
s-sewers would have hygiene issues... [a8]RRRUMBLE[a9]

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But it was so cheap! I couldn’t resist ordering a
la c-carte... [a8]RUMBLE[a9] Oooh...I think I’m[96] BLEURGH!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Someone told me the bell rang a few times
while I was on the other islands.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Do you know what that means!? It means some
scouts have already reached the goal!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] Did you hear Baden’s Bell ringing?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The townspeople cheered, but for challenge
contestants, it’s like a death knell.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Even if I can’t reach the finals, I’d at least like
to watch them.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But tickets cost an arm and a leg. I’m going to
need to make some serious cash on Celeste Isle...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Just the other day, I was lookin’ up at the
clouds over Infern Isle...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...when I saw a faint red spot [96] like a stain on
the sky, it was.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It couldn’t have been a star ’cause it was right
in the middle of the day.
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] It was really, you know, ominous. Made me think
of the ancient disaster that happened there.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] If you have ten darkonium crystals, go to the
bell tower at HQ.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You must ring Baden’s Bell before you can
advance to the finals.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hey, [f5]!
Good luck with your final preparations!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Apparently, the fifth qualifier has rung the bell.
Can’t wait to find out who made it to the finals!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Oh, that is SUCH old news!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] The five top finishers were announced AGES ago!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] They’re already in training for the finals.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m definitely going to watch the finals, but I
won’t be supporting anyone.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I mean, all these challenge scouts are just
big-headed posers, aren’t they.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The department store has bought in new stock
especially for the finalists.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Maybe this would be a good time to improve your
team’s equipment.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Congratulations on making it to the finals, kid.
Here’s a tip to give you a fighting chance...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...Try synthesising a merman and an archdemon.
The result might surprise you!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I didn’t make it into the finals, but I’m definitely
going to watch them.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I spent all my savings travelling here from the
mainland, so it’d be stupid not to.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I went to the department store to buy some
Parmesan cheese...
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...but ended up with a partisan by mistake.
I, er, thought it seemed a bit expensive at the time...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Anyway, I’m stuck with it now, so I use it to stir
my spaghetti.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] What the[96] I almost got it on my shoes!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] What are you doin’, sneakin’ up on a guy like
that?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Er, would you mind goin’ somewhere else?
I can’t...y’know...with people watchin’...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Where do you reckon the finalists have gone to
train their monsters?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I bet they’re all on Palaish Isle, practising in
the Old Maid’s garden.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I couldn’t find enough darkonium in time to reach
the finals...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...so now I’m just like one of the townspeople.
All I can do is watch.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Sad, but true.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I’m sick of this stupid challenge...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...Oh, you’re a finalist, aren’t you.
What I mean is, I’m tired of losing...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But I suppose it’s not the end of the world.
There’ll be another challenge soon enough...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] I hope I have better luck next year...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Finals ready to begin!
Contestants make last-minute preparations!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I bumped into this dodgy-lookin’ bloke in a black
hood the other day.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I tried askin’ him what he wanted, but I couldn’t
understand a bleedin’ word he said!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] My whole village pitched in to help pay my
entry fees and expenses.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] How am I going to tell them that I didn’t even
make it to the finals?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hey, [f5]!
Good luck with your final preparations!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I’m looking forward to watching Rummy fight.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The finishing order doesn’t matter once you’re in
the finals.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] It’s a whole new game, and all bets are off!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Congratulations on making it to the finals, kid.
Here’s a tip to give you a fighting chance...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...Try synthesising a merman and an archdemon.
The result might surprise you!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I grew up on Infern Isle. Couldn’t stand the
place though [96] left as soon as I was old enough.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There seems to be more dark matter there than
anywhere else in Green Bays.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I think that’s why it’s so depressing.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I didn’t make it into the finals, but I’m definitely
going to watch them.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I spent all my savings travelling here from the
mainland, so it’d be stupid not to.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I bumped into this dodgy-lookin’ bloke in a black
hood the other day.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I tried askin’ him what he wanted, but I couldn’t
understand a bleedin’ word he said!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I was SO sure I would win the challenge and
get the Scout’s Mark!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What I wouldn’t give to have a weapon like
that!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I can COMPLETELY understand why the Old Maid
is into metal king slimes.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I mean, who wouldn’t be? All that shiny
round silver goodness [96] they’re lovely!

Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m definitely going to watch the finals, but I
won’t be supporting anyone.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I mean, all these challenge scouts are just
big-headed posers, aren’t they.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:

especially for the finalists.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:

team’s equipment.

[f1][fb][fd]

that?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Where do you reckon the finalists have gone to
train their monsters?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I bet they’re all on Palaish Isle, practising in
the Old Maid’s garden.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...so now I’m just like one of the townspeople.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Sad, but true.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] I’m sick of this stupid challenge...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But I suppose it’s not the end of the world.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] I hope I have better luck next year...

s021.text:

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]This just in! [d0]1[f5] named seventh Monster
Scout Challenge champion!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They sell some unbelievably expensive weapons
at the department store.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I wonder if anyone can actually afford them.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I always thought the challenge was just a
stupid tourist attraction.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] But not any more [96] it’s seriously exciting!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The only reason that kid won the challenge
was because of that strange monster in his team.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If I had a monster like that, I could’ve won it!
Hmph. Some people get all the luck...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Oh, that is SUCH old news!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Didn’t you hear?
The Commissioner has that monster now.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I wonder how he persuaded that kid to part
with it? Seems a bit suspicious, if you ask me.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The first time I saw you, I knew you had
something special.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Champions always have a certain look about
them [96] something in the eyes.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] What’s that? You want to know if the
Commissioner passed by this way?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] [a8]shrug[a9] Nope. Not as far as I can recall.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Assuming I didn’t miss him, he must have
gone north, so try that part of the island.
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] And if you still can’t find him, the chances are
he left by the north jetty.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Oh, hello, [f5].
Are you looking for the Commissioner?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Last time I saw him, he was walking towards
the jetty for Infant Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Don’t tell me he left without presenting you
with your prize?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Did you see that Old Maid Rummy was in the
stands?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’ve never seen her outside her palace before.
How did she get through the doors?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I watched you fight, kid.
Those were some tough battles.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’ve seen a fair few finals in my time, but
never so fiercely contested.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Well, the challenge is over, so I suppose it’s
time for me to go home.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You should probably be heading back too.
I bet your mother’s worried about you.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oooh, that MSO bird’s a right stunner!
I think I’m in love...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]This just in! [d0]1[f5] named seventh Monster
Scout Challenge champion!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I always thought the challenge was just a
stupid tourist attraction.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] But not any more [96] it’s seriously exciting!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Okay, I think I’ve been here long enough.
I’m off!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But I reckon I’ll be back for the next scout
challenge.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Until then, ‘Do Your Best’, Monster Scout.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hi, [f5]!
I watched you fight.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Considering that was your first time, you were
truly amazing!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The first time I saw you, I knew you had
something special.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Champions always have a certain look about
them [96] something in the eyes.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] What’s that? You want to know if the
Commissioner passed by this way?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] [a8]shrug[a9] Nope. Not as far as I can recall.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Assuming I didn’t miss him, he must have
gone north, so try that part of the island.
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] And if you still can’t find him, the chances are
he left by the north jetty.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Something terrible is happening on Infern Isle!
Th-The sky has turned as black as night!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] A-And earthquakes too [96] one after another!
You have to believe me!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] If we hadn’t fled Infern Isle when we did,
I’m certain we’d be dead now...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We’re lucky to be alive. But I can’t help
wondering....are we going to be safe here?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oh, come off it.
They’re just imagining things.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s no way the sky could turn pitch black
in the middle of the day.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Yeah, I always knew that island was bad
news.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I reckon the Commissioner just couldn’t take the
pressure no more.
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] Must’ve decided anywhere was better than here.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I don’t think we’ll be seeing him again.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Oh, that is SUCH old news!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] People are saying that the Commissioner went to
investigate the disaster on Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Breaking news! Disaster strikes Infern Isle [96]
MSO issues travel warning!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I wish they’d get their act together and
announce a new challenge.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’m going to enter the next challenge and show
the scouts how it’s REALLY done.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I heard there was some sort of natural disaster
on Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I hope we’re safe here...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I’ve decided that I’m going to enter the next
challenge.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] But when is it going to start?
The MSO seems to be taking its sweet time...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I feel sorry for the MSO guys...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The moment the Commissioner wanders off,
all hell breaks lose.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Speaking of which [96] he was also away when
that robbery happened, right?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Back in the day, the other scouts feared me.
They called me the ‘Dancing Dumpling’.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s been a while, but I think the time’s come for
the Dumpling’s return. The next challenge is mine!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Reports of the disaster came in just after that
black monster was seen flying towards Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] I can’t believe it’s a coincidence.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I heard that the Commissioner left to investigate
the disaster on Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] At least, that’s what the MSO guys are saying.
And why would they lie?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I’d love to see you in action again.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s been ages since the challenge ended.
I can barely remember it.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I thought I’d never forget those finals.
But as time goes by, the memories fade...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Ah, hello, [f5].
Did you find the Commissioner?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Actually, we’re looking for him too.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Until the Commissioner gets back, we can’t move
on the Infern Isle situation.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Dr Snap couldn’t have left at a worse time...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Do you believe he went to Infern Isle to
investigate? ...Or do you think he’s abandoned us?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We invented a new phrase for when a scout
gets disqualified in a battle...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] We call it ‘pulling a Solitaire’!
Make sure you use it, okay?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[df][a7][b0] This powerful gale is blowing towards yonder
Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[df][a7][b0] I’ve got friends on that island.
I hope they’re safe.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I can’t say anything about the disaster on Infern
Isle until I’ve seen it for myself.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If it’s true what the evacuees are sayin’, then
it’s definitely something out of the ordinary.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Well, as long as this place is safe, Infern Isle
could sink into the ocean for all I care.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] ...Or is that the wrong thing to say?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hi, [f5]!
I watched you fight.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Considering that was your first time, you were
truly amazing!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Breaking news! Disaster strikes Infern Isle [96]
MSO issues travel warning!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Did you see that Old Maid Rummy was in the
stands?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’ve never seen her outside her palace before.
How did she get through the doors?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I feel sorry for the MSO guys...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The moment the Commissioner wanders off,
all hell breaks lose.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Speaking of which [96] he was also away when
that robbery happened, right?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]shiver[a9] Blimey, the loo gets cold at night.
It’s enough to put a man off!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] What, you think that’s funny?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Maybe I could be a scout over on the mainland?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Although it’s pretty good here on the islands.
You get to live like a sports star.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The challenge gives new scouts the perfect
opportunity to hone their skills.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] And once they’ve fought the best in Green Bays,
they’re ready to head out into the wilds beyond.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [df][a7][b0] You’re the champion, aren’t you.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[df][a7][b0] You stood head and shoulders over all them
other scouts.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[df][a7][b0] Never forget what you achieved here, do you
hear me?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I’d love to see you in action again.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s been ages since the challenge ended.
I can barely remember it.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I thought I’d never forget those finals.
But as time goes by, the memories fade...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Ah, hello, [f5].
Did you find the Commissioner?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Actually, we’re looking for him too.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Until the Commissioner gets back, we can’t move
on the Infern Isle situation.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Dr Snap couldn’t have left at a worse time...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Do you believe he went to Infern Isle to
investigate? ...Or do you think he’s abandoned us?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] I’ve been looking for you all over the place.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You have to go straight to HQ.
The Commissioner is anxious to see you.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You haven’t just come from Infern Isle,
have you?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Well anyway, it looks like the crisis there is
over.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The people who fled earlier were saying it was
the end of the world or something.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I was starting to worry that something bad was
going to happen to Domus Isle too.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oh, is that right?
You’ve been to Infern Isle?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But did ya hear!? They say it’s crawling with
new, more powerful monsters now!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Last time anyone saw him, Commissioner Snap
was headed for Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Since then, nothing. You don’t think he got caught
up in that disaster, do you?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Oh, that is SUCH old news!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What I heard is that the Commissioner knew the
disaster was coming...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...and that he went to Infern Isle to try and
prevent it.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I wish there was some way for me to get close
to Miss Croupier.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] Unrequited love is no fun...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Newsflash!
MSO announces new Commissioner!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, champ.
Where’s your sidekick?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You know, that white dog thing you always had
with you.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] It’s strange seeing you without him at your side.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hey, it’s the champion!
Did you hear?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The MSO got a new Commissioner while you
were away!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] The department store is temporarily closed.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well, it WAS open for the entire duration of the
challenge. I suppose they need to close sometimes.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s been a long time since Commissioner Snap
left...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] ...but the MSO has finally named a replacement.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They made an announcement just the other day.
I’m not sure they picked the right person...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I saw the Commissioner leaving HQ just after
the challenge ended.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I suppose he must’ve been on his way to Infern
Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Things are never dull around here.
It’s one crisis after another...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You know, if it were always like this, living in
Green Bays wouldn’t be so bad.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] I’ve been looking for you all over the place.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You have to go straight to HQ.
The Commissioner is anxious to see you.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I have to go to Infern Isle to see the aftermath
of the disaster for myself.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I always thought of it as a depressing back-
water where nothing ever happened, but not now!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oh, is that right?
You’ve been to Infern Isle?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’ve got guts, kid.
That’s prob’ly why you’re the champ.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] What exactly did the Commissioner think he
could do about a disaster like that?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Pray to the weather gods?
Do a voodoo dance?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hi, [f5]!
I watched you fight.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Considering that was your first time, you were
truly amazing!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Even when I do get a chance to speak to her,
all she wants to talk about is the news.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Blast it!
I want to get to know the REAL Canasta!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Newsflash!
MSO announces new Commissioner!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Rumour has it that the new commissioner bought
out the whole of the MSO for a huge heap of cash.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Who the heck is rich enough to BUY the MSO!?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s been a long time since Commissioner Snap
left...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] ...but the MSO has finally named a replacement.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They made the announcement the other day.
Not too sure about their choice though...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s no way Dr Snap is dead. It’d take more
than a little disaster to finish him off.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] My theory is he went to the mainland to find
some new monsters.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What’s that? You want to know how to get to
Infant Isle? ...Seriously?
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...Er, you just take a sea scooter from the north
jetty...or am I missing something here?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You haven’t just come from Infern Isle,
have you?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Well anyway, it looks like the crisis there is
over.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The people who fled earlier were saying it was
the end of the world or something.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I was starting to worry that something bad was
going to happen to Domus Isle too.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oh, is that right?
You’ve been to Infern Isle?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’ve got guts, kid.
That’s prob’ly why you’re the champ.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Last time anyone saw him, Commissioner Snap
was headed for Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Since then, nothing. You don’t think he got caught
up in that disaster, do you?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Oh, that is SUCH old news!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What I heard is that the Commissioner knew the
disaster was coming...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] ...and that he went to Infern Isle to try and
prevent it.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I wish there was some way for me to get close
to Miss Croupier.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] Unrequited love is no fun...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Newsflash!
MSO announces new Commissioner!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey, champ.
Where’s your sidekick?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You know, that white dog thing you always had
with you.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] It’s strange seeing you without him at your side.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hey, it’s the champion!
Did you hear?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The MSO got a new Commissioner while you
were away!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] SLURRRP.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] The department store is temporarily closed.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Well, it WAS open for the entire duration of the
challenge. I suppose they need to close sometimes.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s been a long time since Commissioner Snap
left...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] ...but the MSO has finally named a replacement.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They made an announcement just the other day.
I’m not sure they picked the right person...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I saw the Commissioner leaving HQ just after
the challenge ended.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I suppose he must’ve been on his way to Infern
Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Things are never dull around here.
It’s one crisis after another...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] You know, if it were always like this, living in
Green Bays wouldn’t be so bad.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What’s that? You want to know how to get to
Infant Isle? ...Seriously?
[f1][fb][fd]
[a7][b0] ...Er, you just take a sea scooter from the north
jetty...or am I missing something here?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I have to go to Infern Isle to see the aftermath
of the disaster for myself.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I always thought of it as a depressing back-
water where nothing ever happened, but not now!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oh, is that right?
You’ve been to Infern Isle?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’ve got guts, kid.
That’s prob’ly why you’re the champ.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] What exactly did the Commissioner think he
could do about a disaster like that?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Pray to the weather gods?
Do a voodoo dance?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hi, [f5]!
I watched you fight.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Considering that was your first time, you were
truly amazing!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Even when I do get a chance to speak to her,
all she wants to talk about is the news.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Blast it!
I want to get to know the REAL Canasta!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Newsflash!
MSO announces new Commissioner!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Rumour has it that the new commissioner bought
out the whole of the MSO for a huge heap of cash.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Who the heck is rich enough to BUY the MSO!?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s been a long time since Commissioner Snap
left...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] ...but the MSO has finally named a replacement.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They made the announcement the other day.
Not too sure about their choice though...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s no way Dr Snap is dead. It’d take more
than a little disaster to finish him off.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] My theory is he went to the mainland to find
some new monsters.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Ginny Rumm[96] I mean, Commissioner Solitaire is a
real slave driver. We’re run off our feet.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] People say that Commissioner Rummy has some
seriously scary monsters in her team.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And that they’re equipped with the kind of
weapons a king couldn’t afford.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Anyone who wants to face that lot must be
insane, suicidal or suicidally insane!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Rank X tourney and the Advanced Monster
Scout Proficiency Test are both killers.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But if I had to choose, I reckon I’d start with the
arena...maybe.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I mean, it’s straightforward, ain’t it?
All you need is some bloomin’ powerful monsters.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hey, champion! I’m your biggest fan!
Do your best for me, okay! [a8]wink[a9]

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The department store has received a shipment of
powerful weapons and some other useful items.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I imagine a scout of your abilities would be able
to get some use out of them.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Crikey, Canasta’s lookin’ scrumptious today, eh?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ‘Why don’t I talk to her?’
Are you mad? I couldn’t do that!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] What if she thought I was being weird or
somethin’? I’d never get a second chance!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Newsflash! MSO Commissioner Solitaire announces
Solitaire’s Challenge, calling it ‘the next big thing’!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Everyone’s talking about this Solitaire’s
Challenge thing the Commissioner announced.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s not like the old challenge.
Apparently, you can enter whenever you like.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Oh, that is SUCH old news!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Scouts have to meet certain requirements before
they can compete.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Once they have, they get to fight Commissioner
Rummy!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The battles are held in the sky arena, where
the old challenge finals took place.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] After the disaster, I went to see Infern Isle
for myself.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s unbelievable what happened to that place.
Unbelievable.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Every night, I see this old geezer headin’ down
to the sewers.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I don’t think he lives down there.
What do you reckon he’s up to?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] From this jetty, you can go to Xeroph Isle and
Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] There’s a battle arena on Xeroph Isle where
you can fight monsters.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Have you seen the face carved on the rock on
Infern Isle? It scared the living daylights out of me.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Ginny Rumm[96] I mean, Commissioner Solitaire is a
real slave driver. We’re run off our feet.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] People say that Commissioner Rummy has some
seriously scary monsters in her team.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And that they’re equipped with the kind of
weapons a king couldn’t afford.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Anyone who wants to face that lot must be
insane, suicidal or suicidally insane!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] As time goes by, more and more people seem to
be forgetting the incident on Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Personally, I think it’s for the best.
Forget the hard times, as I always say.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] No matter how many times I try, I cannot
win the Rank A tourney at the battle arena.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Plus, I haven’t been able to solve even one
problem in the advanced proficiency test!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’ve as much chance of winning Solitaire’s
Challenge as a bubble slime!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Just bein’ able to gaze at Canasta fills me
heart with joy.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I don’t dare wish for anythin’ more than that.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.text:
[eb]Newsflash! MSO Commissioner Solitaire announces
Solitaire’s Challenge, calling it ‘the next big thing’!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I wonder why Commissioner Solitaire didn’t
include Madame Rummy’s gardens in her challenge?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Maybe she and the Old Maid don’t get on?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Or perhaps the new commissioner is trying to
assert her independence?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] How did the new commissioner make enough
money to actually BUY the MSO?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] People always said she was a princess.
Seems it was truer than we thought.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I saw that funny old geezer headin’ down to
the sewers again today.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I tried to warn him about how dangerous it is
down there, but he’d have none of it.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] From this jetty, you can go to Xeroph Isle and

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier

[ea][a7][b0] You must be pretty close to fulfilling the entry

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I knew it.
I can’t wait to see you take on the Commissioner.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I’m going to be cheering you on!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’d better get a move on then.

s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Qualifying for Solitaire’s Challenge is murder

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] This scouting business is harder than it
looks! And the monsters SMELL!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Rumour has it that some scouts have already
attempted Solitaire’s Challenge.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But she beat them all and sent them packing,
tails firmly between their legs.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Looks like beating the Commissioner is going to
take some doing...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Oh, that is SUCH old news!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I hear that [f5] is all set to take part
in Solitaire’s Challenge.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] They’ll probably be fighting soon.
Now that’s one battle I HAVE to watch.
