you can fight monsters.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Have you seen the face carved on the rock on
Infern Isle? It scared the living daylights out of me.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Ginny Rumm[96] I mean, Commissioner Solitaire is a
real slave driver. We’re run off our feet.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Well done, champ!
You won Solitaire’s Challenge in style!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’re going to go down in the challenge record
books as one of the greatest scouts in history!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The Rank X tourney and the Advanced Monster
Scout Proficiency Test are both killers.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But if I had to choose, I reckon I’d start with the
arena...maybe.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I mean, it’s straightforward, ain’t it?
All you need is some bloomin’ powerful monsters.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hey, champion! I’m your biggest fan!
Do your best for me, okay! [a8]wink[a9]

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Qualifying for Solitaire’s Challenge is murder
for a new scout like me.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] This scouting business is harder than it
looks! And the monsters SMELL!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Crikey, Canasta’s lookin’ scrumptious today, eh?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ‘Why don’t I talk to her?’
Are you mad? I couldn’t do that!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] What if she thought I was being weird or
somethin’? I’d never get a second chance!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]This just in! [d0]1[f5] becomes the first scout
to win Solitaire’s Challenge!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Did you hear the news?
[d0]1[f5] won Solitaire’s Challenge.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Looks like he isn’t a one-hit wonder after all.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Oh, that is SUCH old news!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The Commissioner announced that she lost
deliberately, to keep things interesting for the fans.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It looks like she’s trying to set up a revenge
match.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’ve just returned from Infern Isle, and I’ve got
some news! The monsters are stronger than ever!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] It’s just the place for any scouts looking for a
quick, but dangerous, way to power up their team!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Every night, I see this old geezer headin’ down
to the sewers.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I don’t think he lives down there.
What do you reckon he’s up to?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey there, champ!
I heard you won Solitaire’s little challenge!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They’re saying you might be the greatest
challenge champion ever.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If only we could have seen you and old Snap
fight [96] then we’d know for sure!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Ginny Rumm[96] I mean, Commissioner Solitaire is a
real slave driver. We’re run off our feet.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Well done, champ!
You won Solitaire’s Challenge in style!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] You’re going to go down in the challenge record
books as one of the greatest scouts in history!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] As time goes by, more and more people seem to
be forgetting the incident on Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Personally, I think it’s for the best.
Forget the hard times, as I always say.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] No matter how many times I try, I cannot
win the Rank A tourney at the battle arena.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Plus, I haven’t been able to solve even one
problem in the advanced proficiency test!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’ve as much chance of winning Solitaire’s
Challenge as a bubble slime!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Just bein’ able to gaze at Canasta fills me
heart with joy.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I don’t dare wish for anythin’ more than that.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]This just in! [d0]1[f5] becomes the first scout
to win Solitaire’s Challenge!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I wonder why Commissioner Solitaire didn’t
include Madame Rummy’s gardens in her challenge?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Maybe she and the Old Maid don’t get on?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Or perhaps the new commissioner is trying to
assert her independence?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] How did the new commissioner make enough
money to actually BUY the MSO?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] People always said she was a princess.
Seems it was truer than we thought.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I saw that funny old geezer headin’ down to
the sewers again today.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I tried to warn him about how dangerous it is
down there, but he’d have none of it.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Hey there, champ!
I heard you won Solitaire’s little challenge!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They’re saying you might be the greatest
challenge champion ever.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] If only we could have seen you and old Snap
fight [96] then we’d know for sure!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What should we do?
The Commissioner hasn’t returned.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Even though the challenge is over, we still need
him here to run things.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I definitely saw a black monster flying through
the sky.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I could’ve sworn there was someone riding on its
back, but maybe it was just my imagination.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I saw a black beast flyin’ through the sky. It
was headin’ north-east as far as I could make out.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The closest place I know of in that neck of the
woods is Infern Isle...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] [a8]sigh[a9] The challenge is over, and now I have
nothing to look forward to.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I thought the Commissioner wouldn’t be busy
any more, so I decided to pay him a visit.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But the old codger had wandered off some-
where and no one knew when he was due back.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Ooh, the challenge finals were SO exciting!
My heart was in my mouth the whole time!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] It’s settled.
I’m going to be a scout too!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] I mean, how can you be born on this island and
not enter the scout challenge?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]This just in! [d0]1[f5] named seventh Monster
Scout Challenge champion!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They sell some unbelievably expensive weapons
at the department store.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] I wonder if anyone can actually afford them.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] You would not believe what I just saw...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...The Commissioner went zipping overhead on the
back of a big black monster!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Er...maybe I need to get some rest...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Did you hear?
The champion gave his monster to the Commissioner.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Maybe Snap made him an offer he couldn’t
refuse.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb][a7][b0] Oh, that is SUCH old news!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] The monster the Commissioner had was black.
The champion’s was white.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] They can’t be the same monster.
No way.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Huh? You’re lookin’ for the Commissioner?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]shrug[a9]
Well, all I know is he ain’t in the sewers.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Nope, I haven’t seen the Commissioner around
here. Although...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...I have heard strange rumours about something
[96] or someone [96] flying off the island...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] What should we do?
The Commissioner hasn’t returned.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Even though the challenge is over, we still need
him here to run things.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I definitely saw a black monster flying through
the sky.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I could’ve sworn there was someone riding on its
back, but maybe it was just my imagination.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I saw a black beast flyin’ through the sky. It
was headin’ north-east as far as I could make out.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The closest place I know of in that neck of the
woods is Infern Isle...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I thought the Commissioner wouldn’t be busy
any more, so I decided to pay him a visit.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But the old codger had wandered off some-
where and no one knew when he was due back.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Oooh, that MSO bird’s a right stunner!
I think I’m in love...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]Tah-da-da-DAH! It’s news hour, and I’m your host,
Canasta Croupier!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb]This just in! [d0]1[f5] named seventh Monster
Scout Challenge champion!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [eb]Make sure you check it out!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] You would not believe what I just saw...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...The Commissioner went zipping overhead on the
back of a big black monster!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Er...maybe I need to get some rest...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Okay, I think I’ve been here long enough.
I’m off!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] But I reckon I’ll be back for the next scout
challenge.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Until then, ‘Do Your Best’, Monster Scout.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Hi, [f5]!
I watched you fight.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[eb][a7][b0] Considering that was your first time, you were
truly amazing!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] Huh? You’re lookin’ for the Commissioner?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] [a8]shrug[a9]
Well, all I know is he ain’t in the sewers.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Nope, I haven’t seen the Commissioner around
here. Although...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...I have heard strange rumours about something
[96] or someone [96] flying off the island...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I heard that a horrible face has appeared on
the rocks of Infern Isle.

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I’d love to go and see for myself, but there’s no
way I’d ever go alone...

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] So, er, champ...do you want to scoot over there
with me?

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text: [ea][a7][b0] REALLY!? Great! Okay, champ, let’s go!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] ...Er, but once we get there, we split up, okay?
Every scout for himself!

s021.speaker: Canasta Croupier
s021.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Really...? If I was with you, wild buffalogres
couldn’t keep me away, but not on my own.

s031.speaker: Wingle
s031.text:
[ea]Given a choice between fight and flight, you’d
choose to fight, right?

s031.speaker: Wingle
s031.text: [ea]Excellent choice.

s031.speaker: Wingle
s031.text: [ea]Chicken.

s031.speaker: Percy Weed
s031.text:
[ea]Er, excuse me.
Would you care for a battle?

s031.speaker: Percy Weed
s031.text: [ea]Oh, goody!

s031.speaker: Percy Weed
s031.text: [ea]Aw...

s031.speaker: Sebeastian
s031.text:
[ea]Hey, loser.
Wanna try and take me on?

s031.speaker: Sebeastian
s031.text:
[ea]Right.
You asked for it!

s031.speaker: Sebeastian
s031.text:
[ea]Aw, come on.
Don’t be a wuss.

s031.speaker: Sebeastian
s031.text:
[ea]Give me fight, pleeease!
Pleasepleasepleaseplease!

s031.speaker: Victoria
s031.text:
[eb]What, you want a battle?
Is that why you’re talking to me?

s031.speaker: Victoria
s031.text:
[eb]Suits me just fine.
Now show me what you got!

s031.speaker: Victoria
s031.text:
[eb]So, what then? Are you trying to pick me up?
I’m out of your league.

s031.speaker: Wyrma
s031.text:
[eb]Excuse me!
Could I tempt you to a little battle?

s031.speaker: Wyrma
s031.text:
[eb]Oh, thank you! But do be gentle with me, okay?
I haven’t done this too often.

s031.speaker: Wyrma
s031.text: [eb]Oh? Aren’t you feeling up to it?

s031.speaker: Orephelia
s031.text:
[eb]I-I’m no good at battles, you know.
I never win.

s031.speaker: Orephelia
s031.text: [eb]Do you really want to fight someone like me?

s031.speaker: Orephelia
s031.text: [eb]Well, please don’t hurt me.

s031.speaker: Orephelia
s031.text:
[eb]That’s right.
Fighting me wouldn’t be any fun.

s031.speaker: Nick
s031.text: [ea][a8]giggles[a9] Oh, looks like it’s my lucky day.

s031.speaker: Nick
s031.text: [ea]You and me, we fight, right?

s031.speaker: Nick
s031.text: [ea]Dinner time!

s031.speaker: Nick
s031.text: [ea]Pfft. I needed to make some cash, fast.

s031.speaker: Christough
s031.text:
[ea]In this world, power is everything.
We shall fight, young scout!

s031.speaker: Christough
s031.text: [ea]There can be only one!

s031.speaker: Christough
s031.text: [ea]Bah! What fun are you?

s031.speaker: Seedy Player
s031.text:
[ea]Hey, kid.
Do me a favour and fight me, okay?

s031.speaker: Seedy Player
s031.text:
[ea]Heheheh, now THAT’S what I’m talkin’ about...
The kid’s got guts!

s031.speaker: Seedy Player
s031.text:
[ea]Aw, come on.
Don’t make me beg!

s031.speaker: Fauna
s031.text:
[eb]Hey, sir?
Do you want to have a battle?

s031.speaker: Fauna
s031.text:
[eb]Yippee!
A battle, a battle!

s031.speaker: Fauna
s031.text:
[eb]Aw, but why? Come ON, PLEASE can we fight?
Just a little one!

s031.speaker: Milicia
s031.text:
[eb]Huh?
Excuse me, but are you flirting with me?

s031.speaker: Milicia
s031.text:
[eb]Oh, I see.
Well, I suppose a battle would be acceptable.

s031.speaker: Milicia
s031.text:
[eb][a8]chuckle[a9] A battle it is then.
But don’t think I’m going to go easy on you!

s031.speaker: Milicia
s031.text:
[eb]I beg your pardon!
Are you turning me down!?

s031.speaker: Maggie
s031.text:
[eb]Hmph. Nice hair.
You don’t look so tough.

s031.speaker: Maggie
s031.text:
[eb]I’ll give you a practice fight.
How about it, spiky head?

s031.speaker: Maggie
s031.text: [eb]Okay. Let me show you how it’s done!

s031.speaker: Maggie
s031.text: [eb]You won’t get any better if you don’t practise!

s031.speaker: Francis Drake
s031.text:
[ea]Ah, perfect timing!
I’m in the mood for a fight. Shall we?

s031.speaker: Francis Drake
s031.text:
[ea]Capital. Do your best, now!
I’d rather not embarrass you!

s031.speaker: Francis Drake
s031.text: [ea]Alas, a missed opportunity if ever there was one.

s031.speaker: Kelvin Klein
s031.text: [ea]Yo, kid. Wanna fight?

s031.speaker: Kelvin Klein
s031.text: [ea]Bring it on!

s031.speaker: Kelvin Klein
s031.text: [ea]Pathetic.

s031.speaker: Norm
s031.text:
[ea]Our paths have crossed. There’s no going back.
We’ve no choice now but to FIGHT!

s031.speaker: Norm
s031.text:
[ea]Enough talking.
Let battle commence!

s031.speaker: Norm
s031.text:
[ea]You’re refusing me?
And you call yourself a scout!

s031.speaker: Daisy
s031.text:
[eb]You want a piece of me?
Come and get it, if you dare.

s031.speaker: Daisy
s031.text:
[eb]Excellent.
This might prove to be...stimulating.

s031.speaker: Daisy
s031.text:
[eb]Fine.
If you don’t think you can handle me...

s031.speaker: Sweetie
s031.text:
[eb]Hey, you’re a cutie.
I’ll be your sparring partner, if you like.

s031.speaker: Sweetie
s031.text:
[eb][a8]snigger[a9] Okay, but that was your last chance to
turn me down!

s031.speaker: Sweetie
s031.text: [eb]Still too young, huh?

s031.speaker: Destiny
s031.text: [eb]I think fate has brought us together today.

s031.speaker: Destiny
s031.text: [eb]We must do battle.

s031.speaker: Destiny
s031.text: [eb]Yes. Let us follow the path and discover our fate.

s031.speaker: Destiny
s031.text: [eb]You cannot escape destiny.

s031.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s031.text:
[df]Well aren’t you a lively-looking young fellow!
Wilhelm Splitz at your service.

s031.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s031.text:
[df]What’s that? You want to fight an old codger like
me!?

s031.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s031.text:
[df][a8]chuckle[a9] I still have a few tricks up my sleeve,
young ’un!

s031.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s031.text:
[df]Is that so?
Hm, I didn’t take you to be a coward...

s031.speaker: Gardini
s031.text:
[df]I may not look it, but I’m a scout jus’ like
yerself. Fancy a fight?

s031.speaker: Gardini
s031.text:
[df]Right then! Get ready to find out why yer
oughta respect yer elders!

s031.speaker: Gardini
s031.text:
[df][a8]laugh[a9]
Children these days have got no backbone!

s031.speaker: Grandead
s031.text:
[df]When two scouts cross paths, nothing can
prevent them from...from...err...

s031.speaker: Grandead
s031.text:
[df]Now, what is it...?
Ah, I remember [96] from FIGHTING!

s031.speaker: Grandead
s031.text:
[df]I’m jolly strong, you know.
You’ll not get the better of me!

s031.speaker: Grandead
s031.text:

s061.speaker: Grandead
s061.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Ah’ve been seein’ so many scouts headin’ intae
town, Ah jus’ assumed ye were too.

s061.speaker: Grandead
s061.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s061.speaker: Grandead
s061.text:
[ea][a7][b0] Come on, old man!
We have tae get outta here right noo!

s061.speaker: Grandead
s061.text:
[df][a7][b0] Go if you want to! I’m staying right here, and
there’s naught you can do about it!

s061.speaker: Grandead
s061.text:
[ea][a7][b0] A-A huge hole opened in the sky, and then
something started pouring from it!

s061.speaker: Grandead
s061.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The wastelands are covered in the stuff!
I-It’s chaos out there!

s061.speaker: Grandead
s061.text:
[ea][a7][b0] The cataclysm has come!
No one can stay on this island and survive!

s061.speaker: Grandead
s061.text: [ea][a7][b0] No one can stay on this island and survive!

s061.speaker: Grandead
s061.text:
[ea][a7][b0] I can’t wait any longer. We have to evacuate
NOW! That girl’s gone and she’s not coming back!

s061.speaker: Grandead
s061.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s061.speaker: Grandead
s061.text:
[ea][a7][b0] They say the monsters on this island are hard
as nails.

s061.speaker: Grandead
s061.text:
[ea][a7][b0] And do you know what? They aren’t wrong!
The beasties here are way too much for me!

s061.speaker: Grandead
s061.text: [ea]If you see this message, it is a BUG!

s062.speaker: Wingle
s062.text:
[ea]Given a choice between fight and flight, you’d
choose to fight, right?

s062.speaker: Wingle
s062.text: [ea]Excellent choice.

s062.speaker: Wingle
s062.text: [ea]Chicken.

s062.speaker: Percy Weed
s062.text:
[ea]Er, excuse me.
Would you care for a battle?

s062.speaker: Percy Weed
s062.text: [ea]Oh, goody!

s062.speaker: Percy Weed
s062.text: [ea]Aw...

s062.speaker: Sebeastian
s062.text:
[ea]Hey, loser.
Wanna try and take me on?

s062.speaker: Sebeastian
s062.text:
[ea]Right.
You asked for it!

s062.speaker: Sebeastian
s062.text:
[ea]Aw, come on.
Don’t be a wuss.

s062.speaker: Sebeastian
s062.text:
[ea]Give me fight, pleeease!
Pleasepleasepleaseplease!

s062.speaker: Victoria
s062.text:
[eb]What, you want a battle?
Is that why you’re talking to me?

s062.speaker: Victoria
s062.text:
[eb]Suits me just fine.
Now show me what you got!

s062.speaker: Victoria
s062.text:
[eb]So, what then? Are you trying to pick me up?
I’m out of your league.

s062.speaker: Wyrma
s062.text:
[eb]Excuse me!
Could I tempt you to a little battle?

s062.speaker: Wyrma
s062.text:
[eb]Oh, thank you! But do be gentle with me, okay?
I haven’t done this too often.

s062.speaker: Wyrma
s062.text: [eb]Oh? Aren’t you feeling up to it?

s062.speaker: Orephelia
s062.text:
[eb]I-I’m no good at battles, you know.
I never win.

s062.speaker: Orephelia
s062.text: [eb]Do you really want to fight someone like me?

s062.speaker: Orephelia
s062.text: [eb]Well, please don’t hurt me.

s062.speaker: Orephelia
s062.text:
[eb]That’s right.
Fighting me wouldn’t be any fun.

s062.speaker: Nick
s062.text: [ea][a8]giggles[a9] Oh, looks like it’s my lucky day.

s062.speaker: Nick
s062.text: [ea]You and me, we fight, right?

s062.speaker: Nick
s062.text: [ea]Dinner time!

s062.speaker: Nick
s062.text: [ea]Pfft. I needed to make some cash, fast.

s062.speaker: Christough
s062.text:
[ea]In this world, power is everything.
We shall fight, young scout!

s062.speaker: Christough
s062.text: [ea]There can be only one!

s062.speaker: Christough
s062.text: [ea]Bah! What fun are you?

s062.speaker: Seedy Player
s062.text:
[ea]Hey, kid.
Do me a favour and fight me, okay?

s062.speaker: Seedy Player
s062.text:
[ea]Heheheh, now THAT’S what I’m talkin’ about...
The kid’s got guts!

s062.speaker: Seedy Player
s062.text:
[ea]Aw, come on.
Don’t make me beg!

s062.speaker: Fauna
s062.text:
[eb]Hey, sir?
Do you want to have a battle?

s062.speaker: Fauna
s062.text:
[eb]Yippee!
A battle, a battle!

s062.speaker: Fauna
s062.text:
[eb]Aw, but why? Come ON, PLEASE can we fight?
Just a little one!

s062.speaker: Milicia
s062.text:
[eb]Huh?
Excuse me, but are you flirting with me?

s062.speaker: Milicia
s062.text:
[eb]Oh, I see.
Well, I suppose a battle would be acceptable.

s062.speaker: Milicia
s062.text:
[eb][a8]chuckle[a9] A battle it is then.
But don’t think I’m going to go easy on you!

s062.speaker: Milicia
s062.text:
[eb]I beg your pardon!
Are you turning me down!?

s062.speaker: Maggie
s062.text:
[eb]Hmph. Nice hair.
You don’t look so tough.

s062.speaker: Maggie
s062.text:
[eb]I’ll give you a practice fight.
How about it, spiky head?

s062.speaker: Maggie
s062.text: [eb]Okay. Let me show you how it’s done!

s062.speaker: Maggie
s062.text: [eb]You won’t get any better if you don’t practise!

s062.speaker: Francis Drake
s062.text:
[ea]Ah, perfect timing!
I’m in the mood for a fight. Shall we?

s062.speaker: Francis Drake
s062.text:
[ea]Capital. Do your best, now!
I’d rather not embarrass you!

s062.speaker: Francis Drake
s062.text: [ea]Alas, a missed opportunity if ever there was one.

s062.speaker: Kelvin Klein
s062.text: [ea]Yo, kid. Wanna fight?

s062.speaker: Kelvin Klein
s062.text: [ea]Bring it on!

s062.speaker: Kelvin Klein
s062.text: [ea]Pathetic.

s062.speaker: Norm
s062.text:
[ea]Our paths have crossed. There’s no going back.
We’ve no choice now but to FIGHT!

s062.speaker: Norm
s062.text:
[ea]Enough talking.
Let battle commence!

s062.speaker: Norm
s062.text:
[ea]You’re refusing me?
And you call yourself a scout!

s062.speaker: Daisy
s062.text:
[eb]You want a piece of me?
Come and get it, if you dare.

s062.speaker: Daisy
s062.text:
[eb]Excellent.
This might prove to be...stimulating.

s062.speaker: Daisy
s062.text:
[eb]Fine.
If you don’t think you can handle me...

s062.speaker: Sweetie
s062.text:
[eb]Hey, you’re a cutie.
I’ll be your sparring partner, if you like.

s062.speaker: Sweetie
s062.text:
[eb][a8]snigger[a9] Okay, but that was your last chance to
turn me down!

s062.speaker: Sweetie
s062.text: [eb]Still too young, huh?

s062.speaker: Destiny
s062.text: [eb]I think fate has brought us together today.

s062.speaker: Destiny
s062.text: [eb]We must do battle.

s062.speaker: Destiny
s062.text: [eb]Yes. Let us follow the path and discover our fate.

s062.speaker: Destiny
s062.text: [eb]You cannot escape destiny.

s062.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s062.text:
[df]Well aren’t you a lively-looking young fellow!
Wilhelm Splitz at your service.

s062.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s062.text:
[df]What’s that? You want to fight an old codger like
me!?

s062.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s062.text:
[df][a8]chuckle[a9] I still have a few tricks up my sleeve,
young ’un!

s062.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
s062.text:
[df]Is that so?
Hm, I didn’t take you to be a coward...

s062.speaker: Gardini
s062.text:
[df]I may not look it, but I’m a scout jus’ like
yerself. Fancy a fight?

s062.speaker: Gardini
s062.text:
[df]Right then! Get ready to find out why yer
oughta respect yer elders!

s062.speaker: Gardini
s062.text:
[df][a8]laugh[a9]
Children these days have got no backbone!

s062.speaker: Grandead
s062.text:
[df]When two scouts cross paths, nothing can
prevent them from...from...err...

s062.speaker: Grandead
s062.text:
[df]Now, what is it...?
Ah, I remember [96] from FIGHTING!

s062.speaker: Grandead
s062.text:
[df]I’m jolly strong, you know.
You’ll not get the better of me!

s062.speaker: Grandead
s062.text:
[df]What, you won’t fight, you say?
Bah, kids these days...

s062.speaker: Grandead
s062.text: Fight this scout?
